papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在GaAs(111)B衬底上成功生长出高质量α-MnTe薄膜，并通过拉曼光谱完整分辨了所有对称性允许的拉曼活性声子模式（121和140 cm⁻¹附近），结合第一性原理计算确认了这些模式属于六方NiAs型晶格。；创新点：首次在技术相关衬底（GaAs(111)B）上实现高质量α-MnTe薄膜的MBE外延生长，并完整解析了其所有对称性允许的拉曼活性声子模式，为研究反铁磁及其晶格耦合激发提供了稳健的薄膜平台。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（MBE）生长、拉曼光谱（Raman spectroscopy）、第一性原理声子计算（first principles phonon calculations）

papers.title: Magneto-optic phonon resonances in magnetic topological EuCd2As2 via helical Raman spectroscopy
papers.abstract: EuCd2As2 materials have two magnetic ordering states: antiferromagnetic (AFM) and ferromagnetic (FM) when their chemical tunability is utilized. While AFM-EuCd2As2 has a nonzero magnetoelectric response due to its symmetry breaking with spin configuration, FM-EuCd2As2 is an ideal candidate for studies of Weyl physics because of its minimum number of Weyl points with opposite chirality. In this article, we examine cryogenic low-frequency Raman spectroscopy of phonon modes in FM-EuCd2As2 crystals using circular polarization configurations, with support from density functional theory calculations, and investigate in-plane magneto-anisotropy by linear polarization configuration below the Curie temperature (Tc = 26 K). We attribute the anomalous enhancements in Raman intensities below the Curie temperature are due to spin-phonon coupling. Furthermore, we see that A-mode peaks can be distinguished by magneto-helical Raman spectroscopy through the magneto-optic effect and that the degree of circular polarization (DCP) of 12.5 meV peak reaches 60% at 4.2 K and becomes saturated. We also examine AFM-EuCd2As2 below Néel temperature (TN = 9 K) to compare with FM-EuCd2As2, but we hardly observe spin-phonon coupling and find negligible DCP values due to almost zero net magnetization. Our results contribute to the understanding of the phonon dynamics and the interplay between topology and magnetism in FM-EuCd2As2, through helical light and external magnetic fields. This lays the foundation for utilizing state-of-the-art Weyl systems for applications in thermoelectrics, phononic devices, and topological quantum computing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：cryogenic low-frequency Raman spectroscopy、circular polarization configurations、linear polarization configuration、density functional theory calculations支持）；研究对象：磁性拓扑材料EuCd₂As₂的铁磁态（FM-EuCd₂As₂）和反铁磁态（AFM-EuCd₂As₂）中的声子模式及其与自旋、磁性的耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在铁磁EuCd₂As₂中，居里温度以下拉曼强度的反常增强源于自旋-声子耦合；通过磁螺旋拉曼光谱可区分A模峰，且12.5 meV峰的圆偏振度在4.2 K时达到60%并饱和。反铁磁态中几乎未观察到自旋-声子耦合，圆偏振度可忽略。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在铁磁EuCd₂As₂中，居里温度以下拉曼强度的反常增强源于自旋-声子耦合；通过磁螺旋拉曼光谱可区分A模峰，且12.5 meV峰的圆偏振度在4.2 K时达到60%并饱和。反铁磁态中几乎未观察到自旋-声子耦合，圆偏振度可忽略。；创新点：利用螺旋拉曼光谱（helical Raman spectroscopy）结合磁光效应，首次在铁磁EuCd₂As₂中通过圆偏振配置区分声子模，并定量揭示自旋-声子耦合导致的拉曼强度增强及圆偏振度饱和行为。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 低温低频拉曼光谱（圆偏振和线偏振配置）、密度泛函理论（DFT）计算、磁光效应分析、圆偏振度（DCP）测量。

papers.title: Theory of Electrically Detected Magnetic Resonance of Silicon Vacancy-Related Spin Pairs in Silicon Carbide
papers.abstract: We present a quantitative theory for simulating the electrically detected magnetic resonance (EDMR) of silicon vacancy-related spin pairs in silicon carbide using steady-state Lindblad master equations. In our theory, we consider V1a and V2a deep level silicon vacancies near the (0/-) charge state transition level in proximity to a previously identified nitrogen-related complex, the incomplete K-center, due to the hyperfine, spin structure, and Landé g factor of the shallow state. Our theory describes recent room temperature measurements attributed to V1a silicon vacancies, with reasonable extracted parameters for defect spin coherence times and electrical transport rates. At lower temperatures we predict that the shallow level hyperfine structure may be spectrally resolvable. Finally, we predict the EDMR spectrum of V2a silicon vacancy-related spin pairs and predict that two-photon, double quantum transitions of the silicon vacancy's negative charge state can be electrically read-out for enhanced magnetic field sensing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：quantitative theory、Lindblad master equations、simulating、predict。；研究对象：碳化硅中硅空位相关自旋对（silicon vacancy-related spin pairs）的电检测磁共振（EDMR）现象，具体涉及V1a和V2a深能级硅空位与氮相关复合物（不完全K中心）形成的自旋对体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该理论能够定量描述近期室温下归因于V1a硅空位的EDRM测量结果，并预测在低温下可分辨浅能级超精细结构；同时预测V2a硅空位相关自旋对的EDMR谱，以及硅空位负电荷态的双光子双量子跃迁可用于增强磁场传感的电读出。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该理论能够定量描述近期室温下归因于V1a硅空位的EDRM测量结果，并预测在低温下可分辨浅能级超精细结构；同时预测V2a硅空位相关自旋对的EDMR谱，以及硅空位负电荷态的双光子双量子跃迁可用于增强磁场传感的电读出。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用稳态Lindblad主方程（steady-state Lindblad master equations）进行定量理论模拟，考虑了浅能态的超精细结构、自旋结构以及朗德g因子。

papers.title: Effect of slow bonds on current fluctuations in the symmetric simple exclusion process
papers.abstract: The symmetric simple exclusion process (SSEP) is a paradigmatic model of classical non-equilibrium dynamics. Exact results for large deviations of particle current in the SSEP have been obtained in various settings using integrability-based methods. In this Article, we discuss how these results are modified in the presence of localized slow bonds. We consider three conventional geometries: (a) a finite one-dimensional lattice weakly coupled to unequal reservoirs at its boundaries, (b) a semi-infinite one-dimensional lattice weakly coupled to a boundary reservoir, and (c) an infinite one-dimensional lattice with localized slow bonds near the origin. For each case, we present exact expressions for the large deviation function of current and validate them through rare-event simulations based on the cloning algorithm. In connection with our results, we present an elementary derivation of the exact large deviation function for the current in the semi-infinite SSEP, complementing recent results obtained through more elaborate techniques.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：exact results、large deviation function、integrable methods、analytical derivation）；研究对象：对称简单排斥过程（SSEP）中粒子电流的大偏差行为，特别关注局域慢键（slow bonds）对该行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在三种典型几何构型（有限链、半无限链、无限链）中，局域慢键会显著改变电流大偏差函数的形式，且该函数可通过精确表达式描述，并通过稀有事件模拟验证。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在三种典型几何构型（有限链、半无限链、无限链）中，局域慢键会显著改变电流大偏差函数的形式，且该函数可通过精确表达式描述，并通过稀有事件模拟验证。；创新点：首次系统研究了局域慢键对SSEP中电流大偏差函数的影响，并提供了半无限SSEP中大偏差函数的初等推导，补充了近期通过更复杂技术获得的结果。
papers.method_zh: 基于可积性方法推导电流大偏差函数的精确表达式，并采用克隆算法（cloning algorithm）进行稀有事件模拟验证。此外，对半无限SSEP给出了大偏差函数的初等推导。

papers.title: Nuclear-Electron Hyperfine Coupling of the Shallow States Associated with Vacancies in Gallium Nitride
papers.abstract: We use multiband real space Green's functions computed using open-boundary conditions for clean GaN to exactly solve the potential-scattering Dyson equation to obtain the electronic structure of single nitrogen and gallium vacancies. From these vacancy solutions, we compute the local density of states as well as the Fermi contact and anisotropic contributions to the hyperfine field in the vicinity of the defect. These quantities directly affect electrically-detected magnetic resonance signals, which can be used to identify these defects when present in GaN devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“multiband real space Green's functions”、“exactly solve the potential-scattering Dyson equation”、“compute the local density of states”。；研究对象：氮化镓（GaN）中与氮空位和镓空位相关的浅能级缺陷态，具体研究其电子结构及核-电子超精细耦合性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过精确求解势散射Dyson方程，获得了GaN中单氮空位和单镓空位的电子结构，并计算了缺陷附近的局域态密度以及超精细场的费米接触和各向异性贡献。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过精确求解势散射Dyson方程，获得了GaN中单氮空位和单镓空位的电子结构，并计算了缺陷附近的局域态密度以及超精细场的费米接触和各向异性贡献。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于开放边界条件的多带实空间格林函数方法，对清洁GaN进行计算，并精确求解势散射Dyson方程，从而获得空位缺陷的电子结构。

papers.title: Magnetic ground state of a prototype quasicrystal approximant: a candidate for octahedral spin ice physics
papers.abstract: Magnetic ordering in quasicrystals has recently emerged as a fertile ground for discovering unconventional magnetic states beyond the framework of periodic crystals. However, elucidating the microscopic origin of such states remains challenging due to the intrinsic aperiodicity of quasicrystals. Here, we address this issue by investigating the prototypical Tsai-type quasicrystal approximant Cd6Tb, which preserves the essential local geometry and connectivity of icosahedral quasicrystals while allowing detailed structural and magnetic characterization due to its translational periodicity. Using neutron diffraction measurements, we find a noncoplanar multi-k magnetic ground state composed of Ising-like Tb moments arranged on a network of corner-sharing octahedra, the ingredients required to host octahedral spin-ice physics. Remarkably, only one third of the Tb moments develop long-range magnetic order, whereas the remaining moments display strongly reduced static order accompanied by persistent spin dynamics on microsecond timescales, as evidenced by muon spin rotation. This coexistence of ordered and fluctuating moments constitutes a potential realization of magnetic fragmentation - a key prediction of octahedral spin-ice physics - in a quasicrystal-related material.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：neutron diffraction measurements（中子衍射测量）、muon spin rotation（μ子自旋旋转）等实验手段。；研究对象：Tsai型准晶近似相Cd6Tb，一种保持二十面体准晶局部几何与连接性、但具有平移周期性的材料，用于研究准晶中的磁有序及八面体自旋冰物理。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Cd6Tb的磁基态为非共面多k结构，由类Ising的Tb磁矩排列在共角八面体网络上构成；仅1/3的Tb磁矩形成长程磁有序，其余磁矩呈现强烈减弱的静态有序并伴随微秒时间尺度的持续自旋动力学，实现了准晶相关材料中八面体自旋冰物理所预言的“磁碎片化”现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Cd6Tb的磁基态为非共面多k结构，由类Ising的Tb磁矩排列在共角八面体网络上构成；仅1/3的Tb磁矩形成长程磁有序，其余磁矩呈现强烈减弱的静态有序并伴随微秒时间尺度的持续自旋动力学，实现了准晶相关材料中八面体自旋冰物理所预言的“磁碎片化”现象。；创新点：首次在准晶相关材料中实验观察到八面体自旋冰物理的关键预言——磁碎片化（有序与涨落磁矩共存）。
papers.method_zh: 中子衍射测量（确定磁结构）、μ子自旋旋转（探测自旋动力学）。

papers.title: Liquid-Liquid Phase Separation in a Minimal Explicit-Solvent Lattice Model Mimicking Protein Solutions
papers.abstract: Biomolecular condensates play essential roles in cellular processes, and recent efforts have focused on understanding their assembly and rational design principles. In this study, we have employed an explicit-solvent minimal statistical mechanical model based on the lattice-gas Hamiltonian with quenched disorder -- which mimics crowders -- to investigate how protein-solvent and protein-crowder interactions influence condensate phase behavior and morphology. The computed phase diagrams reveal rich behavior, including upper critical solution temperature (UCST), closed-loop, and reentrant type transitions under varying protein-solvent interactions at both equilibrium and out-of-equilibrium conditions. We elucidated the origin of these phase behavior changes and examined the role of protein-crowder interactions in modulating condensed phase morphology and stability. We further extended this model to binary protein mixtures where we studied the phase behavior in the presence and absence of quenched disorder. Without disorder, the system exhibits diverse phase-separated morphologies -- partially wetted, fully wetted, segregative, and associative -- with phase boundaries delicately sensitive protein-solvent interactions. The introduction of quenched disorder (or crowder) leads to a broader spectrum of complex morphologies, dictated by the interplay among protein-protein, protein-solvent, and protein-crowder interaction parameters. In general, this work underscores that protein-solvent and protein-crowder interactions, together with protein-protein interactions, can act as key regulatory parameters for modulating condensate morphology. These insights may guide future computational and experimental studies of liquid-liquid phase separation in biomolecular systems aimed at designing stimuli-responsive condensates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：explicit-solvent minimal statistical mechanical model、lattice-gas Hamiltonian、quenched disorder、phase diagrams。；研究对象：蛋白质溶液中的液-液相分离（LLPS）行为，特别是蛋白质-溶剂相互作用和蛋白质-拥挤剂（crowder）相互作用对凝聚体相行为及形貌的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 蛋白质-溶剂和蛋白质-拥挤剂相互作用可调控相图呈现UCST、闭环和回滞型转变；引入无序（拥挤剂）可产生更丰富的复杂凝聚体形貌（如部分润湿、完全润湿、分离型和结合型）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：蛋白质-溶剂和蛋白质-拥挤剂相互作用可调控相图呈现UCST、闭环和回滞型转变；引入无序（拥挤剂）可产生更丰富的复杂凝聚体形貌（如部分润湿、完全润湿、分离型和结合型）。；创新点：在显式溶剂晶格模型中系统研究了蛋白质-溶剂和蛋白质-拥挤剂相互作用作为独立调控参数对液-液相分离形貌的调节作用，并扩展至二元蛋白质混合物体系，揭示了无序（拥挤剂）引入后形貌多样性的增加。
papers.method_zh: 基于含淬火无序的晶格气体哈密顿量的显式溶剂最小统计力学模型，通过计算平衡态和非平衡态下的相图，并分析蛋白质-溶剂、蛋白质-拥挤剂相互作用参数对相行为及形貌的影响。

papers.title: Topology of pulsating active matter: Defect asymmetry controls emergent motility
papers.abstract: In pulsating active matter, topological defects are motile despite the absence of any macroscopic flows and microscopic self-propulsion. We reveal that this motility arises from a ratchet effect: the mechanochemical coupling between local oscillations and repulsive interactions breaks both spatial and time-reversal symmetries, thus leading asymmetric rotating defects to drift under fluctuations. This mechanism regulates a crossover between spiral waves connecting slow defects and fiber-like waves connecting fast defects, in analogy with the onset of heart rhythm disorder in cardiac tissues. We rationalize this crossover in terms of a fluctuating hydrodynamics that captures how motile defects spontaneously nucleate and move within an ordered background.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：fluctuating hydrodynamics、mechanochemical coupling、ratchet effect）；研究对象：脉动活性物质（pulsating active matter）中的拓扑缺陷及其涌现运动性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了脉动活性物质中拓扑缺陷的运动源于棘轮效应：局部振荡与排斥相互作用之间的机械化学耦合同时打破了空间和时间反演对称性，导致不对称旋转缺陷在涨落下漂移。该机制调控了慢速缺陷连接的螺旋波与快速缺陷连接的纤维状波之间的转变，类似于心脏组织中心律失常的起始。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了脉动活性物质中拓扑缺陷的运动源于棘轮效应：局部振荡与排斥相互作用之间的机械化学耦合同时打破了空间和时间反演对称性，导致不对称旋转缺陷在涨落下漂移。该机制调控了慢速缺陷连接的螺旋波与快速缺陷连接的纤维状波之间的转变，类似于心脏组织中心律失常的起始。；创新点：首次将脉动活性物质中缺陷的运动性归因于对称性破缺导致的棘轮效应，并建立了与心脏组织心律失常的类比。
papers.method_zh: 采用涨落流体动力学（fluctuating hydrodynamics）理论框架，分析缺陷在有序背景中自发成核与运动的机制。

papers.title: Demagnetization effect on magnetic noise measurements in spin ice materials
papers.abstract: Magnetic noise spectroscopy provides direct access to spontaneous time-dependent magnetization fluctuations in correlated magnetic systems, including spin liquids, spin ices, and spin glasses. Here we investigate how demagnetizing fields shape the magnetic noise spectra measured in spin ice. By combining magnetic noise and ac susceptibility measurements on single-crystal spin ice samples with different sizes and shapes, we show that magnetic noise, like linear response, is strongly renormalized by sample geometry. As a consequence, measured noise spectra do not directly yield the intrinsic fluctuation spectrum, and demagnetization corrections cannot in general be determined from noise data alone. Instead, sample geometry must be treated as a central experimental control parameter for accessing intrinsic dynamics. These results establish the role of boundary conditions in fluctuation spectroscopy and provide a framework for quantitatively comparing noise measurements with microscopic theories of spin dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合实验测量与理论分析）。关键词：magnetic noise spectroscopy、ac susceptibility measurements、single-crystal spin ice samples。；研究对象：自旋冰材料（spin ice）中的磁噪声谱，以及退磁场（demagnetizing fields）对磁噪声测量的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 磁噪声谱受样品几何形状（尺寸和形状）的强烈重整化，因此直接测量的噪声谱并不反映本征的涨落谱；退磁场修正无法仅从噪声数据中确定，样品几何必须作为控制参数才能获取本征动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：磁噪声谱受样品几何形状（尺寸和形状）的强烈重整化，因此直接测量的噪声谱并不反映本征的涨落谱；退磁场修正无法仅从噪声数据中确定，样品几何必须作为控制参数才能获取本征动力学。；创新点：首次系统揭示了退磁场对自旋冰磁噪声测量的影响，指出边界条件在涨落谱学中的关键作用，并建立了将噪声测量与自旋动力学微观理论进行定量比较的框架。
papers.method_zh: 对单晶自旋冰样品进行磁噪声谱（magnetic noise spectroscopy）和交流磁化率（ac susceptibility）测量，并对比不同尺寸和形状的样品。

papers.title: Beyond Gaussian Statistics in Polymer Melts: Statistical Masking of Persistent Local Constraints
papers.abstract: Short polymer chains exhibit clear deviations from Gaussian end-to-end distance statistics, yet the molecular mechanism by which Gaussian behavior is recovered in long chains remains unestablished. Atomistic molecular dynamics simulations of polyethylene melts reveal that conformational heterogeneity persists at the Kuhn scale across all chain lengths, consisting of a mosaic of slow-relaxing, extended aligned chain segments (ACS) and coiled segments -- random conformational sequences (RCS) and chain ends (CE). We show that the end-to-end distance distributions for both unentangled and entangled chains are accurately described by a $q$-Gaussian function, with the entropic index $q$ increasing systematically from $0.67$ (C50) to $0.99$ (C500). This evolution tracks the emergence and accumulation of RCS segments, which are absent in short chains, establishing $q$ as a quantitative ``heterogeneity index''. The $q < 1$ values are a signature of non-extensive statistics, with the ratio of Tsallis to Boltzmann-Gibbs entropy ($S_q/S_1$), computed directly from simulation data without fitting, decreasing from $1.80$ (C50) to $1.03$ (C500). Crucially, we demonstrate that Gaussian recovery does not result from the erasure of Kuhn-scale heterogeneities, as ACS domains persist in all chain lengths above the critical mass ($\approx 35\%$). Instead, the transition to Gaussian statistics is a statistical masking effect, where the accumulation of independent RCS segments progressively obscures the non-Gaussian signatures of the persistent ACS domains.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：Atomistic molecular dynamics simulations（原子分子动力学模拟）。；研究对象：聚合物熔体（聚乙烯熔体）中短链与长链的末端距统计行为，特别是从非高斯统计向高斯统计恢复的分子机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 长链聚合物中高斯统计的恢复并非由于库恩尺度上构象异质性的消失，而是由于独立随机卷曲片段（RCS）的积累对持续存在的非高斯信号（如扩展对齐链段ACS）产生了统计掩蔽效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：长链聚合物中高斯统计的恢复并非由于库恩尺度上构象异质性的消失，而是由于独立随机卷曲片段（RCS）的积累对持续存在的非高斯信号（如扩展对齐链段ACS）产生了统计掩蔽效应。；创新点：首次提出并定量证明了高斯统计恢复的“统计掩蔽”机制，而非传统认为的局部异质性消失；引入q-高斯函数的熵指数q作为定量“异质性指标”，并直接从模拟数据计算Tsallis熵与Boltzmann-Gibbs熵的比值，无需拟合参数。
papers.method_zh: 原子分子动力学模拟（Atomistic MD simulations），具体针对聚乙烯熔体，分析不同链长（C50至C500）的末端距分布，并使用q-高斯函数拟合，同时计算Tsallis熵与Boltzmann-Gibbs熵的比值。

papers.title: Boltzmann Distribution from Invariance of Coarse-Graining-Scale and Energy-Shift
papers.abstract: We present a concise derivation of the Boltzmann form for single-particle energy distributions in classical many-body Hamiltonian systems. The derivation relies on two physical facts: coarse-graining-scale invariance of the empirical distribution and invariance under a uniform shift of the energy zero. These conditions uniquely yield the Boltzmann factor, whose parameter is fixed by the mean energy per particle. For separable Hamiltonians, the equilibrium weight factorizes into kinetic and configurational contributions sharing the same parameter, identified from the kinetic part as the inverse kinetic temperature. The principle extends to any physical quantity with a stationary distribution and translational invariance. It is illustrated in a one-dimensional diatomic hard-core gas and a nonlinear lattice chain, where it predicts velocity, energy, spacing, collision-time, and pressure-dependent displacement distributions in agreement with simulations. The lattice model further shows how harmonic elasticity, anharmonic corrections, internal pressure, and thermal expansion emerge from the same exponential equilibrium weights. Finally, the relationships among different ensembles are briefly discussed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：推导、原理、理论框架。；研究对象：经典多体哈密顿系统中的单粒子能量分布，以及一般物理量的稳态分布。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从粗粒化尺度不变性和能量零点平移不变性这两个物理事实，可以唯一推导出玻尔兹曼分布形式，其参数由每个粒子的平均能量确定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从粗粒化尺度不变性和能量零点平移不变性这两个物理事实，可以唯一推导出玻尔兹曼分布形式，其参数由每个粒子的平均能量确定。；创新点：提供了一种简洁的玻尔兹曼分布推导方法，不依赖于传统的熵最大化或系统与热库耦合的假设，而是直接从分布对粗粒化尺度和能量平移的不变性出发。摘要未突出说明与已有推导相比的具体新意。
papers.method_zh: 基于不变性原理的数学推导，并结合一维双原子硬核气体和非线性晶格链的数值模拟进行验证。

papers.title: Light-Induced Transient Polarization Reversal in Rhombohedrally Stacked Bilayer Transition-Metal Dichalcogenides via an Electronic Mechanism
papers.abstract: Light-induced sliding ferroelectricity in two-dimensional van der Waals materials enables polarization control via relative layer motion. However, polarization switching occurs on the time scale of shear modes (tens of ps) and requires very large fluences, potentially damaging the samples. Here, using constrained density functional theory and many-body real-time simulations, we demonstrate an ultrafast electronic reversal of the total out-of-plane polarization sign in the photoexcited state, without requiring interlayer sliding, in rhombohedrally stacked transition-metal dichalcogenide bilayers. The polarization changes sign relative to its initial ground-state value at moderate fluences and within 200 fs, about 50 times faster than the typical shear-mode period. The ultrafast switching is driven by a rearrangement of localized dipoles around the tungsten sites. We establish a novel general mechanism for electronic control of low-dimensional ferroelectrics common to all polar multilayers having type II band alignment. Our work has direct implications for ultrahigh-speed volatile optical memory operating on sub-ps time scales.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：constrained density functional theory, many-body real-time simulations。；研究对象：菱方堆叠的双层过渡金属硫族化合物（rhombohedrally stacked bilayer transition-metal dichalcogenides）中的光致铁电性及极化翻转现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在光激发态下，无需层间滑动，即可在200飞秒内实现总面外极化方向的超快电子翻转，翻转速度比典型剪切模周期快约50倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在光激发态下，无需层间滑动，即可在200飞秒内实现总面外极化方向的超快电子翻转，翻转速度比典型剪切模周期快约50倍。；创新点：提出了一种全新的、普适的电子机制，用于控制低维铁电体的极化方向，该机制适用于所有具有II型能带排列的极性多层材料，无需依赖层间滑动，可实现亚皮秒时间尺度的超快极化翻转。摘要未突出说明与已有光致滑动铁电性研究的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用约束密度泛函理论（constrained DFT）和多体实时模拟（many-body real-time simulations）进行计算研究。

papers.title: Excess entropy scaling of the transverse sound speed in simple fluids
papers.abstract: A calculation of the transverse sound velocity as a function of excess entropy is presented for several simple fluids, including the Lennard-Jones, Yukawa, one-component plasma, inverse-power law (soft sphere) and hard sphere models. A quasi-universal character of this dependence is established, extending Rosenfeld's excess-entropy scaling of transport coefficients to the transverse sound velocity. The results are discussed in terms of the soft- to hard-sphere crossover and the Frenkel crossover between gas-like and liquid-like dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：calculation、models、scaling。；研究对象：简单流体的横波声速与过剩熵之间的标度关系。具体体系包括Lennard-Jones、Yukawa、单组分等离子体、反幂律（软球）和硬球模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 横波声速作为过剩熵的函数在多种简单流体中表现出准普适性，将Rosenfeld关于输运系数的过剩熵标度推广到了横波声速。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：横波声速作为过剩熵的函数在多种简单流体中表现出准普适性，将Rosenfeld关于输运系数的过剩熵标度推广到了横波声速。；创新点：将原本仅适用于输运系数的Rosenfeld过剩熵标度思想首次拓展到横波声速这一动力学性质，并揭示了其在不同简单流体模型中的准普适行为。
papers.method_zh: 通过计算多种简单流体模型的横波声速，并分析其与过剩熵的函数关系，建立标度律。讨论中涉及软球-硬球交叉以及Frenkel交叉（气体-液体动力学转变）。

papers.title: Trimerized Spin-$1/2$ Chain: Emergent Low-Energy Hamiltonian, Higher-Energy Excitations, and Magnetic and Thermodynamic Responses
papers.abstract: We investigate a spin-1/2 antiferromagnetic chain with trimerized exchange couplings relevant to Na$_2$Cu$_3$Ge$_4$O$_{12}$. We show that the low-energy Hilbert space maps onto an effective Heisenberg chain of composite spin-1/2 trimer degrees of freedom with positive coupling, enabling an exact spinon excitations via the Bethe ansatz. To access higher-energy dynamics, we develop a self-consistent Jordan-Wigner mean-field theory that yields three fermionic bands reflecting the underlying trimer structure. Remarkably, this approach reproduces the exact low-energy spinon continuum while predicting two additional higher-energy excitation bands consistent with the experimental observations and previous numerical simulations. The theory further captures the 1/3 magnetization plateau under an applied magnetic field, and provides testable predictions in magnetic susceptibility and specific heat. Our results establish a unified framework connecting low- and high-energy excitations in trimerized quantum spin chains.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：effective Hamiltonian, Bethe ansatz, mean-field theory, theoretical framework）；研究对象：具有三聚化交换耦合的自旋-1/2反铁磁链，具体关联化合物Na₂Cu₃Ge₄O₁₂。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 低能希尔伯特空间可映射为复合自旋-1/2三聚体自由度的有效海森堡链，通过Bethe ansatz获得精确自旋子激发；自洽Jordan-Wigner平均场理论可同时再现低能自旋子连续谱并预测两个高能激发带，与实验和数值模拟一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：低能希尔伯特空间可映射为复合自旋-1/2三聚体自由度的有效海森堡链，通过Bethe ansatz获得精确自旋子激发；自洽Jordan-Wigner平均场理论可同时再现低能自旋子连续谱并预测两个高能激发带，与实验和数值模拟一致。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: Bethe ansatz精确求解低能有效模型；自洽Jordan-Wigner平均场理论处理高能动力学，得到反映三聚体结构的三条费米子能带。

papers.title: Anomalous Hall Effect in Silicon-Compatible Altermagnetic alpha-MnTe Thin Films
papers.abstract: Integrating spin-dependent functionality with mainstream semiconductor technology is a central goal of modern spintronics, yet most candidate materials remain incompatible with silicon-based platforms. Here, we report the direct epitaxial integration of alpha-MnTe thin films on Si(111) via molecular beam epitaxy and demonstrate a robust anomalous Hall effect (AHE) in this silicon-compatible altermagnetic system. Despite the absence of net magnetization, the films exhibit a pronounced hysteretic Hall response, providing clear evidence of finite Berry curvature generated by symmetry breaking in the thin-film geometry. High resolution structural and spectroscopic characterization confirms phase-pure, epitaxial growth with hexagonal NiAs-type symmetry, while magnetotransport measurements reveal correlated hysteresis in both transverse and longitudinal channels with systematic temperature evolution. First-principles calculations reveal substantial uncompensated Berry curvature arising from the spin-split band structure consistent with altermagnetic symmetry and the origin of the observed Hall response. These results establish MnTe/Si(111) as a silicon-compatible altermagnetic platform and chart a concrete pathway for embedding Berry-phase-driven functionalities into scalable semiconductor device architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：分子束外延、磁输运测量、高分辨结构表征、第一性原理计算辅助）；研究对象：硅基兼容的α-MnTe薄膜（六方NiAs型结构）中的反常霍尔效应（AHE）及交变磁性（altermagnetism）行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在硅衬底上外延生长的α-MnTe薄膜中观测到显著的反常霍尔效应，证明薄膜几何中的对称性破缺产生了有限贝里曲率，从而在无净磁化强度下实现交变磁性的电输运响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在硅衬底上外延生长的α-MnTe薄膜中观测到显著的反常霍尔效应，证明薄膜几何中的对称性破缺产生了有限贝里曲率，从而在无净磁化强度下实现交变磁性的电输运响应。；创新点：首次在硅基兼容的α-MnTe交变磁性薄膜中实现直接外延集成并观测到反常霍尔效应，为将贝里相位驱动的功能集成到可扩展半导体器件架构提供了具体路径。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（MBE）在Si(111)衬底上直接生长α-MnTe薄膜；高分辨结构及光谱表征确认相纯外延生长；磁输运测量（横向和纵向电阻随温度演化）；第一性原理计算分析自旋劈裂能带结构及未补偿贝里曲率。

papers.title: Generalized field mixing for endpoint criticality with marginal flow: resolving the four-state Potts endpoint in the square-lattice $J_1$--$J_2$ Ising model
papers.abstract: Identifying the asymptotic criticality of a critical endpoint is challenging, as pseudo-first-order signatures persist over accessible system sizes and mask its underlying critical nature. This ambiguity is amplified at endpoints controlled by a marginally irrelevant scaling field, where logarithmic flow delays the onset of asymptotic scaling. Here we develop a generalized field-mixing framework for endpoint criticality governed by one relevant scaling field together with a marginally irrelevant one, a setting that lies outside the conventional two-relevant-field formulation. By constructing a finite-size pseudocritical manifold, the framework removes the normal relevant detuning and exposes the residual marginal drift, enabling controlled histogram- and Binder-based finite-size analyses. We apply this approach to the frustrated square-lattice $J_1$--$J_2$ Ising model, where the location and even the nature of the stripe-ordering endpoint have remained controversial for decades. The endpoint is isolated directly as a distinct singular point, rather than inferred from where the phase boundary appears most Potts-like, and its asymptotic criticality is shown to follow four-state Potts universality with logarithmic corrections. This identification is independently supported by direct comparison with the Potts point of the Ashkin--Teller model and by consistent Binder scaling in both the magnetic and nematic sectors. Our results resolve a longstanding numerical ambiguity in a paradigmatic frustrated Ising system and establish a general framework for extracting asymptotic endpoint criticality in the presence of marginal flow.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：field-mixing framework、finite-size analysis、scaling theory）；研究对象：受挫正方晶格 $J_1$--$J_2$ Ising 模型中的条状序临界端点，以及该端点的渐近临界行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该临界端点遵循四态 Potts 普适类并伴有对数修正，解决了该模型中关于端点位置和性质的长期争议。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该临界端点遵循四态 Potts 普适类并伴有对数修正，解决了该模型中关于端点位置和性质的长期争议。；创新点：提出了一个超越传统双相关场框架的广义场混合方法，能够从存在边缘流的体系中直接提取端点的渐近临界性，而非仅从相边界形状推断。
papers.method_zh: 发展了一种广义场混合框架，用于处理由一个相关标度场和一个边缘无关标度场共同控制的端点临界性；通过构建有限尺寸赝临界流形，结合直方图分析和 Binder 累积量有限尺寸标度分析，并与 Ashkin-Teller 模型的 Potts 点进行直接比较。

papers.title: Exact Single-Scale Outer Solution of the Abrikosov Vortex in the Extreme Type-II Limit
papers.abstract: We determine the exact outer structure of the Abrikosov vortex in the extreme type-II limit, which occurs when the Ginzburg-Landau parameter $κ$ diverges. In this limit, Ginzburg-Landau theory simplifies, outside a shrinking core, to a closed nonlinear theory for the superfluid velocity subject to an algebraic density constraint. The resulting solution is asymptotically exact everywhere outside the vanishing vortex core, demonstrating that both magnetic field and superconducting density vary on the length scale of the London penetration depth. This establishes that the conventional two-length-scale picture of the vortex does not hold in the $κ\gg 1$ limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exact outer structure、asymptotically exact、Ginzburg-Landau theory。；研究对象：极端第二类极限（Ginzburg-Landau参数κ→∞）下的Abrikosov涡旋。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在极端第二类极限下，涡旋的磁场和超导密度均以伦敦穿透深度为特征长度变化，推翻了传统认为存在两个不同特征长度（相干长度和穿透深度）的图像。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在极端第二类极限下，涡旋的磁场和超导密度均以伦敦穿透深度为特征长度变化，推翻了传统认为存在两个不同特征长度（相干长度和穿透深度）的图像。；创新点：首次给出了极端第二类极限下Abrikosov涡旋外区的精确解析解，并明确指出传统双长度尺度图像在该极限下不成立。
papers.method_zh: 基于Ginzburg-Landau理论，在涡旋核心收缩至零的极限下，将问题简化为受代数密度约束的超流速度的非线性理论，并求解出精确的外区解析解。

papers.title: Freezing of the tetrahedral amorphous network in supercooled water triggers crystallization towards LDA ice
papers.abstract: In this work, we provide mechanistic insight into the initial stages of formation of ice across the limit of stability of supercooled water. Such an analysis is particularly important since crystal nucleation is not a relevant mechanism under these conditions. Using molecular dynamics simulation with the TIP4P/2005 potential, water is cooled at a constant pressure with cooling rates of 5 to 10 K per nanosecond. As the liquid is cooled across the temperature of maximum density (T_0 = 277 K), we find that there is a continuous increase in the tetrahedrality of the system. As the cooling continues across the limit of stability of water (T_s $\approx$ 235 K), large scale thermal fluctuations dissipate while the thermal equilibration is achieved through small scale fluctuations. This phenomenon, known as the dynamical crossover [Goutam et. al. in J. Stat. Phys., 168: 1302--1318 (2017)], ends the existence of the liquid state. Subsequently, we find that the tetrahedral network drives the decrease of energy and density. This process terminates when the network undergoes `freezing' (i.e., the bonds of the network acquire sufficient rigidity), due to which the network evolution, as a whole, stops. This triggers a qualitative change in the relaxation mechanism: subsequent relaxation occurs through crystallization, i.e., an increase in the structural order. In particular, we find that the cubic and hexagonal crystalline motifs, which possess medium range order, increase rapidly across the freezing point. In the resulting LDA ice states, cubic ice is found to have a significant contribution in the overall extent of crystallization, which is consistent with the experimental findings. Overall, our work provides the specific mechanism by which crystallization (leading to LDA ice) is initiated across the limit of stability of supercooled water.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：使用分子动力学模拟（Molecular dynamics simulation）和TIP4P/2005势能模型。；研究对象：过冷水在稳定性极限附近结晶形成低密度非晶冰（LDA ice）的初始阶段机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 过冷水中四面体非晶网络的“冻结”（即键获得足够刚性）导致网络整体演化停止，从而触发结晶机制，使立方和六方晶体基元迅速增长，最终形成低密度非晶冰（LDA ice）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：过冷水中四面体非晶网络的“冻结”（即键获得足够刚性）导致网络整体演化停止，从而触发结晶机制，使立方和六方晶体基元迅速增长，最终形成低密度非晶冰（LDA ice）。；创新点：揭示了过冷水在稳定性极限附近结晶并非由经典成核机制主导，而是由四面体网络的动态交叉和随后的“冻结”过程所触发，并明确了立方冰在最终LDA冰态中的显著贡献。
papers.method_zh: 采用TIP4P/2005势能模型的分子动力学模拟，在恒定压力下以5至10 K/纳秒的冷却速率对水进行降温。

papers.title: Mutual Friction in Dissipative Gross-Pitaevskii Thermal Counterflow Turbulence
papers.abstract: We report numerical simulations of the dissipative Gross-Pitaevskii equation for a bulk region of thermal-counterflow turbulence. Quasistationary states are obtained over a range of forcing, damping, and healing-length parameters. The mutual-friction acceleration exhibits cubic scaling with the mean relative velocity between the superfluid and normal-fluid components, and the coefficient of this scaling is linked to the phenomenological damping parameter. The intervortex spacing follows the expected dimensional scaling in the weak-forcing regime. Comparison with a straight-vortex-line model suggests that the vortex-line orientations are nearly isotropic.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“numerical simulations”（数值模拟）、“dissipative Gross-Pitaevskii equation”（耗散Gross-Pitaevskii方程）。；研究对象：热逆流湍流（thermal-counterflow turbulence）中的超流氦体系，具体为耗散Gross-Pitaevskii方程描述的体区域（bulk region）量子湍流。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 互摩擦加速度与超流和正常流体之间的平均相对速度呈三次方标度关系，且该标度系数与唯象阻尼参数相关；在弱驱动区域，涡间距符合预期的维度标度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：互摩擦加速度与超流和正常流体之间的平均相对速度呈三次方标度关系，且该标度系数与唯象阻尼参数相关；在弱驱动区域，涡间距符合预期的维度标度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过数值求解耗散Gross-Pitaevskii方程，在一定的驱动、阻尼和愈合长度参数范围内获得准稳态，并与直涡线模型进行对比分析。

papers.title: Substitution modulated transition from semimetal to superconductor in ZrTe$_{2-x}$Se$_x$ with coexistence of nontrivial electronic topology
papers.abstract: This study explores the emergence of superconductivity in high-quality ZrTe$_{2-x}$Se$_x$ crystals, grown via the isothermal chemical vapor transport (ICVT) technique. Resistive, structural, and thermal measurements reveal that substituting Te with Se in the ZrTe$_2$ matrix induces a superconducting state at low temperatures. The critical temperature ($T_c$) exhibits a clear dependence on the selenium concentration, peaking at $x=0.15$ with a $T_c$ of $4.8$ K. Calorimetric data indicates that even a low Se substitution range is capable of modifying both the electronic contribution and the vibrational modes of the crystal lattice. Combined with ab initio calculations and Wannier Hamiltonian interpolation between ZrTe$_2$/ZrSe$_2$, we established an extensive phase diagram mapping the transition from charge density wave (CDW) to the state with coexistence between the Dirac semimetal and superconductivity (SC), up to the semiconductor phase. This coexistence suggests that ZrTe$_{1.85}$Se$_{0.15}$ could be a candidate platform for topological superconductivity, as it hosts a nontrivial $\mathbb Z_2$ invariant, with nonvanishing surface states in its $(001)$ planes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以计算）。判断依据：关键词“grown via the isothermal chemical vapor transport (ICVT) technique”、“Resistive, structural, and thermal measurements”、“Calorimetric data”，以及“Combined with ab initio calculations”。；研究对象：ZrTe₂₋ₓSeₓ单晶体系，具体研究通过Se替代Te诱导从半金属到超导体的相变，以及非平庸电子拓扑态与超导性的共存。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在ZrTe₂中掺入Se可诱导出超导电性，在x=0.15时超导临界温度最高达4.8 K；该体系在狄拉克半金属与超导共存区域具有非平庸的Z₂拓扑不变量，表明ZrTe₁.₈₅Se₀.₁₅可能是拓扑超导的候选平台。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在ZrTe₂中掺入Se可诱导出超导电性，在x=0.15时超导临界温度最高达4.8 K；该体系在狄拉克半金属与超导共存区域具有非平庸的Z₂拓扑不变量，表明ZrTe₁.₈₅Se₀.₁₅可能是拓扑超导的候选平台。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用等温化学气相输运（ICVT）技术生长高质量单晶；使用电阻、结构和热测量（如量热法）表征超导转变和晶格振动；结合第一性原理计算和Wannier哈密顿量插值（在ZrTe₂/ZrSe₂之间）建立相图。

papers.title: Benchmarking Transparent Conductors
papers.abstract: Transparent conducting oxides (TCOs) are central to optoelectronic technologies, yet their design is often guided by popular figures of merit that are disconnected from the electrical requirement of actual devices. As a result, widely used metrics guide material design under conditions that can be impractical for devices. Here, we introduce a benchmarking framework to guide TCO development, in which transparent conductors are evaluated at fixed, application-relevant sheet resistance $(R_S)$. The resulting metric, $T_{app}(R_S)$, anchors comparison to device requirements, asking instead: What optical transparency can be obtained at the sheet resistance required by a given application? This approach provides a directly interpretable measure of performance, enabling materials to be benchmarked in terms of absolute transparency gains at a specified $R_S$. Applied to representative conventional and emerging TCOs, the framework defines the sheet-resistance landscape relevant to each application and maps how different materials perform within it. In doing so, it provides an application-rooted guide to material development and selection. More broadly, this approach establishes a general strategy for evaluating materials under fixed operational constraints, bridging the gap between materials design and device integration.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/分析文章。判断依据：摘要中提出了一种新的评估框架（benchmarking framework）和性能指标（metric），属于理论建模与性能分析，未提及具体实验或计算模拟手段。；研究对象：透明导电氧化物（TCOs）及其在光电器件中的应用性能评估。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 传统透明导电材料的品质因数（figures of merit）与器件实际电学需求脱节，而基于固定应用相关方阻（\(R_S\)）的评估框架 \(T_{app}(R_S)\) 能更直接地衡量材料在特定应用中的光学透明度，从而为材料开发与选择提供以应用为导向的指导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：传统透明导电材料的品质因数（figures of merit）与器件实际电学需求脱节，而基于固定应用相关方阻（\(R_S\)）的评估框架 \(T_{app}(R_S)\) 能更直接地衡量材料在特定应用中的光学透明度，从而为材料开发与选择提供以应用为导向的指导。；创新点：将材料性能评估从通用的品质因数转向以具体器件电学需求（固定方阻）为锚点的比较，建立了材料设计与器件集成之间的直接桥梁。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 提出了一个以固定方阻（\(R_S\)）为约束条件的基准测试框架，定义新指标 \(T_{app}(R_S)\)，即“在给定应用所需方阻下可获得的光学透明度”，并应用于代表性传统与新兴TCOs，绘制不同应用场景下的方阻-性能图谱。

papers.title: Superconductivity and electronic structure evolution in the enforced semimetal Fe-doped ZrTe$_2$
papers.abstract: ZrTe$_2$ is an outstanding layered semimetal due to the topologically nontrivial electronic structure. In this work, we present an investigation of the electronic evolution of ZrTe$_2$ in the presence of Fe intercalation, namely Fe$_{x}$ZrTe$_2$ ($x= 0 - 0.25$), scrutinized by both experimental measurements and \textit{ab} initio calculations. While the first reveals a superconducting state with a maximum critical temperature $T_c = 2.74$ K ($x=$ 0.03), the latter indicates that the topological features of the pristine ZrTe$_2$ is sensitive to the distance between Te atoms and Zr layers. Also, the intercalation of Fe does not modify the non-trivial electronic band structure unlike the band crossings are now shifted slightly below $E_{F}$. In particular, a van Hove singularity near the Fermi level for a Fe content of $x=0.125$ is observed in the density of states, indicating that the superconducting order may be associated with features of the unfolded band structure and the concomitant enhancement of the density of states at $E_F$. Finally, our results reveal that the new compound with inclusion of Fe intercalation preserves the enforced semimetal classification.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“experimental measurements”和“ab initio calculations”。；研究对象：Fe插层的ZrTe₂体系（FeₓZrTe₂，x=0-0.25），研究其超导电性及电子结构演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Fe插层ZrTe₂中观测到超导态，最高临界温度Tc=2.74 K（x=0.03）；Fe插层不改变拓扑非平庸电子结构，但使能带交叉点略微下移，并在x=0.125时在费米面附近出现van Hove奇异点，表明超导序可能与态密度增强有关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Fe插层ZrTe₂中观测到超导态，最高临界温度Tc=2.74 K（x=0.03）；Fe插层不改变拓扑非平庸电子结构，但使能带交叉点略微下移，并在x=0.125时在费米面附近出现van Hove奇异点，表明超导序可能与态密度增强有关。；创新点：揭示了Fe插层ZrTe₂中超导电性的出现与van Hove奇异点及态密度增强的关联，并确认该体系仍保持“强制半金属”（enforced semimetal）分类。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 实验测量（具体手段摘要未明确说明）和基于第一性原理（ab initio）的电子结构计算。

papers.title: Scaling features for the stress fluctuations in the OFC model
papers.abstract: We consider the Olami-Feder-Christensen (OFC) model on a square two-dimensional lattice with open boundary conditions. The model exhibits self-organized criticality and explains the Gutenberg-Richter law observed for earthquakes. A parameter $α$ controls the level of local dissipation: $α< 0.25$ corresponds to locally dissipative and $α= 0.25$ marks locally conservative dynamics. The avalanche size distribution follows a decaying power-law, with a non-universal critical exponent. Here, we examine the probability distribution of the difference between avalanche size and area. This quantity remains unexplored despite being of significant interest in earthquakes. We find a power-law with a scaling exponent close to one in the conservative OFC model. The scaling feature vanishes even for the physically relevant case $α= 0.21$. To examine the robustness of such features, we also examine the same quantity in the BTW and Manna sandpile models on a square lattice. We find that the power-law behavior survives for these systems due to locally conservative dynamics. We further examine the local and total stress fluctuations in the OFC model for both locally conservative and dissipative dynamics. The finite-size scaling analysis of the power spectra for the stress fluctuations reveals qualitatively the same but quantitatively significantly different behavior. The dynamic exponent describing the divergence of the correlation time with system size changes from nearly ballistic in the conservative to diffusive behavior in the locally dissipative dynamics with $α= 0.21$. The local stress also exhibits a signature of nearly canonical $1/f$ noise in the intermediate regime, and $1/f^2$-type scaling dominates the high-frequency regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词“consider the OFC model”、“examine the probability distribution”、“finite-size scaling analysis”。；研究对象：Olami-Feder-Christensen (OFC) 模型（一种自组织临界性模型），以及用于对比的BTW和Manna沙堆模型。具体物理现象为地震中的应力涨落及其标度特征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在保守型OFC模型中，地震事件（雪崩）大小与面积之差的概率分布呈现幂律行为，标度指数接近1；但在物理相关的耗散情形（α=0.21）下，该标度特征消失。此外，应力涨落的功率谱在保守与耗散动力学下表现出定性相似但定量显著不同的行为，其中动力学指数从近弹道行为（保守）变为扩散行为（耗散，α=0.21）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在保守型OFC模型中，地震事件（雪崩）大小与面积之差的概率分布呈现幂律行为，标度指数接近1；但在物理相关的耗散情形（α=0.21）下，该标度特征消失。此外，应力涨落的功率谱在保守与耗散动力学下表现出定性相似但定量显著不同的行为，其中动力学指数从近弹道行为（保守）变为扩散行为（耗散，α=0.21）。；创新点：首次研究了地震事件中雪崩大小与面积之差这一此前未被探索的物理量，并揭示了其在保守型OFC模型中的标度行为及其在耗散情形下的消失。同时，通过功率谱分析系统比较了保守与耗散动力学下应力涨落的标度行为差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用数值模拟方法，在二维正方晶格上对OFC模型（开放边界条件）进行模拟，并对比BTW和Manna沙堆模型。通过分析雪崩大小与面积之差的概率分布、局部与总应力涨落的功率谱，并进行有限尺寸标度分析来提取动力学指数。

papers.title: Cluster moves with an entropic reservoir accelerate low-temperature simulations of three-dimensional spin glasses
papers.abstract: We present an algorithm for the simulation of three-dimensional spin glasses deep in the low-temperature phase: Parallel Tempering enhanced with Houdayer moves and with an entropic reservoir (PTHR). Although differences with the standard Houdayer algorithm are small, PTHR allows us to equilibrate a large number of samples of $L=16$ lattices with Gaussian couplings for temperatures $T\geq 0.2$. We show that the computational complexity displays better size scaling than standard Parallel Tempering. For finite sizes, our method outperforms other cluster algorithms by a speedup factor of around 64. In close analogy with standard Parallel Tempering, PTHR's computational complexity strongly relates to temperature chaos.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：algorithm, simulation, computational complexity。；研究对象：三维自旋玻璃（three-dimensional spin glasses）在低温相中的模拟。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种结合并行回火、Houdayer移动和熵库的算法（PTHR），能够在低温（T≥0.2）下有效平衡大量L=16格点的高斯耦合样本，且计算复杂度的尺寸标度优于标准并行回火，有限尺寸下速度提升约64倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种结合并行回火、Houdayer移动和熵库的算法（PTHR），能够在低温（T≥0.2）下有效平衡大量L=16格点的高斯耦合样本，且计算复杂度的尺寸标度优于标准并行回火，有限尺寸下速度提升约64倍。；创新点：通过引入熵库对标准Houdayer算法进行微小改进，显著提升了低温模拟的平衡能力和计算效率，并揭示了PTHR的计算复杂度与温度混沌（temperature chaos）的强关联。
papers.method_zh: 算法开发与数值模拟：并行回火（Parallel Tempering）增强Houdayer移动（Houdayer moves）和熵库（entropic reservoir），用于模拟三维自旋玻璃。

papers.title: Hybridization of Ferromagnetic and Cyclotron Resonances in a Two-Dimensional Electron System on a Ferromagnetic Film
papers.abstract: The microwave response of a two-dimensional (2D) electron system located on a dielectric ferromagnetic film, which in turn lies on a conducting metal (gate), has been theoretically studied. The entire system has been placed in the perpendicular static magnetic field. It has been found that the ferromagnetic resonance of the film and the cyclotron resonance of the electrons of the 2D system interact in the magnetic field, leading to their repulsion ('anticrossing'). It has been revealed that the anticrossing region is characterized not only by the modification of resonance frequencies compared to the cyclotron resonance in the 2D system without the ferromagnetic substrate and the ferromagnetic resonance in the film without the 2D system, but also by a strong change in the resonance linewidths.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theoretically studied。；研究对象：位于介电铁磁薄膜上的二维电子系统，整个体系置于垂直静磁场中，且铁磁薄膜下方有导电金属（栅极）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 铁磁薄膜的铁磁共振与二维电子系统的回旋共振在磁场中发生相互作用，导致共振频率相互排斥（“反交叉”），并且反交叉区域不仅共振频率发生显著改变，共振线宽也发生强烈变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：铁磁薄膜的铁磁共振与二维电子系统的回旋共振在磁场中发生相互作用，导致共振频率相互排斥（“反交叉”），并且反交叉区域不仅共振频率发生显著改变，共振线宽也发生强烈变化。；创新点：揭示了铁磁薄膜与二维电子系统之间共振耦合导致的频率排斥和线宽变化，摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，具体框架摘要未明确说明（如是否采用线性响应理论、麦克斯韦方程耦合求解等）。

papers.title: Dealloying by peritectic melting
papers.abstract: Peritectic melting of Ti--Ag has been shown experimentally to form bicontinuous structures, but the mechanism remains unclear. Here we use phase-field simulations to show that these structures arise from a morphological instability of liquid film migration in three dimensions: a Ti-rich solid growing through an Ag-rich liquid film develops a branched seaweed or dendritic structure whose side branches coalesce to form handles, generating a high-genus bicontinuous topology. A sharp-interface theory predicts a solidification-front velocity and an initial ligament width that are constant in time, in contrast to liquid metal dealloying; subsequent $t^{1/3}$ coarsening reproduces the experimentally observed final ligament width.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。判断依据：使用了“phase-field simulations”（相场模拟）和“sharp-interface theory”（尖锐界面理论），并结合了实验观察（“shown experimentally”）。；研究对象：Ti-Ag合金在包晶熔化（peritectic melting）过程中形成的双连续结构（bicontinuous structures）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 包晶熔化形成的双连续结构源于液膜迁移（liquid film migration）在三维空间中的形态不稳定性：富Ti固相在富Ag液相中生长时形成分支状海藻或枝晶结构，其侧枝合并形成手柄状拓扑，最终产生高亏格的双连续结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：包晶熔化形成的双连续结构源于液膜迁移（liquid film migration）在三维空间中的形态不稳定性：富Ti固相在富Ag液相中生长时形成分支状海藻或枝晶结构，其侧枝合并形成手柄状拓扑，最终产生高亏格的双连续结构。；创新点：首次通过相场模拟揭示了包晶熔化形成双连续结构的具体动力学机制（液膜迁移的三维形态不稳定性），并指出其与液态金属脱合金（liquid metal dealloying）的关键区别在于凝固前沿速度和初始韧带宽度不随时间变化，后续以t^{1/3}的粗化规律演化。
papers.method_zh: 相场模拟（phase-field simulations）用于揭示三维液膜迁移的形态不稳定性机制；尖锐界面理论（sharp-interface theory）用于预测凝固前沿速度和初始韧带宽度。

papers.title: Equivalent-neighbor $k$-core percolation in two dimensions
papers.abstract: We perform large-scale numerical simulations to investigate the critical behavior of $k$-core percolation in two dimensions with an extended interaction range $r$. By systematically varying both the core index $k$ and the interaction range $r$, we construct a comprehensive phase diagram in the $(k,r)$ plane. In contrast to $k$-core percolation in infinite dimensions, no hybrid transition is observed in two dimensions: the phase diagram contains only a continuous transition regime and a strictly first-order regime, separated by a tricritical or critical-end point $(k_s,r_s)$. For $k<k_s$ and $r<r_s$, the transition is continuous and belongs to the universality class of standard two-dimensional (2D) percolation. For $k>k_s$ and finite $r>r_s$, the transition is discontinuous, with no hybrid features or critical singularities. In this first-order regime, the pseudocritical point approaches the critical point as $1/\ln L$, where $L$ is the linear system size, distinct from the $L^{-d}$ scaling typical of conventional thermodynamic first-order transitions in $d$ dimensions. This logarithmic finite-size drift is consistent with a nucleation-driven mechanism, in which rare voids trigger the collapse of the finite-range $k$-core. These results demonstrate that geometric constraints can fundamentally alter the nature of $k$-core percolation found in finite dimensions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：large-scale numerical simulations、critical behavior、phase diagram、finite-size scaling。；研究对象：二维空间中具有扩展相互作用范围 \( r \) 的 \( k \)-core 逾渗（\( k \)-core percolation）的临界行为与相图。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维 \( k \)-core 逾渗中，不存在无限维中的混合型相变，相图仅包含连续相变区和严格一级相变区，两者由三临界点或临界端点分隔；在一级相变区，赝临界点随系统尺寸 \( L \) 以 \( 1/\ln L \) 的标度漂移，而非传统热力学一级相变的 \( L^{-d} \) 标度，表明其由稀有空穴触发的成核机制驱动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维 \( k \)-core 逾渗中，不存在无限维中的混合型相变，相图仅包含连续相变区和严格一级相变区，两者由三临界点或临界端点分隔；在一级相变区，赝临界点随系统尺寸 \( L \) 以 \( 1/\ln L \) 的标度漂移，而非传统热力学一级相变的 \( L^{-d} \) 标度，表明其由稀有空穴触发的成核机制驱动。；创新点：揭示了在有限维度下，几何约束（二维空间）如何根本性地改变 \( k \)-core 逾渗的相变性质，特别是发现了一级相变区中独特的对数有限尺寸漂移行为，这与传统热力学一级相变的幂律标度不同，并归因于成核驱动机制。摘要未突出说明与已有二维逾渗研究的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 大规模数值模拟，通过系统改变核心指数 \( k \) 和相互作用范围 \( r \)，构建 \( (k, r) \) 平面上的完整相图，并分析有限尺寸标度行为。

papers.title: Topological fragility and bilinear magnetoelectric resistance in gapless edge states
papers.abstract: In time-reversal symmetric systems such as topological and higher-order topological insulators, 1D spin-momentum locked edge and hinge states are theoretically ``perfectly conducting'', being immune to backscattering by non-magnetic disorder. Here, we reveal a fundamental ``topological fragility'': these states exhibit a bilinear magnetoelectric resistance significantly larger than in 2D systems. This effect requires two ingredients: (i) spin-momentum locking, which maximizes time-reversal symmetry breaking in the non-linear regime, and (ii) random spin-orbit interaction -- the same mechanism behind Elliott - Yafet spin relaxation in heavy elements. Together, these generate a robust backscattering channel when a modest external magnetic field is applied. Our theory requires no gap opening or complex many-body effects, offering a simple and general mechanism that quantitatively explains recent observations in Bismuth hinge states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“theory”、“mechanism”、“requires no gap opening or complex many-body effects”，且未提及实验或计算手段。；研究对象：拓扑绝缘体及高阶拓扑绝缘体中的一维自旋-动量锁定边缘态和铰链态（如铋（Bismuth）铰链态）中的输运现象，具体为双线性磁电电阻效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了拓扑边缘态和铰链态存在一种“拓扑脆弱性”：在施加微弱外磁场时，由于自旋-动量锁定与随机自旋-轨道相互作用的共同作用，这些原本被认为对非磁性无序背散射免疫的态会产生显著增强的双线性磁电电阻，其幅度远大于二维系统。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了拓扑边缘态和铰链态存在一种“拓扑脆弱性”：在施加微弱外磁场时，由于自旋-动量锁定与随机自旋-轨道相互作用的共同作用，这些原本被认为对非磁性无序背散射免疫的态会产生显著增强的双线性磁电电阻，其幅度远大于二维系统。；创新点：提出了一个无需能隙打开或复杂多体效应的简单且普适的机制，定量解释了近期在铋铰链态中观测到的实验现象，揭示了拓扑边缘态在磁场下的“脆弱性”而非理想导电性。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。基于时间反演对称性破缺的非线性效应（自旋-动量锁定）以及Elliott-Yafet自旋弛豫机制（随机自旋-轨道相互作用）构建了产生背散射通道的物理机制。

papers.title: Collective deformation of anisotropic particles with internal pulsation
papers.abstract: Capturing the emergence of deformation waves in contractile living tissues is a challenge that has recently been tackled with models of actively deformable particles. Inspired by the anisotropic deformation of cardiomyocytes in cardiac tissues, we examine how the pulsation of elliptical particles affects their collective properties in dense assemblies. We introduce two types of deformation where the eccentricity of each particle is subject to a periodic drive, and examine the interplay between nematic order and synchronized deformation via a systematic phase diagram. We derive a hydrodynamic description through a coarse-graining procedure, and show that it qualitatively captures the main collective states of the microscopic dynamics. Overall, our model provides key insights into how an active anisotropic deformation yields waves that self-organize into various dynamical patterns.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提到了“通过粗粒化过程推导出流体力学描述”，并研究了“微观动力学的集体状态”，属于理论建模与数值模拟的混合类型。；研究对象：具有内部脉动的各向异性（椭圆形）粒子的集体变形行为。具体体系受心肌细胞各向异性变形的启发，研究密集堆积下椭圆粒子的脉动如何影响其集体性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 主动的各向异性变形可以产生自组织成各种动态模式的变形波。通过系统相图揭示了向列序与同步变形之间的相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：主动的各向异性变形可以产生自组织成各种动态模式的变形波。通过系统相图揭示了向列序与同步变形之间的相互作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新在于：将心肌细胞各向异性变形的生物学启发引入主动粒子模型，并系统研究了椭圆粒子脉动与向列序之间的耦合如何导致集体变形波的自组织。
papers.method_zh: 采用主动变形粒子模型，对每个粒子的偏心率施加周期性驱动力（两种变形类型）。通过粗粒化（coarse-graining）过程推导出流体力学描述，并与微观动力学模拟结果进行定性比较。

papers.title: Spectral properties of non-Hermitian real random matrices with long-range correlations
papers.abstract: We investigate the spectral properties of non-Hermitian real random matrices whose entries exhibit long-range correlations decaying as~$|r-r'|^{-α}$. We find a progressive breakdown of the circular law, controlled by the decrease of~$α$. In all cases, the radial eigenvalue density decreases away from the origin. At~$α>1$, an effective radius, reminiscent of the circular law, is retrieved, while instead, for~$α<1$, the eigenvalue distribution broadens with matrix size and its spectral radius grows like a power law, with exponents numerically close to the exponents controlling the magnitude of fluctuations in the extended central limit theorem. The case~$α=1$ appears as a case with self-similar eigenvalue density, and slowly growing spectral radius. Long-range correlations also enhance clustering of real eigenvalues and slow the resorption of the Saturn effect. These results reveal a correlation-driven transition and suggest the emergence of a new universality class for correlated non-Hermitian random matrices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“investigate”“find”“suggest”等理论分析常用词，未提及实验或计算模拟细节，主要基于数学分析和数值观察（如“numerically close”）。；研究对象：非厄米实随机矩阵，其矩阵元具有长程相关性，衰减形式为 |r - r'|^{-α}。研究的是该矩阵的谱性质（特征值分布、谱半径等）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 长程相关性破坏了非厄米随机矩阵的“圆律”（circular law），并导致一个由相关性指数 α 控制的相变：当 α > 1 时，谱分布仍具有有效半径；当 α < 1 时，谱分布随矩阵尺寸展宽，谱半径呈幂律增长；α = 1 时，谱密度具有自相似性。此外，长程相关性增强了实特征值的聚集并减缓了“土星效应”的消失。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：长程相关性破坏了非厄米随机矩阵的“圆律”（circular law），并导致一个由相关性指数 α 控制的相变：当 α > 1 时，谱分布仍具有有效半径；当 α < 1 时，谱分布随矩阵尺寸展宽，谱半径呈幂律增长；α = 1 时，谱密度具有自相似性。此外，长程相关性增强了实特征值的聚集并减缓了“土星效应”的消失。；创新点：揭示了长程相关性驱动的非厄米随机矩阵谱性质从圆律到新标度行为的转变，暗示存在一个由相关性控制的新普适类。摘要未突出说明与之前具体模型或理论的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析结合数值计算。具体而言，通过解析推导和数值模拟研究不同 α 值下特征值径向密度、谱半径的标度行为，并与扩展中心极限定理中的涨落指数进行数值比较。

papers.title: The Remodeling of Fiber Distributions in Biological Tissues: Rotation without Rotation
papers.abstract: Collagen remodeling in living tissues exhibits anisotropic orientation patterns commonly described by Von Mises distributions, yet the physical origin of such nonequilibrium organization remains unresolved. In the present work, we demonstrate analytically that the combined action of Malthusian growth dynamics and the introduction of linear relations governing mechanical remodeling naturally gives rise to generalized bimodal Von Mises distributions as emergent states of living matter. The theory reveals a {\it rotation without rotation} mechanism, in which fibers progressively reorient in the absence of angular mechanical coupling via selective deposition and removal along preferred directions. The resulting analytical solutions quantitatively reproduce experimentally observed distributions and establish a direct mechanobiological origin for directional statistics in biological tissues. By interpreting the evolving normalized fiber density as a probability distribution function, we formulate a dynamical Shannon entropy framework that captures the temporal emergence of microstructural organization. The theory further yields closed-form expressions for the drift of the associated Fokker--Planck equation, enabling the corresponding stochastic differential equation to be derived, thus revealing that tissue remodeling is the collective outcome of noisy single-fiber dynamics. These results establish a minimal theoretical framework that connects biomechanics, stochastic processes, and nonequilibrium statistical organization in living matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：demonstrate analytically、theory reveals、analytical solutions、formulate a dynamical Shannon entropy framework、closed-form expressions。；研究对象：生物组织中胶原纤维的重新定向与分布重塑现象，具体研究纤维在无角向机械耦合条件下通过选择性沉积与移除实现取向重排的非平衡组织过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一种“无旋转的旋转”机制：纤维在缺乏角向机械耦合的情况下，通过马尔萨斯增长动力学与线性机械重塑关系的联合作用，自发演化为广义双峰冯·米塞斯分布，定量复现了实验观测的纤维取向模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一种“无旋转的旋转”机制：纤维在缺乏角向机械耦合的情况下，通过马尔萨斯增长动力学与线性机械重塑关系的联合作用，自发演化为广义双峰冯·米塞斯分布，定量复现了实验观测的纤维取向模式。；创新点：首次从解析层面将马尔萨斯增长与线性机械重塑结合，直接导出广义双峰冯·米塞斯分布作为活体组织的涌现态，并建立了方向统计学的直接力学生物学起源；揭示了“无旋转的旋转”这一反直觉的纤维重定向机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用解析理论推导，结合马尔萨斯增长动力学、线性机械重塑关系，构建了纤维密度演化的动力学方程；引入香农熵框架描述微观结构的时间涌现；推导出对应的福克-普朗克方程漂移项，并得到随机微分方程。

papers.title: kikuchipy: an open-source toolbox for analysis of EBSD patterns
papers.abstract: We present kikuchipy, an open-source toolbox for analysis of electron backscatter diffraction patterns, written in Python. The software is capable of both Hough and dictionary indexing and orientation and/or projection center refinement of patterns stored in file formats from all major vendors. Indexing results can be validated using maps independent of indexing and by visually comparing experimental and simulated patterns. By leveraging scientific packages in the Python ecosystem, emphasis is put on making the indexing workflow flexible and improve results through fast iteration. The software's capabilities are demonstrated on three application examples: analysis of orientation relationships in a super duplex stainless steel, phase differentiation of aluminium and silicon in a cast modified Al-Si alloy, and phase differentiation of particles in an Al-Mn alloy as Al6Mn or alpha-AlMnSi. The diffraction patterns and analysis workflows are made publicly available. kikuchipy was created and is developed as a resource for the electron microscopy community, allowing anyone to improve the software or include it into their own analysis workflows or softwares.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/软件工具文章。判断依据关键词：open-source toolbox、analysis、Python、indexing。；研究对象：电子背散射衍射（EBSD）图谱的分析方法，具体应用于超双相不锈钢、改性Al-Si合金和Al-Mn合金等材料体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开发了一个名为kikuchipy的开源Python工具箱，能够实现EBSD图谱的Hough索引和字典索引，以及取向/投影中心精修，并通过快速迭代提高索引工作流的灵活性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开发了一个名为kikuchipy的开源Python工具箱，能够实现EBSD图谱的Hough索引和字典索引，以及取向/投影中心精修，并通过快速迭代提高索引工作流的灵活性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于Python科学计算生态，采用Hough变换索引和字典索引两种方法，支持所有主要厂商的文件格式，并通过独立于索引的验证图以及实验与模拟图谱的视觉对比来验证索引结果。

papers.title: Alignment-free ultra-broadband parametric frequency conversion in lead-halide perovskites
papers.abstract: Lead-halide perovskites were demonstrated to exhibit some of the largest known optical nonlinearities, yet their potential for frequency conversion remains largely untapped. Here we demonstrate ultra-broadband four-wave mixing of near- and mid-infrared femtosecond pulses in thick single-crystal LHPs, generating bright, coherent, and highly collimated emission across an exceptionally wide continuous tuning range without phase-matching engineering, angular alignment, or dispersion optimization. Time resolved measurements reveal that the emission originates near the crystal surfaces, where phase-matching constraints are relaxed, while the unusually large intrinsic $χ^{(3)}$ response preserves efficient and directional frequency conversion despite the strongly localized interaction volume. These results position LHPs as a powerful bulk platform for ultra-broadband nonlinear photonics, opening a pathway toward compact, alignment-free architectures for ultrafast frequency conversion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验演示（“demonstrate”）、时间分辨测量（“Time resolved measurements”）以及产生的具体物理现象（“generating bright, coherent, and highly collimated emission”）。；研究对象：铅卤化物钙钛矿（Lead-halide perovskites, LHPs）单晶中的超宽带参量频率转换现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无需相位匹配工程、角度对准或色散优化的条件下，利用铅卤化物钙钛矿单晶实现了近红外到中红外飞秒脉冲的超宽带四波混频，产生了连续可调的明亮、相干、准直发射。该发射源于晶体表面附近，此处相位匹配约束被放宽，而材料巨大的本征三阶非线性（χ(3)）响应保证了在高度局域化相互作用体积下的高效定向频率转换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无需相位匹配工程、角度对准或色散优化的条件下，利用铅卤化物钙钛矿单晶实现了近红外到中红外飞秒脉冲的超宽带四波混频，产生了连续可调的明亮、相干、准直发射。该发射源于晶体表面附近，此处相位匹配约束被放宽，而材料巨大的本征三阶非线性（χ(3)）响应保证了在高度局域化相互作用体积下的高效定向频率转换。；创新点：首次展示了铅卤化物钙钛矿作为一种无需对准（alignment-free）的块体平台，能够实现超宽带参量频率转换，绕过了传统非线性光学中复杂的相位匹配工程和色散优化需求。
papers.method_zh: 实验上，使用近红外和中红外飞秒脉冲在厚单晶铅卤化物钙钛矿中进行四波混频实验，并通过时间分辨测量来探究发射的起源位置。

papers.title: Chain conformations in adsorbed layer during polymer capillary imbibition
papers.abstract: We conducted molecular dynamics simulations to investigate chain conformations in adsorbed layers during polymer capillary imbibition. While the imbibition length adheres to the classical Lucas-Washburn equation, a notable deviation in mobile bead density emerges under strong confinement, consistent with \emph{in situ} dielectric spectroscopy experiments. The proportion of loop structures within adsorbed layers progressively increases during capillary infiltration, attributed to the relaxation of initially stretched chains toward equilibrium configurations. Furthermore, systematic analysis revealed that chain relaxation dynamics exhibit length-dependent retardation, especially under high confinement. The characteristic desorption time demonstrates chain-length dependence in quantitative agreement with scaling predictions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“molecular dynamics simulations”（分子动力学模拟）。；研究对象：聚合物毛细管浸润过程中吸附层内的链构象（chain conformations）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在聚合物毛细管浸润过程中，吸附层内的环状结构（loop structures）比例逐渐增加，这是由于初始拉伸的链向平衡构象松弛所致；链松弛动力学表现出长度依赖的延迟效应，尤其在强受限条件下，且特征解吸时间与标度预测定量一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在聚合物毛细管浸润过程中，吸附层内的环状结构（loop structures）比例逐渐增加，这是由于初始拉伸的链向平衡构象松弛所致；链松弛动力学表现出长度依赖的延迟效应，尤其在强受限条件下，且特征解吸时间与标度预测定量一致。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学模拟（molecular dynamics simulations），并结合与原位介电谱实验（in situ dielectric spectroscopy experiments）的对比。

papers.title: Near-Room-Temperature Antiferromagnetic Ordering in the Quadruple Perovskite Sr4NaRu3O12
papers.abstract: We report the synthesis, structure and magnetic properties of two 1:3 ordered quadruple perovskites Sr4MRu3O12 (M = Li and Na). Sr4NaRu3O12 crystallizes in the centrosymmetric space group R-3 and Sr4LiRu3O12 appears to be isostructural to the Na compound based on the PXRD data. In Sr4NaRu3O12, both Na and Ru are predominantly ordered at the B sites (here Na/Li and Ru) and the structure contains only corner-connected RuO6 and NaO6 octahedra. This atomic ordering also leads to a rather large unit cell with a = 11.25 Å and c = 27.6 Å compared to the basic 12R structure (a = 5.5 Å and c ~ 27 Å). Magnetic measurements reveal that Sr4NaRu3O12 undergoes a magnetic transition to an antiferromagnetic state below TN ~ 265 K which is confirmed by DSC and neutron diffraction. The Ru moments show a collinear antiferromagnetic spin alignment along the hexagonal c axis with a propagation vector k = (0, 0, 1.5). Interestingly, those Ru moments lying on the three-fold roto-inversion do not significantly contribute to the magnetic order, since they are located between antiferromagnetically coupled Ru atoms and are therefore probably highly frustrated. Band structure calculations on Sr4NaRu3O12 complement the observed magnetic ground state and a semiconducting behavior in the compound. Sr4LiRu3O12 shows a magnetic anomaly below 110 K, possibly associated with competing ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic interactions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（含计算补充）。判断依据：关键词包括 synthesis, structure, magnetic measurements, neutron diffraction, DSC，以及 band structure calculations 作为补充。；研究对象：两种1:3有序四重钙钛矿 Sr4MRu3O12（M = Li 和 Na），重点研究 Sr4NaRu3O12 的晶体结构、磁有序及电子性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Sr4NaRu3O12 在约265 K 发生反铁磁相变，Ru 离子沿六方 c 轴形成共线反铁磁排列，传播矢量为 k = (0, 0, 1.5)；位于三重反演轴上的 Ru 离子因高度阻挫而对磁有序贡献微弱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Sr4NaRu3O12 在约265 K 发生反铁磁相变，Ru 离子沿六方 c 轴形成共线反铁磁排列，传播矢量为 k = (0, 0, 1.5)；位于三重反演轴上的 Ru 离子因高度阻挫而对磁有序贡献微弱。；创新点：首次报道了 Sr4NaRu3O12 在近室温（~265 K）下的反铁磁有序，并揭示了其独特的磁结构——部分 Ru 离子因几何阻挫不参与长程磁有序。摘要未突出说明与已有四重钙钛矿磁性的对比。
papers.method_zh: 粉末 X 射线衍射（PXRD）确定晶体结构；磁化率测量、差示扫描量热法（DSC）和中子衍射确定磁相变温度与磁结构；能带结构计算（band structure calculations）辅助解释磁基态和半导体行为。

papers.title: Analysis of Critical Points in a Permutation Model on Hierarchical Lattices by Real-Space Renormalization Group
papers.abstract: The permutation model is a classical spin system where elements of the symmetric group interact with one another. The partition function of this model is directly related to the entanglement structure of random quantum circuits and random tensor networks. In these contexts, the entanglement entropy undergoes a transition between area-law and volume-law scaling, depending on the model parameters. This transition point has attracted considerable attention. In the present work, we investigate the ferromagnetic-paramagnetic phase transition of the permutation model, which corresponds to the entanglement entropy transition. Using exact real-space renormalization group calculations on self-dual hierarchical lattices, we numerically determine finite-replica critical points for (q=mn=2,...,6). We compare the results with the duality prediction based on the Fourier transform of the symmetric group and then extrapolate the b=3 data toward the replica limit $mn\to0$, where the effective dimension is two. The comparison supports the duality-based estimate while also clarifying the systematic uncertainty associated with the extrapolation formula.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：real-space renormalization group、duality prediction、extrapolation。；研究对象：排列模型（permutation model）在自对偶层级晶格上的铁磁-顺磁相变，该相变对应于随机量子电路和随机张量网络中的纠缠熵面积律-体积律转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过实空间重整化群计算，确定了有限副本数（q=mn=2,...,6）下的临界点，并将b=3的数据外推至副本极限（mn→0，有效维度为二维），结果支持基于对偶性的估计，同时揭示了外推公式带来的系统不确定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过实空间重整化群计算，确定了有限副本数（q=mn=2,...,6）下的临界点，并将b=3的数据外推至副本极限（mn→0，有效维度为二维），结果支持基于对偶性的估计，同时揭示了外推公式带来的系统不确定性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用精确实空间重整化群（real-space renormalization group）计算，在自对偶层级晶格上数值确定临界点；利用对称群傅里叶变换的对偶性预测进行比较；并对b=3的数据进行外推至副本极限。

papers.title: The evolution of pairing correlation with $3d_{z^{2}}$ electron filling in a bilayer two-orbital model for La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$
papers.abstract: The discovery of high-${T_c}$ superconductivity in pressurized bilayer nickelate La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ presents a new arena for exploring unconventional pairing mechanisms. A pivotal yet unresolved issue is the specific role of the $3d_{z^{2}}$ orbital of Ni. While its inter-layer super-exchange antiferromagnetic coupling is widely considered crucial for superconductivity, the role of its itinerancy remains undetermined. Early studies showed that the superconductivity is accompanied by the emergence of a small Fermi pocket of the $3d_{z^{2}}$ orbitals. However, recent experiments show controversial results on the role of the $3d_{z^{2}}$ Fermi pocket on superconductivity. Motivated by these experimental results, we investigate an effective bilayer two-orbital model for La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ using density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) on a minimal one-dimensional geometry. By systematically varying the $3d_{z^{2}}$ orbital filling from $1/12$ doping to half-filling, we observe a pronounced suppression of superconducting correlations near half-filling. Our results demonstrate the itinerancy of $3d_{z^{2}}$ orbital is favorable for the pairing in the bilayer two-orbital model for La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$. Moreover, we observe that the pairing correlation is enhanced in regions where charge fluctuations are large, suggesting a competition between charge order and superconductivity in the model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG)、模型计算。；研究对象：加压双层镍氧化物 La₃Ni₂O₇ 中的超导配对机制，具体聚焦于 Ni 的 3d_{z²} 轨道电子填充对超导配对关联的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在双层双轨道模型中，3d_{z²} 轨道的巡游性有利于超导配对；当该轨道填充接近半满时，超导配对关联被显著抑制。此外，电荷涨落大的区域配对关联增强，表明电荷序与超导之间存在竞争。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在双层双轨道模型中，3d_{z²} 轨道的巡游性有利于超导配对；当该轨道填充接近半满时，超导配对关联被显著抑制。此外，电荷涨落大的区域配对关联增强，表明电荷序与超导之间存在竞争。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）方法，在一维最小几何结构上求解有效双层双轨道模型，通过系统改变 3d_{z²} 轨道填充（从 1/12 掺杂到半满）来研究配对关联的演化。

papers.title: On the Relation Between String Order Parameters, Entanglement, and Dynamical Quantum Phase Transitions in Topological Dynamics
papers.abstract: Topological order is defined by topological invariants, rather than symmetries and local order parameters. Nonetheless some topological phases can be characterized by string order parameters and entanglement. In this article we study how string order parameters and entanglement spectra behave out-of-equilibrium following quenches in one dimensional topological models with $\mathbb{Z}$ invariants. Previously it has been suggested that string order parameters could serve as an experimental probe of dynamical quantum phase transitions. Despite the existence of clear zeroes in the order parameters at critical times, we show that in general there is no exact quantitative or qualitative connection with the critical times of dynamical quantum phase transitions. Another possible connection is of dynamical string order parameter zeroes and dynamical crossings at the center of entanglement spectra. Here we see that there can sometimes be a connection, but it is not typical. Again there is no general quantitative or qualitative connection. Each dynamical form of criticality behaves independently, though we do see that critical times tend to be of the same order of magnitude and give an argument for why this is the case. We also find that a string order parameter which labels one topological phase can undergo non-trivial dynamics even following a quench between \emph{other} topological phases. We elucidate where connections can be made, and where they result from a consideration of insufficiently general models. These results cast doubt on the idea of genuine dynamical phases following quenches in such models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：研究（study）、理论分析、模型（topological models）、quenches（淬火）。；研究对象：一维具有Z拓扑不变量的拓扑模型在非平衡淬火动力学中的行为，具体关注弦序参量（string order parameters）、纠缠谱（entanglement spectra）与动力学量子相变（dynamical quantum phase transitions）之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 弦序参量在临界时间出现零点，但一般与动力学量子相变的临界时间没有精确的定量或定性联系；弦序参量零点与纠缠谱中心交叉有时存在联系，但并非典型情况。每种动力学临界行为相互独立，尽管临界时间量级相近。此外，标记某一拓扑相的弦序参量在另一拓扑相之间的淬火后也可能发生非平凡动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：弦序参量在临界时间出现零点，但一般与动力学量子相变的临界时间没有精确的定量或定性联系；弦序参量零点与纠缠谱中心交叉有时存在联系，但并非典型情况。每种动力学临界行为相互独立，尽管临界时间量级相近。此外，标记某一拓扑相的弦序参量在另一拓扑相之间的淬火后也可能发生非平凡动力学。；创新点：系统性地揭示了弦序参量零点、纠缠谱中心交叉与动力学量子相变临界时间之间缺乏普遍、精确的定量或定性联系，指出先前认为弦序参量可作为动力学量子相变实验探针的观点并不普遍成立，并对这类模型中淬火后存在真正动力学相的观点提出质疑。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于一维拓扑模型（具有Z拓扑不变量）的淬火动力学，通过计算弦序参量、纠缠谱以及动力学量子相变的临界时间，进行对比分析。

papers.title: A sweeping twist defect as a topological flagellum that drives colloid motion
papers.abstract: Nematic liquid crystals can dramatically reconfigure under dynamic forcing, providing exciting opportunities in active matter. Here, we study a hybrid disk colloid rotated by an external field which generates a dynamic companion topological defect. The disk moves faster when the defect sweeps across the disk's face. We identify the defect as a non-singular twist wall, characterize the twist energy landscape, and identify the sweeping motion as a topological instability. As the defect sweeps, it reverses the handedness of twist and lowers the free energy in the fluid in the gap above the disk. Landau-de Gennes modeling shows that the sweeping wall behaves as a propagating director texture: the director field is nearly stationary in the wall frame, while nematogens rotate locally as the wall passes. The nematogens' rotation generates a viscous stress on the surface of the disk that hastens its propulsion. Thus, the defect acts as a flagellum that powers colloid swimming, providing an example of a dissipative topological structure whose dynamics can be harnessed to perform useful work.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论建模）。判断依据：摘要中提及“研究混合盘胶体”、“Landau-de Gennes建模”。；研究对象：向列相液晶中由外部场旋转驱动的混合盘胶体，及其产生的动态拓扑缺陷（非奇异扭曲壁）对胶体运动的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 动态拓扑缺陷（扭曲壁）在盘面上扫过时，通过反转扭曲手性并降低间隙流体自由能，在盘表面产生粘性应力，从而加速胶体推进，缺陷充当类似鞭毛的推进结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：动态拓扑缺陷（扭曲壁）在盘面上扫过时，通过反转扭曲手性并降低间隙流体自由能，在盘表面产生粘性应力，从而加速胶体推进，缺陷充当类似鞭毛的推进结构。；创新点：首次将动态拓扑缺陷（非奇异扭曲壁）识别为一种“拓扑鞭毛”，证明其扫动运动可被利用来驱动胶体游泳，为耗散拓扑结构执行有用功提供了新范例。
papers.method_zh: 实验上通过外部场旋转混合盘胶体产生动态拓扑缺陷；理论上使用Landau-de Gennes模型模拟指向矢纹理演化，分析扭曲壁的传播行为及应力产生机制。

papers.title: Nitrogen-doped W0.75Re0.25 Superconducting Nanowire Single Photon Detectors
papers.abstract: Nitrogen-doped Tungsten-Rhenium superconducting alloys were recently proposed as a promising material platform for superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors (SNSPDs), offering a favorable balance between high normal state resistivity and tunable superconducting properties. In this work, we report on the fabrication and characterization of SNSPDs based on ultrathin W0.75Re0.25 films deposited by reactive DC magnetron sputtering in a mixed Ar/N2 atmosphere. Meander detectors with 70 nm linewidth exhibit saturated internal detection efficiency up to 1310 nm at 2.5 K, with sub-nanosecond rise times, decay times of the order of a few nanoseconds, and timing jitter of 73.2 ps measured with room temperature amplifiers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“fabrication and characterization”（制备与表征）、“deposited by reactive DC magnetron sputtering”（反应直流磁控溅射沉积）、“exhibit saturated internal detection efficiency”（展示饱和内探测效率）。；研究对象：氮掺杂钨铼（W₀.₇₅Re₀.₂₅）超导纳米线单光子探测器（SNSPD）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于氮掺杂W₀.₇₅Re₀.₂₅超薄薄膜制备的70 nm线宽蛇形纳米线探测器，在2.5 K下对1310 nm波长光子实现了饱和内探测效率，并具有亚纳秒上升时间、数纳秒衰减时间和73.2 ps的时间抖动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于氮掺杂W₀.₇₅Re₀.₂₅超薄薄膜制备的70 nm线宽蛇形纳米线探测器，在2.5 K下对1310 nm波长光子实现了饱和内探测效率，并具有亚纳秒上升时间、数纳秒衰减时间和73.2 ps的时间抖动。；创新点：首次将氮掺杂钨铼超导合金（此前仅被提出作为有前景的材料平台）实际应用于制备SNSPD器件，并系统展示了其在近红外波段（1310 nm）的优异探测性能。
papers.method_zh: 采用反应直流磁控溅射法在Ar/N₂混合气氛中沉积超薄W₀.₇₅Re₀.₂₅薄膜，并制备成蛇形纳米线探测器；通过电学测量表征其探测效率、响应时间及时间抖动等性能。

papers.title: Sensitivity to perturbations in the three-dimensional Anderson model
papers.abstract: We investigate the fidelity susceptibility, which quantifies the sensitivity of single-particle eigenstates to perturbations, in the three-dimensional Anderson model. As a function of disorder strength $W$, it exhibits two distinct peaks. The first peak signals a crossover at weak disorder strength from plane-wave states to single-particle quantum chaos, and its position shifts toward $W\to 0$ in the thermodynamic limit. The second peak emerges, to high numerical accuracy, at the critical disorder strength associated with the Anderson localization transition. We further show that the divergence of the first peak is maximal, scaling as the square of the inverse frequency cutoff, whereas the divergence of the second peak is submaximal. We relate the latter suppression to the fractal structure of single-particle eigenstates at criticality. We discuss two distinct scenarios that give rise to the peaks in the fidelity susceptibilities. Moreover, studying the scaling of typical fidelity susceptibilities above the Anderson transition, we find evidence of two distinct regimes of nonergodic behavior.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“数值精度”（numerical accuracy）、“标度”（scaling）等关键词，表明主要采用数值模拟与理论分析相结合的方法。；研究对象：三维安德森模型（three-dimensional Anderson model）中的单粒子本征态对扰动的敏感性，具体关注无序强度变化下的保真度磁化率（fidelity susceptibility）行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 保真度磁化率随无序强度呈现两个不同的峰：第一个峰对应从平面波态到单粒子量子混沌的弱无序交叉，在热力学极限下峰位趋近于零无序；第二个峰精确对应安德森局域化相变的临界无序强度。第一个峰的散度最大（与频率截止的平方成反比），第二个峰的散度次最大，后者与临界点处单粒子本征态的分形结构有关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：保真度磁化率随无序强度呈现两个不同的峰：第一个峰对应从平面波态到单粒子量子混沌的弱无序交叉，在热力学极限下峰位趋近于零无序；第二个峰精确对应安德森局域化相变的临界无序强度。第一个峰的散度最大（与频率截止的平方成反比），第二个峰的散度次最大，后者与临界点处单粒子本征态的分形结构有关。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过数值计算三维安德森模型中的保真度磁化率，分析其随无序强度的变化，并研究典型保真度磁化率在安德森转变以上的标度行为。

papers.title: Magnetoelastic effects in the metallic frustrated antiferromagnet CrB$_2$
papers.abstract: Hexagonal chromium diboride CrB$_2$ is a metallic frustrated antiferromagnet with a Néel temperature $T_N \sim$ 88 K. In CrB$_2$, Cr 3$d$ electrons not only give rise to localized magnetic moments but also contribute to metallic conduction. We perform ultrasound velocity measurements on a single crystal of hexagonal CrB$_2$ to determine its elastic properties. The temperature dependence of the $ab$-plane shear elastic modulus exhibits Curie-type softening upon cooling from $\sim$120 K down to $T_N$. This behavior is interpreted as a precursor to a symmetry-lowering lattice distortion at $T_N$, indicating that magnetic frustration is relieved via transverse magnetoelastic coupling. In addition, the $a$-axis and $c$-axis compressive elastic moduli show unusual softness and their suppression upon cooling, which are naturally explained by Fermi-surface nesting and its suppression upon cooling. The present results suggest that, in CrB$_2$, longitudinal magnetoelastic coupling suppresses Fermi-surface nesting and enhances frustrated exchange interactions, while transverse magnetoelastic coupling plays a key role in relieving the frustration.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“ultrasound velocity measurements”（超声速度测量）、“single crystal”（单晶）。；研究对象：六方二硼化铬（CrB₂），一种金属性阻挫反铁磁体，其尼尔温度 \(T_N \sim 88\) K。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在CrB₂中，横向磁弹耦合在 \(T_N\) 附近释放磁阻挫，导致剪切弹性模量出现居里型软化；纵向磁弹耦合则抑制费米面嵌套并增强阻挫交换相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在CrB₂中，横向磁弹耦合在 \(T_N\) 附近释放磁阻挫，导致剪切弹性模量出现居里型软化；纵向磁弹耦合则抑制费米面嵌套并增强阻挫交换相互作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 对六方CrB₂单晶进行超声速度测量，测定其弹性性质（包括ab面剪切模量、a轴和c轴压缩模量）。

papers.title: Transition from Homogeneous to Domain-Wall-Mediated Polarization Switching in BaTiO3: A Machine-Learning Molecular Dynamics Study
papers.abstract: Polarization switching in ferroelectric BaTiO3 can proceed through fundamentally different mechanisms - yet the conditions that determine which pathway is realized remain poorly understood. Using machine-learning potential-based molecular dynamics with the MACEField model, we systematically vary supercell size to reveal a clear transition from homogeneous polarization switching to domain-wall-mediated switching, accompanied by a coercive field increase of over 50%. Shannon entropy analysis demonstrates that this transition is driven by size-dependent polarization fluctuations that promote 180 degree domain-wall nucleation - establishing a direct, quantitative link between local configurational disorder and macroscopic switching behavior. Furthermore, the switching pathway and hysteresis response are shown to depend critically on supercell geometry and the relative orientation of applied stress and electric field. These findings reveal that homogeneous and domain-wall-mediated switching are distinct physical regimes in BaTiO3, and that atomistic simulations must account for system size to correctly capture the operative switching mechanism.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine-learning molecular dynamics（机器学习分子动力学）、simulation（模拟）、supercell size（超胞尺寸）。；研究对象：铁电材料BaTiO₃（钛酸钡）中的极化翻转机制，具体研究从均匀极化翻转到畴壁介导翻转的转变过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在BaTiO₃中，通过改变超胞尺寸可以观察到从均匀极化翻转到畴壁介导翻转的清晰转变，伴随矫顽场增加超过50%；该转变由尺寸依赖的极化涨落驱动，建立了局域构型无序与宏观翻转行为之间的定量联系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在BaTiO₃中，通过改变超胞尺寸可以观察到从均匀极化翻转到畴壁介导翻转的清晰转变，伴随矫顽场增加超过50%；该转变由尺寸依赖的极化涨落驱动，建立了局域构型无序与宏观翻转行为之间的定量联系。；创新点：首次通过系统改变模拟体系尺寸，在原子尺度上揭示了BaTiO₃中均匀翻转与畴壁介导翻转是截然不同的物理机制，并定量建立了局域无序与宏观翻转路径之间的直接关联。
papers.method_zh: 基于机器学习势的分子动力学模拟，采用MACEField模型，系统变化超胞尺寸，并结合Shannon熵分析来表征极化涨落。

papers.title: Spin layer groups and their corepresentations
papers.abstract: Spin layer groups are the crystallographic symmetry groups with a periodic plane, and their symmetry operations are inherited from three-dimensional (3D) spin space groups. However, the direct application of 3D symmetry groups to two-dimensional systems is often inadequate due to anisotropic axes and dimensional reduction. In this work, we systematically classify inequivalent spin layer groups and analytically derive their irreducible corepresentations.
