The Pair Distribution Functions (PDFs) and the Plane Angle Distributions (PADs) of the last 1, 10, 25 and 100 steps of the MD have been obtained. Averaging the last 100 steps, as representative of the liquid, Reverse Monte Carlo (RMC) was applied to obtain 4 atomic structures, one for each set of initial random velocities. Then, a detailed structural study of liquid bismuth at 573 K was undertaken; PDFs and PADs are calculated and reported. Two noticeable peaks appear for the PDFs, at 3.25 and 6.55 Å, along with a pseudo peak (shoulder) at 4.6 Å. This shoulder (after the first peak) of the PDFs is found to be related to the third and fourth neighbor peaks of the crystalline Wyckoff structure and also to the diagonal distances in deformed squares in the liquid structure. For completeness J(r)s are also reported. Two prominent peaks in the MS PADs are observed: 53° and 85°; and two for the RMC PADs: 58° and 90°, suggesting the existence of deformed triangles and squares. Less abundant are higher-order geometrical structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用Molecular Dynamics (MD)和Reverse Monte Carlo (RMC)方法进行模拟计算。；研究对象：液态铋（liquid bismuth）在573 K温度下的原子结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 液态铋的配对分布函数（PDF）在3.25 Å和6.55 Å处出现两个显著峰，并在4.6 Å处出现一个肩峰（伪峰），该肩峰与晶体Wyckoff结构的第三、第四近邻峰以及液态结构中变形正方形的对角线距离有关。平面角分布（PAD）显示存在变形三角形和正方形结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：液态铋的配对分布函数（PDF）在3.25 Å和6.55 Å处出现两个显著峰，并在4.6 Å处出现一个肩峰（伪峰），该肩峰与晶体Wyckoff结构的第三、第四近邻峰以及液态结构中变形正方形的对角线距离有关。平面角分布（PAD）显示存在变形三角形和正方形结构。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用Materials Studio (MS)软件包对216个铋原子的超胞进行分子动力学（MD）模拟，从300 K升温至573 K（100步），并在573 K保持液态500步。对最后1、10、25、100步的配对分布函数（PDF）和平面角分布（PAD）进行分析，并对最后100步的平均结构应用反向蒙特卡洛（RMC）方法获得4个原子结构。

papers.title: AB2X4 spinel structures: similarity and difference between the centrosymmetric, Fd-3m, and non-centrosymmetric, F4132, space groups
papers.abstract: Many compounds belonging to the spinel AB2X4 structure play an important role due to their wide range of practical applications. Most of them are traditionally assigned to the centrosymmetric space group Fd-3m. However, the physical properties of some spinels are incompatible with centrosymmetry. This discrepancy is often accounted for by reducing the symmetry to the non-centrosymmetric space group F-43m, allowing thus small atomic displacements from their original position in Fd-3m. In this work, we demonstrate that the loss of the inversion symmetry can occur without any atomic displacements, since the centrosymmetric Fd-3m and non-centrosymmetric F4132 space groups are equivalent for structure determination and refinement based on X-ray diffraction data. If consistent with experiment, only the use of an anharmonic model of atomic displacements can distinguish these space groups. This study aims to clarify certain misconceptions regarding the structural symmetry and physical properties of spinel type compounds.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“demonstrate that the loss of the inversion symmetry can occur without any atomic displacements”，以及“use of an anharmonic model of atomic displacements”，属于基于对称性分析和结构精修的理论论证。；研究对象：AB2X4型尖晶石结构化合物，具体比较中心对称空间群Fd-3m与非中心对称空间群F4132之间的相似性与差异性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 中心对称的Fd-3m空间群与非中心对称的F4132空间群在基于X射线衍射数据的结构测定和精修中是等价的，因此反演对称性的丧失可以在没有任何原子位移的情况下发生。只有采用非简谐原子位移模型才能区分这两个空间群。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：中心对称的Fd-3m空间群与非中心对称的F4132空间群在基于X射线衍射数据的结构测定和精修中是等价的，因此反演对称性的丧失可以在没有任何原子位移的情况下发生。只有采用非简谐原子位移模型才能区分这两个空间群。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但核心新意在于指出：传统上认为从Fd-3m到F-43m的对称性降低需要原子位移，而本文证明F4132空间群可在无原子位移的情况下实现反演对称性破缺，澄清了尖晶石结构对称性与物理性质之间的一些误解。
papers.method_zh: 基于X射线衍射数据的结构精修分析，结合空间群对称性理论比较，以及非简谐（anharmonic）原子位移模型的应用。

papers.title: Quantized thermal current vortices
papers.abstract: The thermal Hall effect has emerged as a fundamental tool for probing exotic quasiparticles and topological order, particularly in magnetic insulators where electronic conduction is suppressed. Much like skyrmions, which are characterized by their topologically protected spin configurations, the thermal Hall effect is deeply rooted in the geometric properties of the underlying physical space. Although the effect is a well-established experimental phenomenon, current research points toward the existence of its quantum analogue: the quantized thermal Hall effect. In this paper, we provide a theoretical framework for this quantum version based on Sommerfeld's flux quantization. Furthermore, we demonstrate the potential existence of dissipationless thermal current vortices. We suggest that these vortices may play a crucial role in the stability and dynamics of other topological structures, such as skyrmion lattices, offering a new perspective on the interplay between heat transport and magnetic textures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“provide a theoretical framework”、“based on Sommerfeld's flux quantization”、“demonstrate the potential existence”等理论推导和预言性表述。；研究对象：量子化热霍尔效应及热流涡旋（thermal current vortices），特别关注其在磁性绝缘体（magnetic insulators）中与拓扑结构（如斯格明子晶格）的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于索末菲磁通量子化，建立了量子化热霍尔效应的理论框架，并预言了无耗散热流涡旋的存在，该涡旋可能对斯格明子晶格等拓扑结构的稳定性与动力学起关键作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于索末菲磁通量子化，建立了量子化热霍尔效应的理论框架，并预言了无耗散热流涡旋的存在，该涡旋可能对斯格明子晶格等拓扑结构的稳定性与动力学起关键作用。；创新点：将索末菲磁通量子化思想应用于热输运领域，首次提出量子化热流涡旋的概念，并揭示其与磁性拓扑结构（如斯格明子晶格）之间的潜在耦合机制。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：采用索末菲磁通量子化（Sommerfeld's flux quantization）方法，推导量子化热霍尔效应的理论描述，并分析热流涡旋的拓扑性质。

papers.title: Charge density wave in a band insulator
papers.abstract: Charge density wave (CDW) implies a periodic modulation of the charge density. Typically observed in metallic systems, CDWs arise from Fermi surface instabilities, resulting in the total or partial gapping of the Fermi surface. Here, we present experimental evidence for a CDW state emerging in a band insulator which has no Fermi surface. The bulk and surface of our material platform, Bi4Br4, is gapped over the entire Brillouin zone. Through topographic and spectroscopic imaging at low temperatures, we unveil an unexpected unidirectional charge modulation in Bi4Br4, breaking the lattice translation symmetry. The CDW develops at temperatures below 40 K and adds an energy gap atop the existing insulating gap of Bi4Br4. Furthermore, our transport measurements reveal nonlinear electrical conduction, a phenomenon conventionally associated with the sliding or phason mode of incommensurate CDWs. These highly unusual observations represent a new type of CDW and demand a new theoretical framework for CDWs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“experimental evidence”、“topographic and spectroscopic imaging”、“transport measurements”等实验手段。；研究对象：Bi₄Br₄材料中出现的电荷密度波（CDW）现象，该材料原本是能带绝缘体（band insulator），无费米面。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无费米面的能带绝缘体Bi₄Br₄中观测到了电荷密度波（CDW）态，该CDW在40 K以下出现，并在原有绝缘能隙之上叠加了一个新的能隙，同时表现出与非公度CDW滑动或相位子模式相关的非线性电导行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无费米面的能带绝缘体Bi₄Br₄中观测到了电荷密度波（CDW）态，该CDW在40 K以下出现，并在原有绝缘能隙之上叠加了一个新的能隙，同时表现出与非公度CDW滑动或相位子模式相关的非线性电导行为。；创新点：传统CDW被认为源于费米面不稳定性，通常出现在金属体系中。本工作首次在无费米面的能带绝缘体中观测到CDW，挑战了现有CDW理论框架，代表了一种新型CDW。
papers.method_zh: 低温扫描隧道显微镜（STM）进行形貌和能谱成像，以及电输运测量。

papers.title: Signature of spin liquid state in a frustrated 3D antiferromagnet
papers.abstract: Frustrated pyrochlore lattices in transition-metal oxides provide an ideal platform for realizing exotic quantum states, including spin liquids with unconventional low-energy excitations arising from the macroscopic ground-state degeneracy of corner-sharing tetrahedral networks. Here, we report the synthesis and comprehensive characterization of ZnCrGaO$4$, a frustrated three-dimensional pyrochlore-like magnet in which intrinsic cation ordering gives rise to unavoidable atomic-site disorder. A Curie--Weiss analysis of the high-temperature magnetic susceptibility yields a large negative Curie--Weiss temperature, $θ{\mathrm{CW}} \approx -205$ K, indicating dominant antiferromagnetic exchange interactions ($J/k_{\mathrm{B}} \sim 55$ K) between Cr$^{3+}$ ($S = 3/2$) moments. Despite the presence of strong antiferromagnetic interactions, no signature of long-range magnetic ordering is observed down to 125 mK, as evidenced by specific-heat and ac-susceptibility measurements. Furthermore, the absence of bifurcation between zero-field-cooled and field-cooled dc magnetic susceptibilities measured at 0.01 T indicates the absence of spin freezing, which is further supported by the frequency-independent ac susceptibility down to 250 mK. The presence of broad maxima in the magnetic specific heat and ac susceptibility at low temperatures suggests the development of short-range spin correlations within a dynamic magnetic state. In addition, the low-temperature specific heat follows a power-law behavior below 1 K, indicating the presence of unconventional low-energy excitations and algebraic spin correlations. These results provide compelling evidence for a dynamic correlated ground state in ZnCrGaO$_4$, establishing it as a promising platform for exploring highly frustrated $S > 1/2$ three-dimensional quantum magnets and potential spin-liquid behavior.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：synthesis, comprehensive characterization, specific-heat, ac-susceptibility, dc magnetic susceptibilities。；研究对象：一种具有烧绿石结构的三维阻挫反铁磁体 ZnCrGaO₄，其中 Cr³⁺（S=3/2）磁矩位于角共享四面体网络上。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: ZnCrGaO₄ 中尽管存在强反铁磁交换相互作用（θ_CW ≈ -205 K），但在低至 125 mK 的温度下未观察到长程磁有序或自旋冻结，低温比热呈现幂律行为，表明存在非常规低能激发和代数自旋关联，为一种动态关联的量子自旋液体候选材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：ZnCrGaO₄ 中尽管存在强反铁磁交换相互作用（θ_CW ≈ -205 K），但在低至 125 mK 的温度下未观察到长程磁有序或自旋冻结，低温比热呈现幂律行为，表明存在非常规低能激发和代数自旋关联，为一种动态关联的量子自旋液体候选材料。；创新点：在具有 S=3/2 较大自旋的三维阻挫磁体中，通过引入本征阳离子无序（ZnCrGaO₄ 中不可避免的原子位点无序）实现了无长程磁序的量子自旋液体态，拓展了三维量子自旋液体研究的自旋量子数范围。
papers.method_zh: 高温磁化率的 Curie-Weiss 分析、直流磁化率（零场冷/场冷）测量、交流磁化率测量、比热测量（低至 125 mK）。

papers.title: Anderson Localization: A Floquet operator Krylov space perspective
papers.abstract: The problem of Anderson localization, as well as the single particle localization-delocalizaton transition of the Aubry-André model, is studied employing operator Krylov space methods. It is shown that even when the dynamics is generated by a Hamiltonian, studying the dynamics at stroboscopic rather than continuous times has its advantages. In particular, mapping the dynamics to an effective Floquet problem results in an operator Krylov space description where quantities such as the spectral function can be computed with fewer computational resources, while a moment method exists that allows for the extraction of Krylov parameters directly from the discrete time autocorrelation function. For stroboscopic dynamics, the operator Krylov space corresponds to the dynamics of an edge operator of an inhomogeneous Floquet transverse field Ising model, with the parameters of this effective model generated recursively. The Krylov parameters show disorder-averaged renormalization with their distribution narrowing as the recursion step increases. It is shown that a more physical spectral function is obtained from the Krylov parameters obtained from the disorder-averaged autocorrelation function, rather than the disorder-averaged Krylov parameters. The delocalized (localized) phase is shown to correspond to the appearance (absence) of a Porter-Thomas distribution, a ballistically propagating (localized) wavefront in operator Krylov space, and a smooth (discrete) Berstein-Szegö power-spectrum. The localization-delocalization transition is also demonstrated in operator Krylov space. A Porter-Thomas distribution is also observed at the critical point. The long-time dynamics and the inverse participation ratio at the critical point is shown to exhibit behavior consistent with a multi-fractal scaling with system size.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：operator Krylov space methods、mapping to an effective Floquet problem、moment method。；研究对象：安德森局域化问题以及Aubry-André模型的单粒子局域化-去局域化转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将动力学映射为有效Floquet问题，可以在算符Krylov空间中更高效地描述局域化现象；去局域化（局域化）相分别对应算符Krylov空间中Porter-Thomas分布的出现（缺失）、波前的弹道传播（局域）以及光滑（离散）的Berstein-Szegö功率谱；临界点处也观察到Porter-Thomas分布，且长时间动力学和逆参与比表现出与系统尺寸相关的多分形标度行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将动力学映射为有效Floquet问题，可以在算符Krylov空间中更高效地描述局域化现象；去局域化（局域化）相分别对应算符Krylov空间中Porter-Thomas分布的出现（缺失）、波前的弹道传播（局域）以及光滑（离散）的Berstein-Szegö功率谱；临界点处也观察到Porter-Thomas分布，且长时间动力学和逆参与比表现出与系统尺寸相关的多分形标度行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用算符Krylov空间方法，将连续时间动力学映射为有效Floquet问题，利用矩方法从离散时间自关联函数直接提取Krylov参数，并将算符Krylov空间动力学等效为非均匀Floquet横场Ising模型的边界算符动力学。

papers.title: Theory of supercooled water
papers.abstract: We introduce a model of water contemplating true supercooled-liquid states that, as such, are metastable with respect to the crystalline-solid ones. Its numerical solutions reproduce from Speedy-Angell's stability-limit picture to Poole et al.'s metastable liquid--liquid criticality. The real existence of a liquid--liquid critical point is found to gain significant theoretical plausibility from a hitherto unnoticed analogy with the ``inversion thermodynamics'' of Joule-Thomson gas throttling process and, by extension, with the equivalent phenomenology exhibited by black holes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“model”、“numerical solutions”、“analogy”、“thermodynamics”。；研究对象：过冷水的理论模型，具体研究过冷液态水的亚稳相行为及其与结晶固体的关系，以及可能存在的液-液临界点。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型再现了从Speedy-Angell稳定性极限图像到Poole等人提出的亚稳液-液临界性；通过类比焦耳-汤姆逊气体节流过程的“反转热力学”及黑洞的等效现象，为液-液临界点的真实存在提供了显著的理论合理性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型再现了从Speedy-Angell稳定性极限图像到Poole等人提出的亚稳液-液临界性；通过类比焦耳-汤姆逊气体节流过程的“反转热力学”及黑洞的等效现象，为液-液临界点的真实存在提供了显著的理论合理性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但指出其创新在于发现了一个此前未被注意到的热力学类比（与焦耳-汤姆逊气体节流过程及黑洞现象），从而为液-液临界点的存在提供了新的理论依据。
papers.method_zh: 构建了包含真实过冷液态（相对于结晶固体为亚稳态）的水模型，并通过数值求解该模型获得结果；同时采用热力学类比分析（与焦耳-汤姆逊过程和黑洞现象类比）。

papers.title: Electrostatically stabilized surface flat bands in rhombohedral graphite at zero displacement field
papers.abstract: Rhombohedral (ABC-stacked) multilayer graphene hosts interaction-driven phases enabled by surface flat bands at large displacement fields. In thick flakes, however, strong screening suppresses internal electric fields, raising the question of whether a flat-band regime is accessible within the same experimental paradigm. Here, we show that self-consistent, nonlinear electrostatics provides a robust alternative mechanism: even in the absence of a displacement field, a nonuniform near-surface potential flattens the surface-band dispersion and enhances the density of states. In the strong-coupling limit, electrostatics drives the system toward uniform half-filling at each momentum, yielding an asymptotically flat surface band without any gating. At realistic interaction strengths, surface-band flatness is tuned by the proximal gate, with maximal flatness achieved at hole doping when the band is empty. Combining analytic arguments with fully self-consistent calculations in a realistic model, we map the resulting low-field regime and connect to finite $N\!\sim\! 6-15$ layered samples, providing a framework for analyzing the symmetry-broken phases observed in these systems. Our results motivate future experiments in large-$N$ devices and establish a low-field regime for exploring electrostatically induced flat-band physics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：self-consistent, nonlinear electrostatics, analytic arguments, fully self-consistent calculations）；研究对象：菱方（ABC堆叠）多层石墨烯中的表面平带及其静电调控机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在零位移场下，通过自洽非线性静电效应，近表面非均匀电势可使表面能带色散变平并增强态密度；在强耦合极限下，无需栅压即可实现渐近平带。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在零位移场下，通过自洽非线性静电效应，近表面非均匀电势可使表面能带色散变平并增强态密度；在强耦合极限下，无需栅压即可实现渐近平带。；创新点：提出并证明了在无外加位移场时，静电效应本身即可稳定表面平带，为理解大厚度菱方石墨烯中对称性破缺相提供了低场区新机制。
papers.method_zh: 自洽非线性静电学模型、解析论证与全自洽数值计算相结合，模拟有限层数（N~6-15）样品。

papers.title: Controlling spin-$\frac 12$ antiferromagnetic interaction strength in nanographene dimers
papers.abstract: We demonstrate that the effective spin-exchange coupling $J$ in open-shell nanographene dimers can be precisely tuned via tip-induced dehydrogenation of selected carbon atoms. Using the double ionization potential equation-of-motion coupled-cluster singles and doubles (DIP-EOM-CCSD) method, we accurately compute the singlet-triplet gaps, which correspond directly to the exchange coupling $J$. We show that the position of the dehydrogenated (or hydrogen-passivated) site in triangulene dimers strongly modulates the singlet-triplet splitting, allowing $J$ to be tuned over a wide range - from a few meV to several tens of meV. This strategy provides a simple yet powerful route for designing tailored spin models with alternating or spatially patterned spin-exchange couplings.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用DIP-EOM-CCSD方法进行精确计算，摘要中未提及实验操作或理论推导。；研究对象：开壳层纳米石墨烯二聚体中的自旋交换耦合，具体为三角烯二聚体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过针尖诱导对选定碳原子进行脱氢，可以精确调控开壳层纳米石墨烯二聚体中的有效自旋交换耦合强度J，使其在几meV到几十meV的宽范围内变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过针尖诱导对选定碳原子进行脱氢，可以精确调控开壳层纳米石墨烯二聚体中的有效自旋交换耦合强度J，使其在几meV到几十meV的宽范围内变化。；创新点：提出通过脱氢（或氢钝化）位点的位置调控来大范围调制三角烯二聚体中的自旋交换耦合强度，为设计具有交替或空间图案化自旋交换耦合的定制自旋模型提供了简单而有效的途径。
papers.method_zh: 采用双电离势运动方程耦合簇单双激发（DIP-EOM-CCSD）方法，精确计算单重态-三重态能隙，该能隙直接对应交换耦合J。

papers.title: Pressure and Size Dependence of Roton Emission and Vortex Creation by Moving Objects in He~II in $T \to 0$ Limit: Generalized Nonlocal Gross-Pitaevskii Model
papers.abstract: In the framework of generalized, nonlocal Gross-Pitaevskii (GP) model, we study numerically the pressure- and size-dependent mechanisms of roton emission and vortex nucleation by objects moving in superfluid $^4$He. As far as the authors are aware, this is the first attempt to analyze the pressure dependence of these mechanisms and the associated critical velocities within a single theoretical framework. For each of several pressures in the range from 0 to the solidification pressure of $\approx25$~bar, we chose the parameters of the interatomic interaction potential such that the resulting excitation spectrum for the generalized, nonlocal GP equation approximates fairly accurately the pressure-dependent dispersion curve determined experimentally by Godfrin \textit{et al.}, Phys. Rev. B \textbf{103}, 104516 (2021). In the two-dimensional approximation, for circular obstacles (disks) moving in quiescent $^4$He, we calculated two critical velocities -- one corresponding to the roton emission and the other to the nucleation of quantized vortices -- as functions of pressure and the obstacle's size. We also comment briefly on three-dimensional simulations of the roton emission and vortex nucleation by moving spherical obstacles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：numerically study, generalized nonlocal Gross-Pitaevskii model, two-dimensional approximation, three-dimensional simulations）；研究对象：超流⁴He中运动物体（圆盘状障碍物）的旋子发射与涡旋成核机制，以及这些机制随压力和障碍物尺寸的变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在广义非局域Gross-Pitaevskii模型框架下，首次在同一理论框架内分析了从0 bar到约25 bar凝固压力范围内，旋子发射和量子化涡旋成核的临界速度随压力和障碍物尺寸的变化规律。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在广义非局域Gross-Pitaevskii模型框架下，首次在同一理论框架内分析了从0 bar到约25 bar凝固压力范围内，旋子发射和量子化涡旋成核的临界速度随压力和障碍物尺寸的变化规律。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用广义非局域Gross-Pitaevskii（GP）方程进行数值模拟。通过选择原子间相互作用势参数，使模型计算出的激发谱与Godfrin等人（Phys. Rev. B 103, 104516, 2021）实验测得的压力依赖色散曲线精确匹配。在二维近似下计算圆盘障碍物的两个临界速度，并简要讨论三维球形障碍物的模拟结果。

papers.title: Universal classification of continuous phase transitions with two order parameters
papers.abstract: The continuous phase transition, indicated by the macroscopic order parameter and the occurrence of the spontaneous symmetry breaking, is well illustrated based on the Ginzburg-Landau's paradigm. In systems described by one order parameter, the phase diagram is only composed of the normal phase and the ordered phase. However, in systems with two or more order parameters, much richer phase diagrams and critical phenomena may emerge. According to coupling terms of the free energy, we classify the systems with two order parameters into several categories, featuring different patterns of phase diagrams and critical scalings respectively. Our work propose the new avenue to studying and evaluating the complex systems only based on the coupling terms in expressions of free energy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“基于Ginzburg-Landau范式”、“根据自由能耦合项进行分类”、“提出新途径”等关键词，属于理论分析框架构建。；研究对象：具有两个序参量的连续相变系统。具体涉及此类系统中丰富的相图与临界现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 根据自由能中序参量之间的耦合项形式，可将具有两个序参量的系统分为若干类别，每种类别对应不同的相图模式和临界标度行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：根据自由能中序参量之间的耦合项形式，可将具有两个序参量的系统分为若干类别，每种类别对应不同的相图模式和临界标度行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于Ginzburg-Landau理论框架，通过分析自由能表达式中两个序参量之间的耦合项，对系统进行分类研究。

papers.title: Radiation conduction in polaritonic nanowires
papers.abstract: Phonon polaritons have attracted increasing interest as a means to offset the reduction in phonon thermal conductivity in nanostructures caused by enhanced boundary scattering. However, the interpretation of the limited experimental data on phonon polariton-mediated conduction is hindered by the lack of comprehensive full-wave models for predicting thermal electromagnetic transport in solid-state systems. Here, the radiative thermal conductivity in the diffusive regime along SiO2 nanowires near room temperature is predicted using the fluctuational electrodynamics-based discrete system Green's function method. At 400 K, for nanowire diameters of 66 nm and 132 nm, modest radiative conductivities of 0.0264 W/m-K and 0.0165 W/m-K, respectively, are obtained, with contributions dominated by surface phonon polaritons. In contrast, the kinetic theory combined with nanowire dispersion relations derived from Maxwell's equations predicts conductivities that can be nearly two orders of magnitude larger than those obtained from fluctuational electrodynamics, and are largely dominated by bulk phonon polaritons propagating within the nanowire volume. Improved agreement between the kinetic theory and fluctuational electrodynamics for the total radiative conductivity can be achieved by introducing an effective mean free path that accounts for the reduced mean free path of bulk phonon polaritons outside the Reststrahlen spectral bands of SiO2. However, even with this correction, the kinetic theory fails to accurately capture the spectral distribution of radiative conductivity. This work establishes a solid foundation for the development of phonon polariton-based systems for thermal management in micro/nanoelectronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词“预测”（predicted）、“fluctuational electrodynamics-based discrete system Green's function method”、“kinetic theory”。；研究对象：SiO₂纳米线中由声子极化激元（phonon polaritons）介导的辐射热传导现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在室温附近，基于涨落电动力学预测的SiO₂纳米线辐射热导率较小（如400 K时66 nm直径纳米线为0.0264 W/m-K），且主要由表面声子极化激元贡献；而基于动力学理论结合麦克斯韦方程色散关系的预测值可高出近两个数量级，且主要由体声子极化激元贡献。引入有效平均自由程可改善两种方法对总辐射热导率的一致性，但动力学理论仍无法准确捕捉其光谱分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在室温附近，基于涨落电动力学预测的SiO₂纳米线辐射热导率较小（如400 K时66 nm直径纳米线为0.0264 W/m-K），且主要由表面声子极化激元贡献；而基于动力学理论结合麦克斯韦方程色散关系的预测值可高出近两个数量级，且主要由体声子极化激元贡献。引入有效平均自由程可改善两种方法对总辐射热导率的一致性，但动力学理论仍无法准确捕捉其光谱分布。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于涨落电动力学的离散系统格林函数方法（discrete system Green's function method）预测扩散区辐射热导率；同时使用动力学理论（kinetic theory）结合从麦克斯韦方程导出的纳米线色散关系进行对比计算。

papers.title: Supersymmetry Without Time-Reversal Invariance in Model A: A FRG perspective
papers.abstract: We show that, contrary to common belief, supersymmetry alone is not sufficient in Model A dynamics to ensure relaxation toward a stationary state satisfying time-reversal invariance (TRI). An additional condition on top of supersymmetry is required for TRI, which we analyze in detail. We explicitly construct a model that is supersymmetric but violates TRI, and argue that, at least perturbatively, TRI nevertheless emerges as an effective large-scale symmetry. Using the functional renormalization group (FRG), we further show that the dynamical effective action, $Γ[\varphi,\tilde\varphi]$, contains the derivative of the equilibrium effective action, $Γ^{\mathrm{eq}}[\varphi]$, whose renormalization-group flow is identical to that of the equilibrium theory order by order in the derivative expansion. Finally, extending the same line of reasoning, we show that the probability distribution of the total magnetization in the Ising model can be recovered within the Model A framework.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：functional renormalization group (FRG)、Model A dynamics、supersymmetry、time-reversal invariance。；研究对象：Model A 动力学（一种描述非守恒序参量弛豫的经典统计场论），以及其中超对称性与时间反演不变性的关系；具体以伊辛模型的总磁化概率分布为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 超对称性本身不足以保证 Model A 动力学中系统弛豫到满足时间反演不变性的稳态，需要额外条件；但至少在微扰论下，时间反演不变性仍作为有效的大尺度对称性出现。此外，动力学有效作用量中包含平衡态有效作用量的导数，其重整化群流与平衡态理论在导数展开中逐阶相同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：超对称性本身不足以保证 Model A 动力学中系统弛豫到满足时间反演不变性的稳态，需要额外条件；但至少在微扰论下，时间反演不变性仍作为有效的大尺度对称性出现。此外，动力学有效作用量中包含平衡态有效作用量的导数，其重整化群流与平衡态理论在导数展开中逐阶相同。；创新点：推翻了“超对称性自动保证时间反演不变性”的常见观点，明确指出了超对称性之外还需额外条件；并利用 FRG 证明了动力学与平衡态理论在重整化群流上的逐阶对应关系，以及伊辛模型总磁化概率分布在 Model A 框架中的可恢复性。
papers.method_zh: 采用泛函重整化群（FRG）框架，结合导数展开，分析动力学有效作用量 Γ[φ,φ̃] 的结构，并与平衡态有效作用量 Γ^eq[φ] 的重整化群流进行比较。

papers.title: Towards terahertz excitons in hydrogenated graphene superlattices
papers.abstract: Carbon nanostructures, such as nanotubes and graphene nanoribbons, exhibit unique electronic and optical properties that make them very promising candidates for terahertz components. However, carbon nanotube and nanoribbon monolithic on-chip integration is challenging because it may results in significant change of their intrinsic properties after an embedment into a substrate. We investigate with first principles theoretical methods the successful routes of such integration and calculate electronic and optical properties of the integrated structures -- two-dimensional graphene superlattices, where quasi-metallic and dielectric regions alternate by selective hydrogenation of graphene. It is shown that chemical engineering of the graphene surface can lead to strong and well-isolated excitonic absorption peaks in the far-infrared and possibly even terahertz frequencies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first principles theoretical methods”（第一性原理理论方法）。；研究对象：氢化石墨烯超晶格，即通过选择性氢化在石墨烯上形成准金属与介电区域交替的二维超晶格结构，以及其中产生的远红外乃至太赫兹激子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过化学工程对石墨烯表面进行选择性氢化，可以在远红外乃至太赫兹频率范围内产生强且孤立的激子吸收峰。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过化学工程对石墨烯表面进行选择性氢化，可以在远红外乃至太赫兹频率范围内产生强且孤立的激子吸收峰。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理理论方法（first principles theoretical methods），具体用于计算集成结构的电子和光学性质。

papers.title: Rounding Almost Commuting Hamiltonians
papers.abstract: Commuting Hamiltonians lie at the boundary between classical constraint satisfaction and quantum many-body physics, exhibiting rich quantum structure while remaining more tractable than general noncommuting models. In contrast, physical Hamiltonians are rarely exactly commuting, which naturally motivates the study of almost commuting Hamiltonians. Despite their relevance, the implications of approximate commutation are only poorly understood. In this work, we show how to efficiently approximate any almost commuting $2$-local qubit Hamiltonian by a commuting one: we give a locality-preserving algorithmic rounding technique that maps any $2$-local Hamiltonian $H=\sum_{i=1}^m h_i$ with $\|[h_i,h_j]\| \leq ε$ to a nearby Hamiltonian $\hat{H}$ whose terms pair-wise commute, and which is within overall distance $\|H-\hat{H}\| = O(m\,ε^{1/6})$. As a consequence, we show that $δ$-approximations to the ground energy for $ε$-almost commuting $2$-local qubit Hamiltonians lie in $\mathsf{NP}$ when $δ\gg mε^{1/6}$, extending the classical containment well beyond the commuting setting. Finally, we present two applications of our rounding framework: Gibbs sampling and fast Hamiltonian simulation for almost commuting systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“algorithmic rounding technique”“we show”“we present”等理论推导与算法设计关键词，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：几乎对易的2-局域量子比特哈密顿量（almost commuting 2-local qubit Hamiltonians），即哈密顿量中各局域项之间近似对易的量子多体系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种保持局域性的算法舍入技术，可将任意几乎对易的2-局域量子比特哈密顿量高效近似为一个严格对易的哈密顿量，并给出了两者之间的误差上界 \(O(m\varepsilon^{1/6})\)。由此证明，当近似精度 \(\delta \gg m\varepsilon^{1/6}\) 时，几乎对易哈密顿量的基态能量 \(\delta\)-近似问题属于NP类。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种保持局域性的算法舍入技术，可将任意几乎对易的2-局域量子比特哈密顿量高效近似为一个严格对易的哈密顿量，并给出了两者之间的误差上界 \(O(m\varepsilon^{1/6})\)。由此证明，当近似精度 \(\delta \gg m\varepsilon^{1/6}\) 时，几乎对易哈密顿量的基态能量 \(\delta\)-近似问题属于NP类。；创新点：首次将经典约束满足问题与量子多体物理之间的边界（对易哈密顿量）推广到几乎对易情形，并给出了高效的近似对易化算法及其复杂度理论后果（NP包含性）。此外，该舍入框架还被应用于吉布斯采样和快速哈密顿量模拟。
papers.method_zh: 采用算法舍入（algorithmic rounding）框架，将几乎对易的哈密顿量映射到严格对易的哈密顿量，并分析映射前后的距离上界。该技术保持哈密顿量的局域性（locality-preserving）。

papers.title: Absolute measurement of the intrinsic helicity in nanophotonics
papers.abstract: Helicity is a universal quantity describing the internal rotation of an object or a field. Whether it characterizes fundamental properties such as the spin of elementary particles or leads to practical consequences such as the toxicity or harmlessness of chiral molecules, defining and measuring it is essential. However, this remains ambiguous in the case of chiral photonic systems such as plasmonic nanoparticles or photonic metasurfaces, where contrary to common knowledge, the observation of circularly polarized dependent optical properties is not a relevant measure for the helicity. We demonstrate experimentally and theoretically that the helicity can be rigorously defined and measured in a nanophotonic system emitting circularly polarized light after excitation in the near-field by a focused electron beam. In the case of a model system composed of two plasmonic dipoles (Born-Kuhn systems), we show that the helicity of photonic modes takes on a very intuitive form and can be simply measured by symmetrizing the geometry of excitation and detection. The method could be extended to a variety of chiral photonic systems, whose locally enhanced properties make them promising for the engineering of local chirality.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与理论）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“We demonstrate experimentally and theoretically”，即同时进行了实验验证和理论推导。；研究对象：手性光子系统的本征手性（intrinsic helicity），具体以由两个等离激元偶极子构成的模型系统（Born-Kuhn systems）为例，研究其在近场电子束激发下发射圆偏振光的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在手性光子系统中（如等离激元纳米颗粒或超表面），观测到的圆偏振依赖光学性质并不能直接作为衡量系统手性（helicity）的有效指标。通过对称化激发和探测的几何结构，可以严格定义并绝对测量光子模式的本征手性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在手性光子系统中（如等离激元纳米颗粒或超表面），观测到的圆偏振依赖光学性质并不能直接作为衡量系统手性（helicity）的有效指标。通过对称化激发和探测的几何结构，可以严格定义并绝对测量光子模式的本征手性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容推断，其核心创新在于：1）澄清了在手性光子系统中，圆二色性等常见光学响应并非手性的直接度量这一反直觉事实；2）提出并实验验证了一种基于近场电子束激发和对称化几何结构的、可绝对测量本征手性的新方法。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用聚焦电子束在近场激发手性光子结构，并测量其发射的圆偏振光。理论上，通过分析由两个等离激元偶极子构成的Born-Kuhn模型，推导出光子模式手性的直观表达式，并提出了通过对称化激发与探测几何结构来测量手性的方法。

papers.title: Everything at Every Scale: Scale-Invariant Diffusion with Continuous Super-Resolution
papers.abstract: Creating images from noise is image generation; reconstructing fine details from coarse inputs is super-resolution. Despite their practical differences, both can be understood as reversing information loss across scales. We introduce $\textbf{SKILD}$, a $\textbf{S}$cale-invariant $\textbf{K}$-Space $\textbf{I}$mage $\textbf{L}$earning $\textbf{D}$iffusion model that unifies generation and continuous super-resolution within a single unconditional framework. Both natural images and critical physical systems exhibit scale invariance, and we leverage it to design a forward process that attenuates image content from fine to coarse scales while injecting spectrum-matched Gaussian noise, making scale an explicit coordinate of the diffusion dynamics. The same trained reverse process performs generation and continuous super-resolution by varying only the starting timestep: $\textit{no task-specific architecture, no conditioning branch, no classifier-free guidance, no retraining per scale factor}$. Empirically, SKILD reaches FID $2.65$ and Inception Score $9.63$ on unconditional CIFAR-10, performs $2\times$--$8\times$ super-resolution on ImageNet from a single unconditional checkpoint while outperforming conditional models across perceptual metrics, and reconstructs critical Ising models whose connected four-point correlations closely track the ground truth.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算方法文章。关键词：diffusion model（扩散模型）、scale-invariant（尺度不变性）、unconditional framework（无条件框架）。；研究对象：论文研究的是图像生成与超分辨率的统一框架，具体应用于自然图像（CIFAR-10、ImageNet）以及临界物理系统（critical Ising model，临界伊辛模型）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种尺度不变的扩散模型SKILD，能够在单一无条件框架下同时实现图像生成和连续超分辨率，无需任务特定架构或条件分支，并且在临界伊辛模型上重建的四点关联函数与真实值高度吻合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种尺度不变的扩散模型SKILD，能够在单一无条件框架下同时实现图像生成和连续超分辨率，无需任务特定架构或条件分支，并且在临界伊辛模型上重建的四点关联函数与真实值高度吻合。；创新点：首次将尺度不变性引入扩散模型，实现了生成与连续超分辨率的无条件统一，无需重训练、条件分支或无分类器引导。
papers.method_zh: 基于K空间（K-space）的尺度不变扩散模型，设计了一个前向过程：从精细尺度到粗糙尺度逐步衰减图像内容，同时注入与频谱匹配的高斯噪声，使尺度成为扩散动力学的显式坐标。反向过程通过仅改变起始时间步长，即可执行生成或任意倍数的超分辨率。

papers.title: Uncovering multi-channel magnetic hopfion annihilation via a single-node, billion-spin-scale atomistic framework
papers.abstract: Modern atomistic spin simulations combine long stochastic trajectories, thermodynamic sampling, static optimization and multi-image transition-path workflows, all of which rely on repeated evaluation of spin Hamiltonians and become computationally prohibitive on the large lattices required for three-dimensional magnetic textures. We introduce SpinX, a GPU-native atomistic spin simulation framework built around a unified Hamiltonian interface and multiple user-selectable computational backends. Its core is a crystallographic sublattice decomposition that reformulates translationally invariant spin interactions as multi-channel tensor convolutions, enabling dense, sparse and FFT-based convolution backends, while irregular systems are handled by pair-list evaluation and long-range dipolar fields by reciprocal-space FFT. Implemented in JAX, SpinX supports deterministic and stochastic Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert dynamics, Monte Carlo sampling, static optimization, dynamical spectroscopy and string and geodesic nudged elastic band transition-path calculations on heterogeneous accelerator platforms. A validated mixed-precision mode combines fp32 field evaluation with fp64 spin-state propagation. We validate SpinX against analytical single-spin dynamics, finite-size thermodynamics of bcc Fe and transverse dynamic structure factors. Performance benchmarks show peak throughput exceeding 10 billion spin-site operations per second on a single accelerator and aggregate single-node workloads of over 1 billion atomic spins. Applying this framework to an exchange-stabilized magnetic hopfion, we uncover two competing annihilation channels on a million-spin atomistic lattice: a previously reported axial-collapse pathway and a distinct lateral-rupture pathway with a different transition morphology and activation barrier.(Due to arXiv's limit, the abstract shown here is a shortened version)
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：atomistic spin simulations, GPU-native framework, performance benchmarks）；研究对象：三维磁性孤子结构，特别是交换作用稳定的磁性霍普夫子（magnetic hopfion）的湮灭机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在百万原子尺度的晶格上，发现了磁性霍普夫子存在两种相互竞争的湮灭通道：一种是先前报道过的轴向塌缩路径，另一种是形态和势垒都不同的横向断裂路径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在百万原子尺度的晶格上，发现了磁性霍普夫子存在两种相互竞争的湮灭通道：一种是先前报道过的轴向塌缩路径，另一种是形态和势垒都不同的横向断裂路径。；创新点：提出了一个基于晶学子格分解的统一哈密顿量接口，将多种自旋相互作用（包括长程偶极场）高效映射到GPU上的张量卷积或FFT计算，从而在单节点上实现了超过10亿自旋的模拟规模，并在此规模下首次揭示了磁性霍普夫子湮灭的横向断裂新通道。
papers.method_zh: 开发了名为SpinX的GPU原生原子自旋模拟框架。该框架基于JAX实现，核心是晶学子格分解，将平移不变的自旋相互作用重构为多通道张量卷积，并支持稠密、稀疏和基于FFT的卷积后端。它实现了确定性/随机性LLG动力学、蒙特卡洛采样、静态优化、动力学谱以及弦/测地线NEB过渡态路径计算，并采用了混合精度模式（fp32场计算+fp64自旋传播）。

papers.title: Native topological readout on qubit hardware: a Fibonacci-chain benchmark of measurement-compilation trade-offs
papers.abstract: Recent demonstrations of non-Abelian braiding of graph vertices on noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) superconducting processor, and the experimental realization of topological order in general on various quantum hardware platforms necessitate an important question: when does a native (topological) fusion readout genuinely help for topological anyonic Hamiltonians implemented on NISQ hardware? We use the Fibonacci anyons chain as a concrete model for understanding the trade-off between measurement cost and compilation cost in that setting. The comparison is made against a simple grouped-Pauli baseline, and is scored by a covariance-aware mean-squared-error (MSE) of the full energy estimator. We based our benchmark on two different important classes of quantum circuits, namely Floquet time-evolved and variational quantum eigensolver quantum circuits, with the underlying Hamiltonian consisting of both braiding and fusion interaction. Our analysis found that there is not a uniform best method across both problems: the fusion readout method performed better on Floquet-type circuits on both the MSE and covariance-aware sampling variance, while the grouped Pauli method performed better on VQE on the MSE but worse on sampling variance. We derive scaling laws, and compute shot-budget crossover points, where one method is operationally favored above the other. The relevance of this work extends beyond Fibonacci chains to two-dimensional topological models compiled on superconducting and other qubit-native platforms, and can be used as a guide in answering the question of when one should measure in the native operator basis of the target physics, or when it is better to fall back on Pauli-basis reconstruction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：benchmark（基准测试）、analysis（分析）、scaling laws（标度律）、shot-budget crossover points（预算交叉点）。；研究对象：Fibonacci任意子链（Fibonacci anyons chain）作为拓扑量子系统的具体模型，以及在该模型上实现的Floquet时间演化电路和变分量子本征求解器（VQE）电路。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 不存在适用于所有问题的统一最优测量方法：对于Floquet型电路，融合读出（fusion readout）方法在均方误差（MSE）和协方差感知采样方差上均表现更好；对于VQE电路，分组Pauli方法在MSE上表现更好，但在采样方差上较差。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：不存在适用于所有问题的统一最优测量方法：对于Floquet型电路，融合读出（fusion readout）方法在均方误差（MSE）和协方差感知采样方差上均表现更好；对于VQE电路，分组Pauli方法在MSE上表现更好，但在采样方差上较差。；创新点：系统量化了在NISQ硬件上实现拓扑任意子哈密顿量时，原生拓扑测量与Pauli基重构测量之间的权衡（measurement-compilation trade-off），并给出了操作上选择某一方法的预算交叉点。摘要未突出说明与已有基准测试工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 通过对比两种测量方案——原生拓扑融合读出（native topological fusion readout）与简单的分组Pauli基线（grouped-Pauli baseline），使用协方差感知的均方误差（covariance-aware MSE）作为能量估计器的评分标准，推导标度律并计算预算交叉点（shot-budget crossover points）。

papers.title: UNATE: UNsupervised ATomic Embedding for crystal structures property prediction
papers.abstract: Accurately predicting crystal properties is critical for accelerating materials discovery, but it is often limited by scarce labeled data and costly theoretical calculations. To alleviate this, we propose UNATE (Unsupervised Atomic Embedding), a framework that leverages structural information extracted from unlabeled crystal structures. UNATE integrates an unsupervised denoising autoencoder with self-supervised contrastive learning to learn robust atomic representations, which are then used as input features for downstream property prediction. Experimental results show that replacing raw atomic numbers with UNATE-pretrained node embeddings yields a 2.7\% improvement over the full-data baseline. Notably, the benefits become more pronounced in scenarios with limited labeled data, reaching improvements of up to 10\% when only 25\% of the labeled data is used.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：unsupervised denoising autoencoder、self-supervised contrastive learning、pretrained node embeddings。；研究对象：晶体结构（crystal structures）及其性质预测（property prediction），未指定具体化合物体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 使用无监督预训练的原子嵌入（UNATE）替代原始原子序数作为输入特征，可在全数据基线基础上提升2.7%的预测性能；在仅有25%标注数据的低数据场景下，性能提升可达10%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：使用无监督预训练的原子嵌入（UNATE）替代原始原子序数作为输入特征，可在全数据基线基础上提升2.7%的预测性能；在仅有25%标注数据的低数据场景下，性能提升可达10%。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 无监督去噪自编码器（unsupervised denoising autoencoder）结合自监督对比学习（self-supervised contrastive learning），从无标注晶体结构中学习原子表示，再作为下游性质预测任务的输入特征。

papers.title: Sideband fingerprints of antibunched light in cascaded quantum wave mixing
papers.abstract: Quantum wave mixing on a single superconducting qubit produces a hierarchy of coherent side peaks associated with elastic multiphoton scattering pathways. In a cascaded source--probe geometry these pathways become sensitive to the photon statistics of the radiation emitted by the source qubit. We develop an analytical theory of this effect starting from the cascaded master equation in the weak-driving regime. In the coherent-filtering limit $γ_{\rm s}\ggγ_{\rm pr}$, the standard coherent--coherent wave-mixing hierarchy is recovered. In the opposite limit $γ_{\rm pr}\ggγ_{\rm s}$, side peaks associated with multiphoton absorption from the antibunched source field are parametrically suppressed. Numerical solutions confirm the analytical scaling laws. The resulting sideband hierarchy provides a frequency-domain fingerprint of antibunched itinerant microwave light.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：analytical theory、cascaded master equation、weak-driving regime、numerical solutions）；研究对象：基于单个超导量子比特的级联量子波混频体系，具体研究源-探针几何结构中反聚束光子的边带指纹。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在级联源-探针结构中，当探针弛豫率远大于源弛豫率时，与反聚束源场多光子吸收相关的边峰被参数化抑制；该边带层级结构可作为反聚束行波微波光子的频域指纹。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在级联源-探针结构中，当探针弛豫率远大于源弛豫率时，与反聚束源场多光子吸收相关的边峰被参数化抑制；该边带层级结构可作为反聚束行波微波光子的频域指纹。；创新点：揭示了级联量子波混频中边带结构对源光子统计的敏感性，并建立了反聚束光子的频域指纹识别方法。
papers.method_zh: 从级联主方程出发，在弱驱动条件下建立解析理论；通过数值求解验证解析标度律；对比两种极限情况（γ_s≫γ_pr 和 γ_pr≫γ_s）下的边带行为。

papers.title: Machine Learning Multiscale Interactions
papers.abstract: Realistic physical systems are characterised by emergent interactions across multiple length and time scales, posing a significant challenge for predictive machine learning (ML) models. Most scientific ML models focus on a narrow range of interactions. While machine learning force fields (MLFFs) offer near-quantum accuracy, the ubiquitous message-passing layers miss long-range many-body effects. Here we introduce the Multiscale Structural Ensemble (MuSE), a hierarchical model that uses Soft Coarse-Graining Pooling to construct coarse representations from smooth fractional assignments of atoms to coarse nodes, enabling MLFF modules to operate across multiple scales. MuSE is architecture-agnostic and coupled with SO3krates, MACE, and PaiNN MLFFs for both molecules and materials. We demonstrate the power of MuSE through Hessian-based benchmarks, folding trajectories for biomolecules, and energy profiles in molecule-graphene nanostructures, where MuSE accurately captures quantum-mechanical interactions at relevant scales -- unlike other recent long-range ML models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词包括“machine learning force fields (MLFFs)”、“hierarchical model”、“Soft Coarse-Graining Pooling”、“Hessian-based benchmarks”等，属于机器学习方法开发与计算验证。；研究对象：多尺度物理系统中的相互作用，具体包括分子、生物分子（如折叠轨迹）、以及分子-石墨烯纳米结构等体系中的长程多体相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为MuSE（多尺度结构集成）的分层模型，能够通过软粗粒化池化方法构建多尺度表示，使机器学习力场模块在不同尺度上准确捕捉量子力学相互作用，优于其他近期长程机器学习模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为MuSE（多尺度结构集成）的分层模型，能够通过软粗粒化池化方法构建多尺度表示，使机器学习力场模块在不同尺度上准确捕捉量子力学相互作用，优于其他近期长程机器学习模型。；创新点：MuSE模型是架构无关的，能够将机器学习力场扩展至多尺度，同时捕捉短程和长程多体效应，弥补了传统消息传递层在长程相互作用上的缺失。
papers.method_zh: 采用Soft Coarse-Graining Pooling（软粗粒化池化）方法，将原子按平滑分数分配至粗粒化节点，构建分层结构；与SO3krates、MACE、PaiNN等三种机器学习力场（MLFF）架构耦合；通过Hessian矩阵基准测试、生物分子折叠轨迹、分子-石墨烯纳米结构能量曲线进行验证。

papers.title: Pulse magnet of 10 T for power laser experiments with x-ray free-electron laser diagnostics
papers.abstract: The importance of investigating magnetized plasmas/solids in extreme conditions has grown over the last decades, particularly in the field of high energy density physics (HEDP), such as laboratory astrophysics and inertial confinement fusion. However, up to now, the unique capabilities of an X-ray free-electron laser (XFEL), such as high brilliance and low divergence have never been exploited for this type of research. In this paper, we present the first platform developed at SACLA, Japan, that combines a high-power optical laser for generating matter under extreme conditions of pressure and temperature, an XFEL probe, and an external magnetic field. The high current is produced using a 2 kV, 4.8 kJ pulsed power system giving a maximum current of 10 kA which is synchronized with the optical laser and XFEL in a vacuum environment. It flows through a split-pair coil to generate a high magnetic field (10 T at 6 kA) which has 1 cm access every 45$^{\circ}$ in the equatorial plane and 90$^{\circ}$ in the poloidal one. This platform offers new opportunities to study high-energy-density matter in strong magnetic fields, including shock propagation, instability growth, and turbulent plasma dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：platform developed（平台开发）、pulsed power system（脉冲功率系统）、experiment（实验）。；研究对象：论文研究的是在极端条件下（高温、高压）的磁化等离子体/固体物质，具体涉及高能量密度物理（HEDP）领域，如实验室天体物理和惯性约束聚变中的冲击波传播、不稳定性增长和湍流等离子体动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 成功开发并展示了首个结合高功率激光、X射线自由电子激光（XFEL）探针和外部强磁场的综合实验平台，该平台可在真空环境中产生10特斯拉的脉冲磁场。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：成功开发并展示了首个结合高功率激光、X射线自由电子激光（XFEL）探针和外部强磁场的综合实验平台，该平台可在真空环境中产生10特斯拉的脉冲磁场。；创新点：首次将XFEL的高亮度和低发散度等独特能力应用于磁化高能量密度物质的研究，构建了集高功率激光、XFEL诊断和外部强磁场于一体的实验平台。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法。具体包括：使用一套2 kV、4.8 kJ的脉冲功率系统产生高达10 kA的电流；采用分裂对线圈（split-pair coil）结构，在6 kA电流下产生10 T的强磁场；该磁场系统与高功率光学激光器和XFEL探针在真空环境中实现同步。

papers.title: Balancing structure and randomness: maximum entropy networks for context-dependent computations
papers.abstract: Understanding how network function constrains neural connectivity is a central challenge in neuroscience. An influential approach is to train neural networks with gradient descent on cognitive tasks and characterize the resulting connectivity. A key limitation is that the resulting structure depends on the details of the training procedure. Here we propose a complementary normative approach based on the maximum entropy principle for network connectivity, independent of any particular learning algorithm. We describe connectivity as a probability distribution over single-neuron weights, express task requirements as constraints on this distribution, and determine the unique distribution maximizing Shannon entropy subject to these constraints. A weight scale parameter controls the balance between randomness and task-induced structure. We apply this framework to context-dependent input-selection tasks in 2-layer feed-forward networks, and show that maximum entropy inference becomes analytically tractable by mapping nonlinear networks onto gain-modulated linear models. Starting from an a priori homogeneous distribution, we find that maximizing entropy under task constraints leads to the emergence of populations of neurons, each defined by its pattern of contextual gain modulation. Increasing the number of contexts drives a transition from context-specialized to unspecialized, random populations. Increasing the weight scale drives a parallel transition from structured to random stimulus selectivity. Strikingly, this maximum entropy connectivity matches both qualitatively and quantitatively the structure of networks trained with gradient descent across different learning regimes. Our results suggest that the interplay between task constraints and entropy maximization provides a fundamental principle for understanding the relationship between structure and function in neural networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：maximum entropy principle、normative approach、analytically tractable）；研究对象：神经网络连接性与任务约束之间的关系，具体为2层前馈网络在上下文依赖输入选择任务中的连接结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在任务约束下最大化香农熵，会导致神经元群体涌现出上下文增益调制的特定模式；该最大熵连接结构与梯度下降训练得到的网络结构在定性和定量上均一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在任务约束下最大化香农熵，会导致神经元群体涌现出上下文增益调制的特定模式；该最大熵连接结构与梯度下降训练得到的网络结构在定性和定量上均一致。；创新点：提出一种独立于具体学习算法的规范性（normative）方法，基于最大熵原理直接推导网络连接结构，避免了梯度下降训练中细节依赖的局限性。
papers.method_zh: 最大熵原理（maximum entropy principle），将连接性建模为单神经元权重的概率分布，通过约束条件求解最大熵分布；将非线性网络映射为增益调制线性模型以实现解析可解性。

papers.title: Superfluid fraction and effective ion mass in the crystalline crust of a neutron star: role of interband response
papers.abstract: Neutron superfluidity in the inner crust of a neutron star is further investigated, focusing on the role of the interband response in the superfluid fraction and the effective mass of crustal ions induced by their motion through the superfluid. Calculations are performed within the linear response theory of the self-consistent time-dependent Hartree-Fock-Bogoliubov equations with Skyrme nuclear energy density functionals in the Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer approximation. The absence of interband response in previous analyses is clarified. The neutron superfluid density is formally shown to be consistent with the entrainment matrix derived earlier in homogeneous neutron-proton superfluid mixture, thus providing a unified description of entrainment effects in the inner crust and outer core of a neutron star within the same microscopic framework. The relative importance of the intraband and interband responses in different regions of the crust is numerically assessed from three-dimensional band-structure calculations, taking into account quantum zero-point motion of ions about their equilibrium position. The neutron superfluid fraction is found to be enhanced by the interband response, resulting in effective ion masses that remain close to the mass of quantum mechanically bound nucleons for realistic neutron pairing gaps. Results are compared to predictions from classical hydrodynamics with different prescriptions for the permeability of ions to superfluidity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：线性响应理论、自洽含时Hartree-Fock-Bogoliubov方程、Skyrme核能量密度泛函、BCS近似等理论框架关键词。；研究对象：中子星内壳层晶体中的中子超流性，具体关注超流分数和晶格离子有效质量，以及能带间响应对二者的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 能带间响应会增强中子超流分数，使得在真实中子配对能隙下，晶格离子的有效质量仍接近量子力学束缚核子的质量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：能带间响应会增强中子超流分数，使得在真实中子配对能隙下，晶格离子的有效质量仍接近量子力学束缚核子的质量。；创新点：澄清了以往分析中缺失的能带间响应，并形式化证明了中子超流密度与早期均匀中子-质子超流混合物中导出的熵曳矩阵一致，从而在同一微观框架下统一描述了中子星内壳层和外壳层中的熵曳效应。
papers.method_zh: 基于自洽含时Hartree-Fock-Bogoliubov方程的线性响应理论，采用Skyrme核能量密度泛函和BCS近似；通过三维能带结构计算，数值评估了能带内和能带间响应的相对重要性，并考虑了离子围绕平衡位置的量子零点运动。

papers.title: Hydrodynamics constrain choanoflagellate collar geometry
papers.abstract: As the closest living relatives of animals, choanoflagellates exhibit remarkable diversity. Even their microvilli collar, used to filter and capture food, varies significantly among species. This diversity suggests either strong environmental adaptation or an insensitivity to the collar geometry. Previous hydrodynamic studies have suggested that the pressure change across the collar is similar across species. In this study, we show that hydrodynamics imposes additional geometric constraints on the choanoflagellate collar. We create a simplified, reduced-order model that neglects finite collar length to investigate how the microvillus radius and the gap between microvilli influence the flow. Comparing with biological data reveals significant variation in the pressure drop between species. Additionally, a ridge emerges in the microvilli radius-gap phase space, along which both effective flux and power dissipation are maximised. Notably, several species cluster near the flux ridge but lie away from the power dissipation ridge. These observations suggest that choanoflagellate collars do not necessarily share a similar pressure drop. Instead, their geometry is influenced by the competing demands of maximising flux and minimising power costs. The broad variation observed among species is made possible by these ridge-like structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：hydrodynamic studies、reduced-order model、phase space分析。；研究对象：领鞭毛虫（choanoflagellate）的微绒毛领（microvilli collar）几何结构，具体研究微绒毛半径与微绒毛间隙对流体过滤效率的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 领鞭毛虫的微绒毛领几何结构并非在所有物种中保持相似的压力降，而是受到最大化通量与最小化能量消耗的竞争约束；在微绒毛半径-间隙相图中存在一条“通量脊”，多个物种聚集在该脊附近，但远离“耗散脊”。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：领鞭毛虫的微绒毛领几何结构并非在所有物种中保持相似的压力降，而是受到最大化通量与最小化能量消耗的竞争约束；在微绒毛半径-间隙相图中存在一条“通量脊”，多个物种聚集在该脊附近，但远离“耗散脊”。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但相对于此前认为不同物种间领部压力降相似的观点，本研究揭示了流体动力学对领几何结构的额外约束，并发现物种几何分布受通量与耗散竞争驱动。
papers.method_zh: 采用简化降阶模型（reduced-order model），忽略有限领长效应，通过流体动力学分析微绒毛半径与间隙对流动的影响，并与生物学数据进行比较。

papers.title: A DMFT approach to evaluate electronic frictional effects near solid surfaces of strongly correlated systems
papers.abstract: Electronic friction-Langevin dynamics (EF-LD) provides an efficient framework for capturing nonadiabatic effects at solid surfaces, with particular relevance to electrochemistry and molecular electronics. In this work, we investigate electronic friction in the two-dimensional Hubbard-Holstein model employing dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT), where the full density-matrix numerical renormalization group (FDM-NRG) serves as the impurity solver. Our results are benchmarked against mean-field theory (MFT). DMFT yields two distinct peaks in the electronic friction, arising from electron attachment/detachment resonances with the solid Fermi level, whereas MFT is unable to capture this Fermi resonance. We further examine the dynamics of electronic friction via EF-LD simulations. Our simulations uncover significant discrepancies mainly in the electronic population evolution predicted by MFT versus DMFT, indicating that MFT is inadequate for describing nonadiabatic dynamics in strongly correlated systems. Thanks to its flexibility and computational efficiency, the proposed DMFT-based approach can be readily extended to a broad range of applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：DMFT、FDM-NRG、EF-LD模拟、MFT基准对比。；研究对象：强关联体系（二维Hubbard-Holstein模型）在固体表面附近的电子摩擦效应，以及非绝热动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: DMFT计算显示电子摩擦存在两个由电子附着/脱离与固体费米能级共振引起的独立峰，而平均场理论（MFT）无法捕捉这一费米共振；EF-LD模拟表明MFT在描述强关联体系的非绝热动力学时存在显著偏差。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：DMFT计算显示电子摩擦存在两个由电子附着/脱离与固体费米能级共振引起的独立峰，而平均场理论（MFT）无法捕捉这一费米共振；EF-LD模拟表明MFT在描述强关联体系的非绝热动力学时存在显著偏差。；创新点：首次将DMFT框架应用于强关联体系（Hubbard-Holstein模型）的电子摩擦计算，揭示了MFT无法描述的费米共振双峰结构，并展示了该方法在计算效率和灵活性上的优势，可推广至更广泛的应用场景。
papers.method_zh: 采用动力学平均场理论（DMFT）结合全密度矩阵数值重整化群（FDM-NRG）作为杂质求解器，并辅以电子摩擦-朗之万动力学（EF-LD）模拟，以平均场理论（MFT）作为基准对比。

papers.title: Accelerated Simulation Algorithms for Extreme First-Passage Problems with General Emission Profiles
papers.abstract: Fastest arrival events, where the first among many diffusing particles reaches a target, are central in triggering signal initiation in molecular stochastic systems. Classical approaches to simulate such events rely on full trajectory generation of all particles, leading to prohibitive computational costs in the large particle number regime. In this work, we present a general simulation framework for efficiently generating order statistics of arrival times by exploiting asymptotic first-passage distributions. This framework applies to diffusion processes in bounded domains with localized absorbing targets, for which short-time first-passage asymptotics are available, such as Brownian motion in dimensions one, two, and three. Starting with the case of instantaneous emission, we derive and implement a recursive inverse transform algorithm to simulate the first $k$ arrivals without tracking particle trajectories. We extend this algorithm to time-dependent emission profiles via an iterative approach, enabling the simulation of extreme statistics in systems with temporal injection, ranging from rapid to prolonged emission. Additionally, we provide asymptotic estimates of the mean fastest arrival time. To conclude, the present acceleration algorithm which bypasses Brownian simulations of trajectories can be used for spatial reaction networks, rare event detection, or diffusion-controlled activation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：simulation algorithms, asymptotic first-passage distributions, recursive inverse transform algorithm。；研究对象：极端首次通过问题（Extreme First-Passage Problems），具体指大量扩散粒子中第一个（或前k个）到达特定吸收目标的时间统计。物理背景是分子随机系统中的信号触发。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种无需追踪所有粒子轨迹即可高效模拟大量扩散粒子首次到达时间顺序统计量的通用算法框架，并给出了平均最快到达时间的渐近估计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种无需追踪所有粒子轨迹即可高效模拟大量扩散粒子首次到达时间顺序统计量的通用算法框架，并给出了平均最快到达时间的渐近估计。；创新点：通过利用渐近分布绕过对布朗粒子轨迹的全模拟，显著降低了在大粒子数体系下模拟极端首次通过事件的计算成本，并将该方法从瞬时发射推广到了任意时间依赖的发射轮廓。
papers.method_zh: 基于短时首次通过渐近分布，开发了递归逆变换算法（用于瞬时发射情况）和迭代扩展算法（用于时间依赖发射情况）。该方法适用于一、二、三维有界域中的布朗运动。

papers.title: Exact Variance and Fano Factor for Arbitrary Level Crossings in Stationary Gaussian Processes
papers.abstract: Understanding the statistics of level crossings in stochastic processes is crucial across many scientific disciplines. The traditional Kac-Rice formula gives the mean rate of level crossings and has found broad use. However, that mean rate captures only a coarse summary of the crossing process. It depends entirely on local properties of the stochastic process at a given instant and is therefore blind to the correlation structure of the process over time. To understand whether crossing events, such as neuronal spikes, tend to cluster in time, spread apart, or exhibit more complex temporal organization, one must go beyond the mean rate and study higher-order crossing statistics. Here we go beyond the mean by deriving the exact analytical formulae for the variance and Fano factor of arbitrary level crossings in smooth stationary Gaussian processes. Our exact solution reveals how the full temporal correlation structure dictates whether crossings cluster or become regular. In systems with oscillatory correlations, such as a stochastic damped harmonic oscillator, a recent crossing suppresses an immediate subsequent one, producing sub-Poissonian statistics. However, as damping increases and oscillations disappear, a large and slow excursion above the threshold can produce multiple closely spaced crossings, yielding super-Poissonian statistics. In purely relaxational, non-oscillatory systems, such as a mean-reverting process driven by Ornstein-Uhlenbeck noise, the competition between the timescales of the driving noise and system relaxation produces a richer landscape, including reentrant transitions between sub- and super-Poissonian statistics as the threshold level is varied. Taken together, the exact variance and Fano factor derived here complement the Kac-Rice mean rate, enabling more robust parameter estimation and model selection across any setting where Gaussian processes are used.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“推导出精确解析公式”“exact analytical formulae”，属于纯理论推导。；研究对象：平稳高斯过程中任意水平穿越事件的方差与Fano因子统计量。具体物理现象包括：随机阻尼谐振子的穿越聚类行为、均值回复过程（Ornstein-Uhlenbeck噪声驱动）的穿越统计。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出平稳高斯过程任意水平穿越的方差与Fano因子的精确解析公式，揭示了时间相关结构如何决定穿越事件是聚集（超泊松统计）还是规则化（亚泊松统计），并发现非振荡系统中驱动噪声与系统弛豫时间尺度竞争可导致随阈值变化的再入式亚/超泊松统计转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出平稳高斯过程任意水平穿越的方差与Fano因子的精确解析公式，揭示了时间相关结构如何决定穿越事件是聚集（超泊松统计）还是规则化（亚泊松统计），并发现非振荡系统中驱动噪声与系统弛豫时间尺度竞争可导致随阈值变化的再入式亚/超泊松统计转变。；创新点：首次给出任意水平穿越方差与Fano因子的精确解析解，突破了Kac-Rice公式仅能描述平均率的局限，将穿越统计与过程的完整时间相关结构直接关联。摘要未突出说明是否包含数值验证或与实验数据的对比。
papers.method_zh: 解析理论推导：基于平稳高斯过程的完整时间相关函数，超越传统Kac-Rice平均率公式，直接计算穿越数方差与Fano因子的精确表达式。

papers.title: Extracting Universal Entanglement Scaling from Mixed Fermionic Gaussian States via Entanglement Projected Entropy
papers.abstract: Identifying spatial quantum correlations in mixed states is challenging because thermal mixed-state contributions obscure the entanglement encoded in subsystem entropy. Here, we introduce the entanglement projected entropy, a diagnostic for extracting boundary-sensitive quantum correlations from mixed fermionic Gaussian states. By resolving subsystem entropy into Gaussian entanglement channels and projecting their purification partners onto the physical complement, we obtain a closed-form expression in terms of the physical covariance matrix. In a one-dimensional free-fermion chain, it removes the volume-law mixed-state background and recovers the zero-temperature conformal scaling with the $c/3$ coefficient. In a two-dimensional half-filled $π$-flux model, it reveals a universal finite-temperature scaling collapse governed by an effective Dirac infrared length. These results establish entanglement projected entropy as a Gaussian spatial filter for boundary-sensitive quantum correlations hidden in mixed-state entropy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提出新的理论诊断方法（entanglement projected entropy），并基于协方差矩阵推导闭式表达式，未提及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：混合费米子高斯态中的空间量子关联，具体在一维自由费米子链和二维半填充π-通量模型中进行验证。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 纠缠投影熵能够从混合态熵中提取出边界敏感的量子关联，在一维体系中恢复零温共形场论的c/3标度，在二维π-通量模型中揭示由有效狄拉克红外长度控制的普适有限温度标度塌缩。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：纠缠投影熵能够从混合态熵中提取出边界敏感的量子关联，在一维体系中恢复零温共形场论的c/3标度，在二维π-通量模型中揭示由有效狄拉克红外长度控制的普适有限温度标度塌缩。；创新点：提出一种从混合态熵中过滤体积律背景、提取边界敏感量子关联的“高斯空间滤波器”方法，首次在混合费米子高斯态中实现普适纠缠标度行为的提取。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于费米子高斯态的协方差矩阵，将子系统熵分解为高斯纠缠通道，并通过投影净化伙伴到物理补集，得到纠缠投影熵的闭式表达式。

papers.title: Dissipative preparation of injective tensor network states
papers.abstract: The preparation of tensor network states is a fundamental prerequisite for a wide range of quantum simulation tasks. While many unitary protocols for preparing these states have been investigated, dissipative state preparation provides a powerful alternative since it can be robust to noise and initialization errors. In this paper, we construct both continuous-time and discrete-time geometrically local dissipative processes whose unique steady state is a given injective tensor network state. Our method prepares all injective matrix product states on $N$ sites to an error $\varepsilon$ in $O(\log (N/\varepsilon))$ time, yielding an exponential improvement over previously known dissipative preparation schemes. For two and higher-dimensional tensor network states, we prove that when the tensors of the state are \emph{highly injective}, the constructed dissipative processes are rapid-mixing i.e., they prepare a state $\varepsilon$-close to the $N$-site target state in $O( \log (N/\varepsilon))$ time. For these states, our approach provides a polynomial speedup over known unitary methods for states defined on lattices and an exponential speedup for states on general bounded-degree graphs. We corroborate our theoretical results with numerical studies that indicate that the dissipative protocol can rapidly prepares states outside the high-injectivity assumption.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：dissipative state preparation（耗散态制备）、construct（构建）、prove（证明）、numerical studies（数值研究）。；研究对象：张量网络态（tensor network states），特别是内射张量网络态（injective tensor network states），包括一维矩阵乘积态（MPS）和二维及以上维度的张量网络态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 本文构建了连续时间和离散时间的几何局域耗散过程，其唯一稳态为给定的内射张量网络态。对于一维内射MPS，制备误差ε所需时间为O(log(N/ε))，相比已知耗散方案实现了指数加速；对于高维高度内射张量网络态，同样实现了O(log(N/ε))的快速混合，并在晶格态上相对于已知幺正方法获得多项式加速，在一般有界度图上获得指数加速。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：本文构建了连续时间和离散时间的几何局域耗散过程，其唯一稳态为给定的内射张量网络态。对于一维内射MPS，制备误差ε所需时间为O(log(N/ε))，相比已知耗散方案实现了指数加速；对于高维高度内射张量网络态，同样实现了O(log(N/ε))的快速混合，并在晶格态上相对于已知幺正方法获得多项式加速，在一般有界度图上获得指数加速。；创新点：首次提出能够以对数时间（相对于系统尺寸N和误差ε）制备任意内射张量网络态的耗散协议，显著优于此前已知的耗散制备方案。摘要未突出说明与具体物理实现平台的关联。
papers.method_zh: 理论构建与数值验证。具体包括：构造几何局域的连续时间（continuous-time）和离散时间（discrete-time）耗散过程；利用快速混合（rapid-mixing）理论分析收敛时间；通过数值模拟验证高内射假设之外的状态也能快速制备。

papers.title: Separable Force Matching of PBE0 Hybrid-Functional Reference Forces for Path-Integral Simulations of Liquid Water
papers.abstract: Force-matched water models provide a practical route from first-principles reference data to long classical and path-integral molecular simulations. Previous flexible four-site potentials in the spirit of q-TIP4P/F showed that fitting analytic models to density-functional-theory forces can reproduce key structural features of liquid water while retaining the efficiency required for quantum-nuclear sampling. Here we introduce two refinements aimed at making this strategy more accurate and more reproducible for molecular simulation. First, the production fit is based on PBE0 hybrid-functional reference forces and therefore includes the Hartree--Fock exact-exchange contribution in the electronic-structure target. Second, the parametrization is formulated as a separable nonlinear least-squares problem in which all linear force-field amplitudes are eliminated analytically for every trial set of nonlinear shape parameters. The resulting force-matching protocol lowers the dimension of the nonlinear search, reduces compensation between heterogeneous parameters, and enables a controlled comparison of Lennard-Jones and Buckingham oxygen--oxygen repulsion terms. Applied to CP2K reference forces for liquid water, the projected optimization reproduces target force distributions and yields radial distribution functions close to first-principles and neutron-scattering benchmarks. The Buckingham representation gives a more flexible short-range repulsive wall than a purely Lennard-Jones form, and the final flexible model remains stable in path-integral simulations. The method provides a transparent workflow for deriving simulation-ready water potentials from accurate hybrid density-functional reference forces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“force-matched water models”、“first-principles reference data”、“density-functional-theory forces”、“path-integral simulations”等关键词，属于基于第一性原理参考数据的力场拟合与分子模拟计算。；研究对象：液态水（liquid water），具体为基于PBE0杂化泛函参考力的可分离力匹配水模型，用于经典和路径积分分子动力学模拟。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将力匹配参数化问题表述为可分离非线性最小二乘问题，并基于PBE0杂化泛函参考力进行拟合，可以更准确、更可重复地构建适用于路径积分模拟的柔性水势，所得径向分布函数接近第一性原理和中子散射基准。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将力匹配参数化问题表述为可分离非线性最小二乘问题，并基于PBE0杂化泛函参考力进行拟合，可以更准确、更可重复地构建适用于路径积分模拟的柔性水势，所得径向分布函数接近第一性原理和中子散射基准。；创新点：1）首次将PBE0杂化泛函参考力用于力匹配水模型构建，引入精确交换贡献；2）将参数化问题表述为可分离非线性最小二乘问题，线性力场振幅可解析消去，降低非线性搜索维度，减少异质参数间的补偿效应，并实现Lennard-Jones与Buckingham氧-氧排斥项的可控比较。
papers.method_zh: 可分离非线性最小二乘力匹配方法（separable nonlinear least-squares force matching），基于PBE0杂化泛函（包含Hartree-Fock精确交换贡献）的CP2K参考力数据，对比Lennard-Jones和Buckingham形式的氧-氧排斥项，最终构建柔性四点水模型（类似q-TIP4P/F）。

papers.title: Thermal Spin Polarization Driven by Nuclear Spin-Orbit Coupling in Neutron Star Pasta
papers.abstract: We discuss anomalous spin polarization on the surface of nuclear pasta in a neutron star, driven by a nuclear spin-orbit interaction. We present an effective two-band model of surface-localized neutrons near the nuclear pasta. The central point is the emergence of a Rashba-type spin-orbit hybridization generated by the neutron--nucleus spin-orbit force in the presence of the strong density gradient normal to the pasta surface. Starting from a single-particle Hamiltonian with a central potential and a standard nuclear spin-orbit interaction, we show that the surface spin polarization occurs due to the thermal inhomogeneity even in the absence of a magnetic field. Our study links neutron-star physics and solid-state spintronics and would contribute to understanding the interplay between spin dynamics and strong magnetic fields.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：discuss、present an effective two-band model、show、starting from a single-particle Hamiltonian。；研究对象：中子星核意面（nuclear pasta）表面的反常自旋极化现象，具体涉及表面局域中子由核自旋-轨道耦合驱动的热自旋极化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在中子星核意面表面，即使不存在外磁场，仅由温度不均匀性（热非均匀性）即可通过中子-原子核自旋-轨道力产生类似Rashba型的自旋-轨道杂化，从而驱动表面自旋极化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在中子星核意面表面，即使不存在外磁场，仅由温度不均匀性（热非均匀性）即可通过中子-原子核自旋-轨道力产生类似Rashba型的自旋-轨道杂化，从而驱动表面自旋极化。；创新点：将中子星物理与固态自旋电子学联系起来，揭示了核自旋-轨道耦合在无磁场条件下由热非均匀性驱动自旋极化的新机制。
papers.method_zh: 构建了一个有效双带模型来描述核意面表面局域中子，从包含中心势和标准核自旋-轨道相互作用的单粒子哈密顿量出发进行理论推导。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning for Laser Additive Manufacturing Scan-Order Optimisation: A Bilevel Proxy--FEA Diagnostic Framework for Reward and World-Model Diagnosis
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning offers a promising approach for scan-order optimisation in laser additive manufacturing, where sequential scan decisions critically influence thermal accumulation, residual stress, distortion, and final part quality. A central challenge in applying RL to this domain lies in reward and world-model fidelity: full finite-element analysis is computationally prohibitive for dense in-the-loop evaluation, while cheap thermo-inspired proxy metrics, though efficient, may capture only partial aspects of the true thermo-mechanical objectives. This paper investigates a bilevel Proxy--FEA diagnostic framework for reward and world-model diagnosis in reinforcement-learning-guided scan-order optimisation. The lower level employs lightweight scan-path and thermo-inspired proxies for rapid candidate generation and preliminary policy-side screening, while the upper level utilises sparse Abaqus FEA simulations to provide simulation-based reference labels. The framework is examined on a simplified whole-track heating LDED32 stripe benchmark comprising ten representative scan strategies. Final-cooling residual Mises stress, U3 vertical distortion, and PEEQ plasticity metrics reveal an observed stress--distortion trade-off rather than a single monotonic quality objective. Within the evaluated set, the center_out strategy emerges as a robust compromise candidate, while raster_left_to_right and edge_in form opposing endpoints of the trade-off. Proxy--FEA alignment analysis shows that current cheap path-based metrics predominantly capture distortion-related (U3) behaviour and exhibit only weak correlation with the sparse FEA reference labels. These findings highlight that proxy-only reward designs risk misalignment in future RL training and underscore the value of sparse FEA reference signals for diagnostic-guided reward and world-model refinement prior to large-scale policy optimisation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据关键词：reinforcement learning（强化学习）、finite-element analysis（有限元分析）、simulation（模拟）、diagnostic framework（诊断框架）。；研究对象：激光增材制造（laser additive manufacturing）中的扫描顺序优化问题，具体涉及热积累、残余应力、变形和最终零件质量等热力学物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在激光增材制造扫描顺序优化中，存在应力与变形之间的权衡（stress–distortion trade-off），而非单一单调的质量目标；当前基于廉价路径的代理指标主要捕捉变形行为，与有限元参考标签相关性弱，可能导致强化学习奖励设计失配。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在激光增材制造扫描顺序优化中，存在应力与变形之间的权衡（stress–distortion trade-off），而非单一单调的质量目标；当前基于廉价路径的代理指标主要捕捉变形行为，与有限元参考标签相关性弱，可能导致强化学习奖励设计失配。；创新点：提出了一个双层诊断框架，将廉价代理指标与稀疏有限元模拟结合，用于诊断强化学习中的奖励函数和世界模型保真度，揭示了代理指标与真实热力学目标之间的对齐程度及潜在风险。
papers.method_zh: 采用双层代理-有限元分析（bilevel Proxy–FEA）诊断框架：下层使用轻量级扫描路径和热学启发代理指标进行快速候选生成和策略筛选；上层使用稀疏的Abaqus有限元模拟提供参考标签。在简化全轨迹加热LDED32条带基准上评估了十种代表性扫描策略。

papers.title: Time-Symmetry of Lagrangian Coherent Structures in Active Turbulence
papers.abstract: Active flows are central to mixing and transport across living systems. While Newtonian fluids remain laminar, diffusive and predictable at the microscale, living fluids like dense bacterial suspensions can exhibit highly chaotic flows like active turbulence, with anomalous transport capabilities. The underlying spatiotemporally persistent structures that drive mixing in active flows, however, remain uncharted. Using Lagrangian Coherent Structures, we now uncover networks of attracting and repelling hyperbolic surfaces. We study changes in the distribution and spectra of Finite-Time Lyapunov Exponent fields in response to increasing activity. Despite the dominance of vorticity in the flow, extreme forward and backward time chaotic mixing is found to originate from straining regions, emphasizing the role of saddles. Fractal dimensions of ridges reveal a morphological simplification of LCS networks with increasing activity, while retaining isotropic crossing. Throughout our work, we also probe a hitherto unasked question-Are signatures of Lagrangian irreversibility manifest in attracting and repelling LCS? To the contrary, we find there is a striking time-symmetry. Our work takes the first steps towards linking flow structures in active turbulence to invariant mixing surfaces. These findings will crucially help in designing activity modulation protocols to seed or inhibit flow structures, and thence mixing, in a bid to tame active turbulence for varied applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Lagrangian Coherent Structures、Finite-Time Lyapunov Exponent fields、Fractal dimensions。；研究对象：活性湍流（active turbulence）中的拉格朗日相干结构（Lagrangian Coherent Structures），具体体系为密集细菌悬浮液等活性流体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 活性湍流中吸引和排斥的拉格朗日相干结构网络表现出显著的时间对称性，而非预期的拉格朗日不可逆性；极端混沌混合源于应变区域（鞍点），而非涡旋主导区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：活性湍流中吸引和排斥的拉格朗日相干结构网络表现出显著的时间对称性，而非预期的拉格朗日不可逆性；极端混沌混合源于应变区域（鞍点），而非涡旋主导区域。；创新点：首次在活性湍流中系统研究拉格朗日相干结构网络，并揭示其时间对称性，挑战了活性流动中拉格朗日不可逆性的直觉预期。
papers.method_zh: 采用拉格朗日相干结构（LCS）方法，通过计算有限时间李雅普诺夫指数（FTLE）场的分布与谱，分析脊线的分形维数，并比较前向与后向时间演化下的结构对称性。

papers.title: DNA end tethering through break-induced DNA--protein condensation
papers.abstract: Cells deploy robust mechanisms to repair DNA damage, safeguarding genomic stability and cellular health, but the physical principles underlying these processes remain incompletely understood. Experiments show \emph{in vitro} that upon a DNA double-strand break, a DNA--protein condensate can tether the broken DNA ends before they disperse away, a critical step for subsequent repair biochemistry. However, it remains puzzling how such condensation reliably achieves spatiotemporal localization at the break site and captures both broken ends despite intrinsic stochasticity. Here, we propose that broken DNA ends can trigger a conversion of proteins from a soluble state to a condensate-competent state. Combining this idea with Brownian dynamics simulations and theory, we propose a physical mechanism for reliable DNA-end tethering. Simulations show that such break-induced conversion can drive local DNA--protein condensation with two possible outcomes: successful or failed tethering. To rationalize this, we construct an effective free energy landscape, identify the corresponding stationary states, and demonstrate that tethering is governed by a kinetic competition between polymer relaxation and condensation dynamics. Together, our study shows that DNA end-dependent conversion, coupled with DNA--protein condensation, can reliably tether broken DNA ends.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（结合计算）。判断依据：提出物理机制、构建自由能景观、使用布朗动力学模拟和理论分析。；研究对象：DNA双链断裂后，由DNA-蛋白质凝聚体（condensate）介导的断裂末端拴系（tethering）过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 断裂的DNA末端可以触发蛋白质从可溶态向凝聚态转化，这种断裂诱导的转化与DNA-蛋白质凝聚动力学之间的竞争，决定了末端拴系的成功与否。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：断裂的DNA末端可以触发蛋白质从可溶态向凝聚态转化，这种断裂诱导的转化与DNA-蛋白质凝聚动力学之间的竞争，决定了末端拴系的成功与否。；创新点：提出了“断裂诱导的蛋白质状态转换”这一新概念，并以此为基础建立了DNA末端可靠拴系的物理机制，解释了在内在随机性下如何实现时空定位与双末端捕获。
papers.method_zh: 布朗动力学模拟（Brownian dynamics simulations）与理论分析（构建有效自由能景观、识别稳态）。

papers.title: Defect Conformal Manifolds along RG Domain Walls between $\mathbb Z_N$-Parafermions and Minimal Models
papers.abstract: We investigate the renormalization group (RG) domain walls interpolating between the $\mathbb{Z}_N$ parafermion theory (the critical $N$-state Potts model) and the Virasoro minimal model $\mathcal{M}_{N+1}$. These flows are genuinely non-perturbative and an explicit construction of Gaiotto type RG domain wall remains elusive. We bypass this limitation by employing a bottom-up approach centered on the emergence of ``phantom currents". By tracking the preserved non-invertible symmetries ($\mathfrak{so}(3)_N$) along the flow, we extract the exact spectrum of these currents localized on the defect. We demonstrate that the presence of a spin-1 phantom current allows the interface to be marginally deformed, dynamically generating a continuous defect conformal manifold. Furthermore, we show that an extra spin-2 operator, crucially as a $W^{(3)}$-algebra descendant of the spin-1 phantom current, rigidly constrains the UV-IR stress tensor mixing via the cluster decomposition principle. This algebraic framework enables the exact computation of the parameter-dependent transmission rate across the conformal manifold, which we observe strictly vanishes in the large-$N$ limit as a consequence of macroscopic target space collapse.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、bottom-up approach、algebraic framework、exact computation。；研究对象：重整化群（RG）畴壁，具体插值于 $\mathbb{Z}_N$ 顺铁理论（临界 $N$ 态 Potts 模型）与 Virasoro 极小模型 $\mathcal{M}_{N+1}$ 之间的界面。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过追踪沿 RG 流保持的非可逆对称性，发现自旋-1 的“幻影流”允许界面发生边缘形变，从而动态生成一个连续的缺陷共形流形；同时，自旋-2 算符（作为 $W^{(3)}$ 代数的后代）通过团簇分解原理严格约束了 UV-IR 应力张量混合，并使得跨共形流形的透射率在大 $N$ 极限下严格为零。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过追踪沿 RG 流保持的非可逆对称性，发现自旋-1 的“幻影流”允许界面发生边缘形变，从而动态生成一个连续的缺陷共形流形；同时，自旋-2 算符（作为 $W^{(3)}$ 代数的后代）通过团簇分解原理严格约束了 UV-IR 应力张量混合，并使得跨共形流形的透射率在大 $N$ 极限下严格为零。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用自下而上的方法，聚焦于“幻影流”的出现，通过追踪沿 RG 流保持的非可逆对称性（$\mathfrak{so}(3)_N$）来提取缺陷上局域流的精确谱，并利用代数框架（$W^{(3)}$ 代数）计算参数依赖的透射率。

papers.title: Geometry, elasticity, and activity in the transport of self-propelled filaments in turbulence
papers.abstract: We investigate the transport of elastic active filaments in two-dimensional turbulence, focusing on how propulsion geometry and elasticity determine vortex trapping and transport. Using a bead-spring model with activity applied at the filament head, we compare propulsion that follows the instantaneous filament conformation with propulsion imposed along a fixed external direction. We find that activity does not generically enhance transport: when propulsion remains coupled to the filament backbone, vortex trapping remains dominant and motion stays effectively diffusive, whereas fixed-direction propulsion enables persistent excursions across flow structures and leads to superdiffusive transport. In both cases, activity shifts filament conformations toward more extended states, effectively opposing elastic relaxation without eliminating preferential sampling of coherent vortical regions. At low Weissenberg number, this conformational change is amplified: activity cooperates with elasticity to enhance preferential sampling of vortical regions and strengthen vortex trapping. Transport therefore emerges from a competition between activity, elasticity, and flow-induced deformation, with elasticity determining how effectively activity-induced extensions can persist against turbulent trapping. These results establish propulsion geometry as the key control parameter for transport, with elasticity and activity acting cooperatively rather than independently to shape filament dynamics in turbulent flows.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：使用bead-spring模型进行数值模拟，分析活动性、弹性与湍流耦合的动力学行为。；研究对象：二维湍流中自推进弹性细丝（self-propelled elastic filaments）的输运行为，重点研究推进几何构型（propulsion geometry）与弹性如何决定涡旋捕获与输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 活动性并不普遍增强输运：当推进力与细丝骨架耦合时，涡旋捕获占主导，运动保持扩散性；而固定方向推进则导致超扩散输运。输运由活动性、弹性与流致变形之间的竞争决定，推进几何构型是关键控制参数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：活动性并不普遍增强输运：当推进力与细丝骨架耦合时，涡旋捕获占主导，运动保持扩散性；而固定方向推进则导致超扩散输运。输运由活动性、弹性与流致变形之间的竞争决定，推进几何构型是关键控制参数。；创新点：揭示了推进几何构型（而非单纯活动性强度）是控制湍流中细丝输运的关键参数，并发现弹性与活动性在影响细丝动力学时是协同而非独立作用。摘要未突出说明与实验或具体材料的直接对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用bead-spring模型，在细丝头部施加活动性（activity），比较两种推进方式：沿瞬时细丝构型推进 vs. 沿固定外部方向推进。在二维湍流场中模拟，分析Weissenberg数（低Wi）下的构型变化与涡旋优先采样行为。

papers.title: Machine-learned atomistic simulations reveal the basis of hydrogen-induced crack-plane transition in alpha-Fe
papers.abstract: Hydrogen-related fracture in body-centered cubic Fe and ferritic steels often appears as transgranular quasi-cleavage rather than purely intergranular failure, especially at low to moderate hydrogen contents. Fractography has suggested that hydrogen may change the dominant cleavage faceting from {100} toward {110}, but atomic-scale evidence for this possible crack-plane transition remains unclear. Here we construct an efficient neural-network potential for α-Fe/H and combine large-scale, three-dimensional molecular dynamics with grand-canonical Monte Carlo (GCMC), allowing the near-tip crack-surface region and crack tip within a defined GCMC domain to exchange hydrogen with a reservoir at fixed chemical potential. A comparison of four crack systems identifies the controlling response: (100)[010], (100)[011], and (110)[001] remain cleavage-dominated, whereas the (110)[1-10] crack changes from dislocation emission in pure Fe to cleavage under hydrogen charging. The energetic origin is twofold. Hydrogen lowers the Griffith cleavage threshold of the {110} cleavage-plane family more strongly than that of {100}, and, for the controlling crack, a Rice-type energetic descriptor indicates that the surface-energy-controlled cleavage resistance decreases faster than the unstable-stacking-fault-controlled emission resistance, consistent with a weakened dislocation-emission shield. These results provide a thermodynamically consistent atomistic basis for a hydrogen-induced transgranular crack-plane transition in Fe.
