papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“derivation”（推导）、“framework”（理论框架）、“establish a common physical foundation”（建立共同物理基础）等关键词，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：多体关联电子态中的广义移位矢量（shift vector），具体涉及非线性光学、输运现象、光致关联、电子-声子介导过程以及激子电子-空穴态中的内禀偶极性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 移位矢量可以更根本地理解为单个关联电子态的内禀偶极矩，而非仅与量子态间跃迁相关的电荷中心位移。这一发现将移位矢量统一为关联电子态的内禀偶极属性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：移位矢量可以更根本地理解为单个关联电子态的内禀偶极矩，而非仅与量子态间跃迁相关的电荷中心位移。这一发现将移位矢量统一为关联电子态的内禀偶极属性。；创新点：将移位矢量从传统的跃迁关联图像重新定义为单个关联态的内禀偶极矩，揭示了其与多体关联内部相干结构的深层联系，并统一了此前在不同物理过程中提出的各类移位矢量表达式。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导。通过分析规范不变性的局域与全局方面、相位梯度项的起源及其与多体关联内部相干结构的联系，建立了单态移位矢量的理论框架，并应用于光致关联、电子-声子介导过程及激子态等具体情形。

papers.title: Nonreciprocal surface tension: anisotropy-induced defect motility and organization
papers.abstract: We show that interfacial nonreciprocity transforms defect dynamics in conserved scalar fields within the framework of the Nonreciprocal Cahn-Hilliard model. Nonreciprocal surface tension alone produces intermittently stable defects: system-spanning target patterns form, lose stability, self-destruct, and nucleate again from a defect-chaotic state. When bulk and interfacial contributions interplay in a particular way, the system forms a distinct mosaic-wave state: traveling waves remain coherent within finite domains demarcated by linear arrangements of motile dislocations, which act as lines of phase slip. Mosaic-waves exhibit scale-free fluctuations at length scales much larger than the average wavelength of the traveling patterns. To explain the wide range of emergent dynamics, we construct the dynamics of the Goldstone-mode. The nonlinearities governing its large-scale fluctuations belong to the anisotropic Kardar-Parisi-Zhang universality class, with the sign of the nonlinear anisotropy controlling the nature of the out-of-equilibrium dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“framework of the Nonreciprocal Cahn-Hilliard model”、“construct the dynamics of the Goldstone-mode”、“belongs to the anisotropic Kardar-Parisi-Zhang universality class”等理论模型和数学分析关键词。；研究对象：非互易Cahn-Hilliard模型框架下的守恒标量场中的界面缺陷动力学，具体研究由非互易表面张力引起的缺陷（如靶形图案、位错）的迁移和组织行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非互易表面张力单独即可产生间歇性稳定的缺陷（如靶形图案），而体相与界面贡献的特定耦合会导致一种新的“马赛克波”态，其中行波在由移动位错线分隔的有限域内保持相干，且该态在远大于行波波长的尺度上表现出无标度涨落。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非互易表面张力单独即可产生间歇性稳定的缺陷（如靶形图案），而体相与界面贡献的特定耦合会导致一种新的“马赛克波”态，其中行波在由移动位错线分隔的有限域内保持相干，且该态在远大于行波波长的尺度上表现出无标度涨落。；创新点：揭示了非互易表面张力本身（而非通常的体非互易性）是驱动缺陷动力学和自组织的关键机制，并发现了一种新的“马赛克波”态及其与各向异性KPZ普适类的关联。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。具体包括：基于非互易Cahn-Hilliard模型进行动力学研究；构建Goldstone模的动力学方程；利用各向异性Kardar-Parisi-Zhang（KPZ）普适类分析控制大尺度涨落的非线性项。

papers.title: Localized Excitonic Emission in Wafer-Scale MOCVD-Grown GaSe 2D Nanosheets for Classical and Non-Classical Light Sources
papers.abstract: Wafer-scale growth of two-dimensional semiconductors remains a key challenge for their integration into photonic technologies. While most studies of two-dimensional semiconductors have focused on transition metal dichalcogenides and their scalable fabrication, comparatively little attention has been given to III-VI monochalcogenides. Here, we report wafer-scale growth of gallium selenide (GaSe) by metal-organic chemical vapor deposition (MOCVD) and investigate its structural and optical properties for visible-range classical and quantum light emission. Two samples with thicknesses ranging from a few monolayers to several micrometers, controlled via the growth time, were investigated. The 30-minute grown sample yields intense, broad photoluminescence spanning 1.7--2.0$\,$eV, whereas the thinner 3-minute sample exhibits discrete narrow emission lines and single-photon emission with $(g^{(2)}(0) = 0.15 \pm 0.10)$. Remarkably, cathodoluminescence mapping reveals pronounced spatial localization of both spectrally narrow and broad emission centers. Together with temperature-dependent power-law analysis and Raman mapping, our results indicate defect-induced emission rather than intrinsic excitonic recombination. These findings establish wafer-scale MOCVD grown 2D GaSe as a platform for classical and non-classical light sources and highlight defect-engineered localization as a route toward scalable quantum photonics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：MOCVD生长、光致发光、阴极发光、拉曼映射、单光子发射测量。；研究对象：二维硒化镓（GaSe）纳米片，具体为通过金属有机化学气相沉积（MOCVD）在晶圆尺度上生长的III-VI族单硫族化物半导体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在MOCVD生长的晶圆级GaSe纳米片中观测到局域化的激子发射，其中较薄样品（3分钟生长）表现出离散窄线发射和单光子发射（g²(0)=0.15±0.10），且所有发射均源于缺陷诱导而非本征激子复合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在MOCVD生长的晶圆级GaSe纳米片中观测到局域化的激子发射，其中较薄样品（3分钟生长）表现出离散窄线发射和单光子发射（g²(0)=0.15±0.10），且所有发射均源于缺陷诱导而非本征激子复合。；创新点：首次在晶圆级MOCVD生长的二维GaSe中同时实现经典宽带发光和量子单光子发射，并明确揭示缺陷工程导致的局域化是发射机制的核心，为可扩展量子光子学提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 金属有机化学气相沉积（MOCVD）生长；光致发光（PL）光谱；阴极发光（CL）成像与映射；温度依赖的幂律分析；拉曼映射；二阶关联函数g²(0)测量。

papers.title: Selective Fermi-Level Pinning: A Design Strategy for Giant Rectification in Molecular Junctions
papers.abstract: Molecular rectifiers are key functional components of molecular-scale integrated circuits, yet achieving high rectification ratios remains a longstanding challenge due to the intrinsic symmetry of resonant tunneling and the complexity of interfacial energy-level alignment. Here, we propose a rectifier design strategy based on selective Fermi-level pinning that breaks transport symmetry via pinning interactions between molecular frontier orbitals and electrodes. This framework enforces tunneling transport to be predominantly governed by unoccupied molecular orbitals, while substantially suppressing contributions from occupied states, thereby establishing a simplified and highly controllable rectification mechanism. The resulting cyclo[n]carbon-based molecular junctions exhibit giant rectification ratios exceeding 103, while retaining exceptional structural robustness against variations in both donor chain length and carbon ring size. This work reveals the critical role of selective Fermi-level pinning in molecular junctions and provides a general design principle for engineering functional single-molecule electronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：propose a rectifier design strategy、framework、design principle。；研究对象：基于选择性费米能级钉扎（selective Fermi-level pinning）的分子整流器，具体体系为环[n]碳（cyclo[n]carbon）分子结。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过选择性费米能级钉扎打破输运对称性，使隧穿输运主要由未占据分子轨道主导，从而在环[n]碳分子结中实现超过10³的巨整流比，且对分子结构变化具有鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过选择性费米能级钉扎打破输运对称性，使隧穿输运主要由未占据分子轨道主导，从而在环[n]碳分子结中实现超过10³的巨整流比，且对分子结构变化具有鲁棒性。；创新点：提出“选择性费米能级钉扎”作为通用设计策略，通过主动利用钉扎效应而非被动避免，实现高度可控且简化的整流机制，克服了传统共振隧穿对称性导致的整流比限制。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架设计：基于分子前线轨道与电极之间的钉扎相互作用（pinning interactions）构建整流机制；未提及具体计算软件或方法（如DFT、NEGF等），摘要未明确说明。

papers.title: Inviscid scaling in the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation from functional renormalization group and direct numerical simulations
papers.abstract: We show that the one-dimensional Kuramoto-Sivashinsky (KS) equation features a scaling regime characterized by the dynamical exponent $z=1$ at intermediate scales between the large-scale Kardar-Parisi-Zhang (KPZ) scaling with $z=3/2$ and the small-scale non-universal behavior. This scaling regime is intrinsic to the KS dynamics since it arises from the vanishing of the effective viscosity when evolving from its microscopic negative KS value, to its macroscopic effective positive KPZ value. This vanishing of the viscosity deeply imprints the behavior of correlations at intermediate scales, which exhibit a universal $z=1$ scaling. This behavior pertains to the inviscid-Burgers universality class, which corresponds to the zero-viscosity fixed point of the KPZ equation. We evidence and characterize this so-far-overlooked scaling regime using both functional renormalization group and direct numerical simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值计算）。判断依据：functional renormalization group（泛函重整化群）、direct numerical simulations（直接数值模拟）。；研究对象：一维Kuramoto-Sivashinsky（KS）方程及其标度行为，特别是中间尺度的动力学标度性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在KS方程中，介于大尺度KPZ标度（z=3/2）与小尺度非普适行为之间，存在一个由动力学指数z=1表征的中间标度区。该标度区源于有效黏度从微观负值向宏观正值的演化过程中消失，属于无黏Burgers普适类。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在KS方程中，介于大尺度KPZ标度（z=3/2）与小尺度非普适行为之间，存在一个由动力学指数z=1表征的中间标度区。该标度区源于有效黏度从微观负值向宏观正值的演化过程中消失，属于无黏Burgers普适类。；创新点：首次发现并表征了KS方程中此前被忽略的z=1中间标度区，并将其归因于有效黏度消失的动力学过程，指出该行为属于KPZ方程的零黏度不动点（无黏Burgers普适类）。
papers.method_zh: 泛函重整化群（functional renormalization group）理论分析，以及直接数值模拟（direct numerical simulations）。

papers.title: Field evolution of the magnetic structure and spin Hamiltonian in Cs$_2$RuO$_4$
papers.abstract: We report neutron diffraction under applied magnetic fields and complementary zero-field neutron spectroscopy measurements on Cs$_2$RuO$_4$. Previous work [Phys. Rev. B. 112, 134436 (2025)] identified a spin-flop-like transition accompanied by a quantum critical point within the ordered phase, attributed to strong frustration between alternating single-ion anisotropy planes. Here, we quantitatively confirm the predicted field evolution of the magnetic structure using neutron diffraction. Furthermore, analysis of the excitation spectrum within an SU(3) spin-wave framework resolves previously undetermined parameters of the minimal spin Hamiltonian and lifts the associated degeneracies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：neutron diffraction、neutron spectroscopy measurements）；研究对象：Cs₂RuO₄ 在磁场下的磁结构演化及其自旋哈密顿量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过中子衍射定量证实了之前预测的磁场下磁结构演化，并利用SU(3)自旋波框架解析了最小自旋哈密顿量中此前未确定的参数，消除了相关简并性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过中子衍射定量证实了之前预测的磁场下磁结构演化，并利用SU(3)自旋波框架解析了最小自旋哈密顿量中此前未确定的参数，消除了相关简并性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 应用磁场下的中子衍射实验、零场中子谱学测量，以及SU(3)自旋波理论框架进行激发谱分析。

papers.title: A Metadynamics-Based Framework for Free Energy Surface Mapping of Multiparticle Diffusion in Crystals
papers.abstract: We propose two metadynamics (MetaD)-based methodologies for efficiently mapping free energy surfaces (FESs) of multiple interacting carriers diffusing in crystalline solids. Our approaches circumvent the challenges of high-dimensional collective variables (CVs) by employing replica state exchange MetaD and parallel bias MetaD, both of which decompose the high-dimensional CVs into multiple lower-dimensional ones. As a benchmark, we investigate two-dimensional lithium (Li) diffusion in LixTiS2 across a wide range of Li concentrations. The Li jump frequencies estimated from the obtained FESs exhibit concentration- and temperature-dependent trends consistent with previous kinetic Monte Carlo simulations and nuclear magnetic resonance measurements. Our approaches provide a promising framework for capturing the slow dynamics of diffusive carriers that are typically inaccessible to conventional molecular dynamics simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：metadynamics (MetaD)、free energy surfaces (FESs)、molecular dynamics simulations。；研究对象：多载流子在晶体中的协同扩散现象，具体以锂离子（Li）在LixTiS2中的二维扩散为基准体系，涵盖不同锂浓度范围。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过所提出的两种基于metadynamics的方法，成功获得了多相互作用载流子的自由能面（FES），并从中提取的锂跳跃频率展现出与先前动力学蒙特卡洛模拟及核磁共振测量一致的浓度和温度依赖趋势。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过所提出的两种基于metadynamics的方法，成功获得了多相互作用载流子的自由能面（FES），并从中提取的锂跳跃频率展现出与先前动力学蒙特卡洛模拟及核磁共振测量一致的浓度和温度依赖趋势。；创新点：提出了一种能够高效映射晶体中多相互作用载流子自由能面的框架，该框架可捕捉传统分子动力学模拟通常无法访问的扩散载流子的慢动力学行为。
papers.method_zh: 采用两种metadynamics变体方法：副本状态交换metadynamics（replica state exchange MetaD）和并行偏置metadynamics（parallel bias MetaD）。这两种方法通过将高维集体变量（CVs）分解为多个低维CVs，克服了高维CVs带来的挑战。

papers.title: Cathodoluminescence Analysis of Defects and Grain Boundaries in Zn3P2 Thin Films Grown on Graphene by MOVPE and MBE
papers.abstract: Zn3P2 is a promising earth-abundant absorber for thin-film photovoltaics, yet its development is hindered by the lack of lattice-matched substrates, its incompatible thermal expansion coefficient, and a complex defect landscape. Here, we demonstrate the quasi-van der Waals epitaxy of Zn3P2 on graphene by metal-organic vapour phase epitaxy (MOVPE) and directly link the density of antiphase boundaries to optical emission modulation using correlative electron microscopy and cathodoluminescence (CL). Moreover, it is observed through CL that grain boundaries act as non-radiative sinks for excited charge carriers. The effect extends several micrometres into the grains, making grain boundaries detrimental to the applicability of Zn3P2 in read devices. Further comparison with molecular beam epitaxy grown films reveals the suppression of strain-related sub-bandgap emission in MOVPE-grown material. Overall, quasi-van der Waals epitaxy of Zn3P2 by MOVPE resulted in larger grains and improved material quality. In addition, these results directly link extended defects to recombination pathways in Zn3P2 and highlight grain-size control as a key strategy for improving earth-abundant photovoltaic absorbers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“correlative electron microscopy and cathodoluminescence (CL)”、“MOVPE”、“molecular beam epitaxy”等实验手段。；研究对象：Zn₃P₂薄膜在石墨烯上的准范德华外延生长，具体研究其缺陷（反相边界）和晶界对光学性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 反相边界密度与光学发射调制直接相关；晶界作为非辐射复合中心，其影响可延伸至晶粒内部数微米，对器件性能有害。MOVPE生长的材料相比MBE具有更大晶粒、更高质量，并抑制了应变相关的亚带隙发射。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：反相边界密度与光学发射调制直接相关；晶界作为非辐射复合中心，其影响可延伸至晶粒内部数微米，对器件性能有害。MOVPE生长的材料相比MBE具有更大晶粒、更高质量，并抑制了应变相关的亚带隙发射。；创新点：首次将Zn₃P₂中反相边界的密度与光学发射调制直接关联，并定量揭示了晶界对载流子复合的非辐射影响范围（数微米），同时对比了MOVPE与MBE两种生长方法在抑制应变相关缺陷方面的差异。
papers.method_zh: 金属有机气相外延（MOVPE）和分子束外延（MBE）生长Zn₃P₂薄膜；关联电子显微镜与阴极发光（CL）光谱技术进行表征。

papers.title: Studying Creep-Fatigue interaction of Nickel-Based Superalloys using Crystal Plasticity and Entropy-Based life prediction model
papers.abstract: Creep-fatigue interaction in single-crystal nickel superalloys is difficult to predict because the response depends on the combined effects of loading parameters, hold time, temperature, and the underlying deformation mechanisms. This is important for turbine blade applications, where components experience both fatigue and creep during service. In the present work, a crystal plasticity finite element (CPFE) framework is used to study the creep-fatigue response of a single-crystal nickel superalloy under a range of practically relevant thermo-mechanical loading conditions. In particular, the effects of strain amplitude, R-ratio, hold duration, and temperature on cyclic deformation, stress relaxation, damage evolution, and creep-fatigue life are examined. Particular attention is given to separate the roles of fatigue and creep damage, understanding their interaction, and identify the creep-dominated and fatigue-dominated regimes as a function of strain amplitude and hold time. The study brings together these effects within a single framework and shows that the predicted trends in cyclic response and life are in good agreement with experimental observations reported in the literature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：crystal plasticity finite element (CPFE) framework、framework、predicted trends）；研究对象：单晶镍基高温合金的蠕变-疲劳交互作用（creep-fatigue interaction），具体涉及涡轮叶片服役条件下的热-机械加载响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过晶体塑性有限元框架，成功分离了疲劳损伤与蠕变损伤的贡献，识别出随应变幅值和保载时间变化的蠕变主导与疲劳主导区域，预测的循环响应和寿命趋势与文献实验观测吻合良好。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过晶体塑性有限元框架，成功分离了疲劳损伤与蠕变损伤的贡献，识别出随应变幅值和保载时间变化的蠕变主导与疲劳主导区域，预测的循环响应和寿命趋势与文献实验观测吻合良好。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断其创新在于将应变幅值、R-比、保载时长和温度等多种因素统一在一个框架内，并系统区分了疲劳与蠕变损伤的各自作用及交互机制。
papers.method_zh: 晶体塑性有限元（CPFE）框架，用于模拟不同应变幅值、R-比、保载时长和温度下的循环变形、应力松弛、损伤演化及蠕变-疲劳寿命。

papers.title: Orientational frustration drives enhanced diffusion of anisotropic particles in a liquid labyrinth
papers.abstract: Transport of nanoscale objects in complex, structured environments plays a key role in a wide range of processes, from biomolecular dynamics in extracellular spaces to transport in porous materials such as filters and catalysts. While anomalous diffusion is well established, how particle anisotropy governs transport under geometric constraints remains unclear. Here we use 3D single-particle tracking to investigate the diffusion of stiff one-dimensional carbon nanotubes in a continuous soft matter network of interconnected chambers and constrictions. Transport is anomalous and antipersistent, with strong length dependent confinement and trapping, consistent with obstructed diffusion. Unexpectedly, however, escape from confinement is poorly sensitive to nanotube length as opposed to what would be expected of pore mediated transport. Despite a tenfold length increase and significantly enhanced trapping, escape time increased by only ~1.4. Single-particle orientational tracking reveals the origin of this weak scaling. Indeed, long nanotube, i.e. those with length comparable to the chamber dimensions, dynamically align with constrictions enabling efficient, geometry-assisted escape that offsets increased confinement while shorter nanotubes need to screen the volume to find their escape path. These results uncover an alignment-mediated transport mechanism that decouples confinement strength from escape kinetics, distinct from pore-mediated transport mechanisms, establishing a quantitative framework for anisotropic diffusion in complex environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：3D single-particle tracking（三维单粒子追踪实验）。；研究对象：各向异性粒子（刚性一维碳纳米管）在连续软物质网络（由相互连通的腔室和收缩通道构成的“液体迷宫”）中的扩散行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 长碳纳米管（长度与腔室尺寸相当）通过动态对齐收缩通道实现几何辅助逃逸，使得逃逸时间对粒子长度的依赖性极弱（长度增加10倍，逃逸时间仅增加约1.4倍），从而解耦了约束强度与逃逸动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：长碳纳米管（长度与腔室尺寸相当）通过动态对齐收缩通道实现几何辅助逃逸，使得逃逸时间对粒子长度的依赖性极弱（长度增加10倍，逃逸时间仅增加约1.4倍），从而解耦了约束强度与逃逸动力学。；创新点：揭示了一种由取向对齐介导的输运机制，该机制不同于传统的孔隙介导输运，能够使各向异性粒子在几何约束下实现高效逃逸，并建立了复杂环境中各向异性扩散的定量框架。
papers.method_zh: 三维单粒子追踪技术，用于实时追踪碳纳米管在软物质网络中的扩散轨迹、取向及逃逸行为。

papers.title: Memory-driven topological ordering during the transition from dormant to migrating epithelia
papers.abstract: Transitions from quiescence to collective migration in epithelia underlie wound healing and cancer invasion, yet their physical origin remains poorly understood. Here we show that quiescent epithelial monolayers store spatially contractile stresses that function as a form of mechanical memory. Upon serum-induced reactivation, these pre-stressed regions nucleate extensile asters that emit propagating polarity domain walls. Along these interfaces, topological defects are created, advected and annihilated, leading to defect coarsening with faster kinetics than by elastic interactions. An active elastic model quantitatively reproduces the observed dynamics and identifies stored stress as the origin of rapid topological reorganization. Our results establish a mechanism in which mechanical memory in quiescent epithelia triggers active stress release, driving collective migration via rapid topological ordering, distinct from conventional unjamming and flocking transitions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论混合类型。关键词：实验观察（“we show that”）、定量模型（“active elastic model quantitatively reproduces”）。；研究对象：上皮组织从静止态到集体迁移的转变过程，具体涉及伤口愈合和癌症侵袭中的物理机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 静止的上皮单层中储存的空间收缩应力构成一种“机械记忆”，在血清诱导激活后，这些预应力区域会释放应力，通过快速拓扑缺陷粗化驱动集体迁移，其动力学快于传统弹性相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：静止的上皮单层中储存的空间收缩应力构成一种“机械记忆”，在血清诱导激活后，这些预应力区域会释放应力，通过快速拓扑缺陷粗化驱动集体迁移，其动力学快于传统弹性相互作用。；创新点：揭示了静止上皮中的机械记忆作为主动应力释放的触发源，驱动一种不同于传统“unjamming”和“flocking”转变的快速拓扑有序化迁移机制。
papers.method_zh: 实验上通过血清诱导上皮细胞单层从静止态激活，观察应力释放、极性畴壁传播及拓扑缺陷的生成、输运与湮灭；理论上构建了活性弹性模型，定量复现实验动力学。

papers.title: Thermodynamic stability of twisted domains in AgCrSe$_{2}$ thin films grown on lattice-matched YSZ(111) substrate
papers.abstract: Control of structural domains in epitaxial thin films of functional materials is a fundamental technique to utilize their intrinsic physical and chemical properties in solid-state devices. In this study, we report on suppression of twisted-domain formation in thin-film growth of polar magnetic semiconductor AgCrSe$_{2}$ using pulsed-laser deposition. In exploring concomitant optimized growth temperature and Ag/Cr composition ratio of supply, we find the critical growth temperature ($T\mathrm{_{sub}}$) for obtaining single 60$^{\circ}$ domain in c-axis oriented AgCrSe$_{2}$ thin film on a lattice-matched (111) plane of the yttria-stabilized zirconia substrate. At temperatures below and above the critical $T\mathrm{_{sub}}$, metastable 0$^{\circ}$ domain in addition to the 60$^{\circ}$ domain emerges, indicating delicate energy balance of thermodynamic stability for obtaining the single-domain structure. Surface structural analysis using time-of-flight low-energy atom scattering spectroscopy reveals the presence of two polar orientations along $+Z$ and $-Z$ directions. These findings provide valuable insights into the thin-film growth mechanisms for a family of two-dimensional compounds with rhombohedral lattices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“使用脉冲激光沉积（pulsed-laser deposition）”、“表面结构分析使用飞行时间低能原子散射谱（time-of-flight low-energy atom scattering spectroscopy）”。；研究对象：极性磁性半导体AgCrSe₂薄膜在晶格匹配的YSZ(111)衬底上的外延生长，具体关注薄膜中扭转畴（twisted domains）的热力学稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在晶格匹配的YSZ(111)衬底上生长c轴取向的AgCrSe₂薄膜时，存在一个临界生长温度（T_sub），在此温度下可获得单一的60°畴结构；低于或高于该临界温度时，会额外出现亚稳态的0°畴，表明单畴结构的获得依赖于热力学稳定性的精细能量平衡。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在晶格匹配的YSZ(111)衬底上生长c轴取向的AgCrSe₂薄膜时，存在一个临界生长温度（T_sub），在此温度下可获得单一的60°畴结构；低于或高于该临界温度时，会额外出现亚稳态的0°畴，表明单畴结构的获得依赖于热力学稳定性的精细能量平衡。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 脉冲激光沉积（PLD）生长薄膜；通过优化生长温度和Ag/Cr组分比来探索生长条件；使用飞行时间低能原子散射谱（TOF-LES）进行表面结构分析，以确定极性取向（+Z和-Z方向）。

papers.title: In situ estimation of local acoustic pressure amplitude by force balancing with a ferrofluid droplet probe
papers.abstract: Acoustic tweezers enable non-contact manipulation of microscale objects, but quantitative in situ evaluation of the peak local pressure amplitude remains difficult in confined devices. Conventional hydrophone-based measurements are often limited at the microscale by probe size and installation constraints. Here, we present a force-balance method in which a trapped ferrofluid droplet serves as a local probe in a standing-wave acoustic field and an externally applied magnetic-field gradient is tuned so that the magnetic force balances the maximum primary acoustic radiation force on the droplet. From the magnetic force on the ferrofluid droplet, determined at the balance point, we estimate a peak local pressure amplitude of $2.6\times10^{5}$~Pa for 7.2~MHz operation at 10~V$_{\mathrm{pp}}$. This approach provides a practical route for quantitative in situ characterization of microscale acoustic fields and for setting operating conditions in compact acoustofluidic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了具体的实验方法（力平衡法、磁力梯度调控）和实验测量结果（估算出2.6×10^5 Pa的声压幅值）。；研究对象：微尺度声场中局部声压幅值的原位定量表征，具体以铁磁流体液滴作为探针，在驻波声场中通过磁力与声辐射力平衡来估算声压。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过磁力与声辐射力平衡的方法，利用铁磁流体液滴探针，成功估算了在7.2 MHz、10 Vpp驱动条件下微尺度声场中的峰值局部声压幅值为2.6×10^5 Pa。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过磁力与声辐射力平衡的方法，利用铁磁流体液滴探针，成功估算了在7.2 MHz、10 Vpp驱动条件下微尺度声场中的峰值局部声压幅值为2.6×10^5 Pa。；创新点：提出了一种无需传统水听器、适用于受限微尺度器件的原位声压定量表征方法，解决了传统水听器因探头尺寸和安装限制难以在微尺度下进行定量测量的难题。
papers.method_zh: 力平衡法：在驻波声场中捕获铁磁流体液滴作为局部探针，通过外部施加的磁场梯度调节磁力，使其与液滴所受的最大初级声辐射力平衡，从而根据平衡点处的磁力估算局部声压幅值。

papers.title: Quantum fluctuations in quartet superfluid of two-dimensional Fermi mixture
papers.abstract: We study quantum fluctuations in quartet superfluid (QSF) of two-dimensional (2D) fermion mixtures with mass imbalance. Here QSF is a high-order superfluid that corresponds to the condensation of ($1+3$) clusters, each consisting of a light fermion and three heavy ones. By incorporating the Gaussian fluctuations respecting dominant four-body correlations in this system, our theory successfully produces the logarithmic dependence of the 2D equation of state in the deep binding regime, thereby offering a correct physical picture of quartet clusters behaving as composite bosons. By extending the Gaussian fluctuation theory from pairing to quartet superfluids, our results shed light on quantum fluctuations in general fermion superfluids with arbitrarily high-order correlations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“研究量子涨落”“通过引入高斯涨落”“理论成功产生……依赖关系”等理论分析表述。；研究对象：二维费米混合物中的四重态超流（quartet superfluid, QSF），具体为质量不平衡的轻费米子与三个重费米子组成的（1+3）团簇凝聚体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在深束缚区域，理论成功给出了二维状态方程的对数依赖关系，表明四重态团簇可视为复合玻色子，从而揭示了具有高阶关联的费米子超流中量子涨落的正确物理图像。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在深束缚区域，理论成功给出了二维状态方程的对数依赖关系，表明四重态团簇可视为复合玻色子，从而揭示了具有高阶关联的费米子超流中量子涨落的正确物理图像。；创新点：将高斯涨落理论从配对超流扩展到四重态超流，为研究任意高阶关联的费米子超流中的量子涨落提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 采用高斯涨落理论（Gaussian fluctuation theory），将配对超流中的涨落处理方法推广至四重态超流，并纳入体系中占主导的四体关联效应。

papers.title: Exact solution of generalized gauge-invariant Ising chains with multi-spin interactions
papers.abstract: In this work, exact solutions are obtained for a class of generalized gauge-invariant $n$-chain Ising models ($n=1,2,3,4$) with arbitrary multi-spin interactions that are invariant under the local $\mathbb{Z}_2$ gauge group. On a strip lattice of finite length $L$ and width $n$ with periodic or free boundary conditions, an explicit expression for the partition function is derived using the transfer-matrix method. Two successive transformations are developed: elimination of gauge redundancy and reduction of the original model to an effective $n$-chain Ising model with all possible interactions between neighboring vertical layers. On the basis of the spectral decomposition of the $2^n\times 2^n$ transfer matrix, general formulas are obtained for gauge-invariant correlation functions and Wilson loops of arbitrary width. For $n \le 3$, explicit expressions are derived in terms of eigenvalues and eigenvectors. A detailed analysis of the behavior of the Wilson loop is performed, which allows us to identify regimes exhibiting area-law (confinement-like) and perimeter-law (deconfinement-like) dependence. For specific Hamiltonians, the string tension is computed and the corresponding phase diagrams are constructed. The results generalize and substantially extend the classical works on the gauge-invariant Ising model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exact solution、transfer-matrix method、spectral decomposition。；研究对象：一类具有任意多自旋相互作用的广义规范不变伊辛链模型（n=1,2,3,4），在有限长、宽度为n的条状晶格上，具有周期或自由边界条件。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过精确求解，识别出Wilson圈的面积律（类似禁闭相）和周长律（类似退禁闭相）行为，并计算了特定哈密顿量下的弦张力，构建了相应的相图。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过精确求解，识别出Wilson圈的面积律（类似禁闭相）和周长律（类似退禁闭相）行为，并计算了特定哈密顿量下的弦张力，构建了相应的相图。；创新点：将经典规范不变伊辛模型的工作推广到具有任意多自旋相互作用的广义n链情形（n=1,2,3,4），并给出了精确解。
papers.method_zh: 转移矩阵方法。通过两次连续变换：消除规范冗余，将原始模型约化为有效n链伊辛模型（包含相邻垂直层间所有可能相互作用）。基于2^n×2^n转移矩阵的谱分解，得到规范不变关联函数和Wilson圈的一般公式。

papers.title: Non-adiabatic phonon renormalization in metallic versus insulating rutile oxides
papers.abstract: We present a comparative Raman scattering study of metallic rutile oxides (RuO$_2$ and IrO$_2$) and insulating rutiles (TiO$_2$ and SnO$_2$). Temperature-dependent Raman spectra reveal that the metallic compounds exhibit pronounced phonon frequency hardening, $ω(11~\mathrm{K})-ω(300~\mathrm{K})=Δω\approx 6$-$10~\mathrm{cm}^{-1}$, whereas the insulating rutiles show only modest hardening, $Δω\approx 1$-$3~\mathrm{cm}^{-1}$. In contrast, the linewidth changes, $ΔΓ\approx 1$--$7~\mathrm{cm}^{-1}$, do not display a systematic metallic-insulating classification. Fits with the conventional Klemens anharmonic decay model reproduce the overall temperature trends but yield inconsistent anharmonic parameters for the metallic compounds when benchmarked against insulating rutile analogues. A modified Klemens framework, incorporating an additional $T^{2}$ correction to the phonon frequency arising from the electronic contribution to the phonon self-energy, quantitatively accounts for the enhanced renormalization observed in metallic systems. These results establish finite non-adiabatic electron-phonon coupling in metallic rutiles and demonstrate that phonon renormalization can be identified even in the absence of observable Fano asymmetry in the phonon line shapes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“Raman scattering study”（拉曼散射研究）、“Temperature-dependent Raman spectra”（变温拉曼光谱）。；研究对象：金属性金红石氧化物（RuO₂ 和 IrO₂）与绝缘性金红石氧化物（TiO₂ 和 SnO₂）中的声子重整化现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 金属性金红石氧化物表现出显著的声子频率硬化（Δω≈6-10 cm⁻¹），而绝缘性金红石氧化物仅表现出微弱的硬化（Δω≈1-3 cm⁻¹）。该增强的重整化源于金属体系中非绝热电子-声子耦合的贡献，且可在不出现法诺不对称线形的情况下被识别。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：金属性金红石氧化物表现出显著的声子频率硬化（Δω≈6-10 cm⁻¹），而绝缘性金红石氧化物仅表现出微弱的硬化（Δω≈1-3 cm⁻¹）。该增强的重整化源于金属体系中非绝热电子-声子耦合的贡献，且可在不出现法诺不对称线形的情况下被识别。；创新点：通过对比金属性与绝缘性金红石氧化物的拉曼光谱，明确建立了金属体系中非绝热电子-声子耦合对声子频率重整化的贡献，并证明即使声子线形未表现出法诺不对称性，该重整化效应仍可被识别。
papers.method_zh: 变温拉曼散射实验；采用传统Klemens非简谐衰减模型以及修正的Klemens框架（引入来自电子对声子自能贡献的T²修正项）对数据进行拟合分析。

papers.title: Optical Transmission of 2D Material with Quantum Anomalous Hall Effect
papers.abstract: We study the optical properties of gapped two-dimensional materials which are subject to the quantum anomalous Hall effect. At sufficiently low temperatures the transmission, reflection and absorption coefficients are found to have a universal behavior that depends only on the ratio of the photonic energy and the gap energy. There is a singular behavior with total reflection when these energies are equal. In the limit of a vanishing gap we recover results for graphene, where the optical coefficients depend only on the fine-structure constant. The observed optical properties provide an accurate measurement of the bandgap.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We study”“are found to”“provide”等理论推导和预测性表述，未提及实验或计算模拟方法。；研究对象：具有量子反常霍尔效应的有能隙二维材料的光学性质，特别是光透射、反射和吸收行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在足够低的温度下，有能隙二维材料的光学透射、反射和吸收系数表现出仅依赖于光子能量与能隙能量之比的普适行为；当光子能量等于能隙能量时，出现全反射的奇异行为。在能隙趋于零的极限下，光学系数仅依赖于精细结构常数，与石墨烯结果一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在足够低的温度下，有能隙二维材料的光学透射、反射和吸收系数表现出仅依赖于光子能量与能隙能量之比的普适行为；当光子能量等于能隙能量时，出现全反射的奇异行为。在能隙趋于零的极限下，光学系数仅依赖于精细结构常数，与石墨烯结果一致。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，基于量子反常霍尔效应下的有能隙二维材料的光学响应模型，推导透射、反射和吸收系数的解析表达式。

papers.title: Pulsed thermal annealing enables switching of chiral antiferromagnetic order with a sub-millitesla field in Mn$_3$Sn
papers.abstract: The manipulation of antiferromagnetic (AFM) order is a central theme in modern spintronics. In this work, we achieve reliable switching of the chiral AFM state in the Weyl antiferromagnet Mn$_3$Sn using a heat pulse combined with a very small magnetic field as small as 0.1 mT. By systematically measuring the anomalous Hall effect (AHE) in high-quality single crystals, we show that the field needed for switching decreases as the temperature approaches the Néel temperature $T_N$, and vanishes at $T_N$. Pulsed thermal annealing above $T_N$ followed by cooling in a tiny external field enables full and reproducible switching of the magnetic octupole order. Our results show that thermal softening (heating above $T_N$ to temporarily remove the magnetic anisotropy) is a key step that lowers the energy barrier to nearly zero. This allows an extremely weak directional field (like the effective field from spin-orbit torque in thin-film devices) to set the final magnetic state during cooling. We also provide a simple model to estimate the temperature rise in nanoscale devices under current pulses, giving practical guidance for device design. This work highlights that thermal effects are not a side issue but an important partner to spin torques, and suggests that future work should take both into account.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：测量 anomalous Hall effect、单晶样品、脉冲热退火实验）；研究对象：Weyl反铁磁体 Mn₃Sn 中的手性反铁磁序的调控与切换
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将样品加热至 Néel 温度以上进行脉冲热退火，再在极小的外磁场（低至 0.1 mT）下冷却，即可实现反铁磁序的可靠、可重复切换；热软化（加热消除磁各向异性）是降低能量势垒至接近零的关键步骤。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将样品加热至 Néel 温度以上进行脉冲热退火，再在极小的外磁场（低至 0.1 mT）下冷却，即可实现反铁磁序的可靠、可重复切换；热软化（加热消除磁各向异性）是降低能量势垒至接近零的关键步骤。；创新点：首次证明利用热脉冲结合亚毫特斯拉级极小磁场即可实现 Mn₃Sn 中手性反铁磁态的切换，并明确指出热效应并非自旋转矩的副作用，而是与之协同的重要机制。
papers.method_zh: 高质量单晶样品的反常霍尔效应（AHE）系统测量；脉冲热退火实验；基于电流脉冲的纳米器件温升模型估算。

papers.title: Tuning J$_1$-J$_2$ in Quasi-2D Triangular Lattice Antiferromagnet $α$-SrCr$_2$O$_4$ via Uniaxial Pressure
papers.abstract: Triangular lattice antiferromagnets first attracted attention as a frustrated magnetic lattice which can serve as a platform to realize the resonating valence bond state. While the triangular lattice itself was shown to support classical 120 degree order, many theoretical phase diagrams suggest a quantum spin liquid state within a small range of parameters. One possible avenue to achieve such a state is to tune the anisotropy of the triangular lattice antiferromagnet by applying uniaxial pressure. This motivated our Raman scattering study of quasi-two-dimensional antiferromagnet $α$-SrCr$_2$O$_4$ under applied uniaxial pressure. Under ambient conditions, $α$-SrCr$_2$O$_4$ develops long-range helical magnetic order below T$_N$ = 43 K. We identify two-magnon excitations associated with this long-range antiferromagnetic order below T$_N$ at 15.5 meV and 40 meV by comparison with spin wave calculations. We observe the two features from the two-magnon excitation shift away from (towards) each other under applied tensile (compressive) pressure, indicating a decrease (increase) in anisotropy. Raman active phonons show a shift to higher (lower) frequencies under applied compressive (tensile) pressure, indicating efficient transmission of pressure and tuning of the lattice. We show spin wave and two-magnon density of states calculations under uniaxial pressure are consistent with our experimental results.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：Raman scattering study、spin wave calculations、experimental results）；研究对象：准二维三角晶格反铁磁体α-SrCr₂O₄，在单轴压力下的磁性和晶格性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过施加单轴压力，可以调控α-SrCr₂O₄中两个磁振子激发峰之间的相对位移，从而改变磁各向异性；拉曼声子峰在压力下发生频移，表明压力有效传递并调控了晶格。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过施加单轴压力，可以调控α-SrCr₂O₄中两个磁振子激发峰之间的相对位移，从而改变磁各向异性；拉曼声子峰在压力下发生频移，表明压力有效传递并调控了晶格。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 拉曼散射实验（Raman scattering），结合自旋波计算（spin wave calculations）和双磁振子态密度计算（two-magnon density of states calculations）。

papers.title: Mean first passage time of chiral active Brownian particles
papers.abstract: Chiral active Brownian particles (CABPs) are self-propelled agents with intrinsic rotational dynamics, giving rise to circular trajectories commonly observed in biological and synthetic microswimmers. Understanding how CABPs explore confined environments and locate targets is crucial for characterizing transport, search efficiency, and reaction processes in physical and biological systems. We study the escape dynamics of CABPs from one- and two-dimensional confined domains. In one dimension, we consider intervals with either two absorbing boundaries or a reflecting boundary on one side and an absorbing boundary on the other, and derive closed-form asymptotic solutions in the high-chirality regime, revealing the quantitative scaling of the mean first passage time (MFPT) as a function of particle rotation speed (chirality). In two dimensions, we analyze escape from a disk containing one absorbing arc or two symmetric absorbing arcs. By numerically solving the governing partial differential equations, we compute the MFPT for CABPs to escape the domains as a function of the particle's initial orientation, self-propulsion speed, angular velocity, and domain geometry. Our results show that, depending on the parameters and geometry, the MFPT can exhibit non-monotonic behavior as a function of chirality. There exists an optimal chirality at an intermediate value that minimizes the escape time. Our work offers a comprehensive characterization of CABP escape dynamics in canonical confinements and identifies chirality as a key control parameter for transport and search in confined physical and biological systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：derive closed-form asymptotic solutions、numerically solving governing partial differential equations）；研究对象：手性活性布朗粒子（CABPs）在受限一维和二维区域中的逃逸动力学，具体包括一维区间（两端吸收边界或一端反射一端吸收）和二维圆盘（含一个或两个对称吸收弧）中的平均首次通过时间（MFPT）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: MFPT随手性（旋转速度）的变化可呈现非单调行为，存在一个最优手性值使逃逸时间最小化；在高手性极限下，MFPT随手性变化的定量标度关系可通过闭式渐近解描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：MFPT随手性（旋转速度）的变化可呈现非单调行为，存在一个最优手性值使逃逸时间最小化；在高手性极限下，MFPT随手性变化的定量标度关系可通过闭式渐近解描述。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 一维情形：推导高手性极限下的闭式渐近解；二维情形：通过数值求解控制偏微分方程计算MFPT，并系统分析初始取向、自推进速度、角速度及几何结构的影响。

papers.title: Nonlinear Wave Propagation in 1D Polycatenated Ring Chains
papers.abstract: We study the nonlinear wave dynamics of one-dimensional chains of polycatenated rings. These interlocked structures support amplitude-dependent nonlinear wave propagation driven by tensile activation and internal structural flexibility, unlike traditional granular crystals. Through dynamic impact experiments, finite-element modeling, and discrete-particle simulations of vertical chains pretensioned by gravity, we observe and explain nonlinear waves characterized by a compact leading wavefront followed by persistent trailing oscillations, which arise from energy partitioning into the rings' internal bending modes. Further, we demonstrate that the system's nonlinearity is not a fixed material constant. By altering the rings' geometric aspect ratio and contact angles, we can tune the effective contact exponent and the amplitude scaling of the wave speed. This work builds upon nonlinear wave propagation in classical granular crystals and establishes polycatenated systems as a highly tunable and designable platform to study and control nonlinear dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算+理论）。判断依据：dynamic impact experiments（实验）、finite-element modeling（有限元模拟）、discrete-particle simulations（离散粒子模拟）。；研究对象：一维多环链（polycatenated ring chains）中的非线性波传播现象，具体为受重力预拉伸的垂直链中由拉伸激活和内部结构柔性驱动的非线性波。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该体系支持振幅依赖的非线性波，其特征为紧凑的前沿波头后跟随持续尾迹振荡，该振荡源于能量分配到环的内部弯曲模式；系统非线性并非固定材料常数，可通过改变环的几何长宽比和接触角来调控有效接触指数和波速的振幅标度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该体系支持振幅依赖的非线性波，其特征为紧凑的前沿波头后跟随持续尾迹振荡，该振荡源于能量分配到环的内部弯曲模式；系统非线性并非固定材料常数，可通过改变环的几何长宽比和接触角来调控有效接触指数和波速的振幅标度。；创新点：将非线性波传播从经典颗粒晶体拓展到多环链体系，并证明该体系具有高度可调性和可设计性，可通过几何参数而非材料常数来调控非线性动力学。
papers.method_zh: 动态冲击实验、有限元建模、离散粒子模拟。

papers.title: Surface States in Strain-Induced Nodal-Line Topological Semiconductors
papers.abstract: This work explores the topological phase diagram of inverted-band-gap semiconductors under strain and spin-orbit coupling. Using a minimalistic Luttinger Hamiltonian model, we follow the transitions between a 3D topological insulator, a Dirac semimetal, a nodal-line semimetal, and a Weyl semimetal. Analytical and exact solutions for surface states are derived for high-symmetry directions as well as in several limiting cases. We demonstrate the continuous evolution of these surface states across phase boundaries, providing a unified picture that synthesizes previous literature. Specifically, we detail the progression from a Dirac to a nodal-line and then to a Weyl semimetal as spin-orbit coupling originating from bulk inversion asymmetry is introduced. A hierarchy of energy scales is established, defining the criteria for realizing these phases. Finally, we reveal a non-analyticity in the surface-state dispersion at the projected nodal line, originating from distinct, terminating patches of surface states with unique spin textures in momentum space.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：使用Luttinger哈密顿量模型进行解析推导，未涉及实验或数值计算。；研究对象：应变与自旋-轨道耦合作用下反带半导体的拓扑相图，具体包括三维拓扑绝缘体、狄拉克半金属、节线半金属和Weyl半金属之间的相变，以及表面态的性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了表面态在相边界处的连续演化，建立了从狄拉克半金属到节线半金属再到Weyl半金属的渐进转变过程；发现投影节线处表面态色散存在非解析性，源于具有独特自旋织构的不同表面态补丁。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了表面态在相边界处的连续演化，建立了从狄拉克半金属到节线半金属再到Weyl半金属的渐进转变过程；发现投影节线处表面态色散存在非解析性，源于具有独特自旋织构的不同表面态补丁。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用最小化Luttinger哈密顿量模型，沿高对称方向及若干极限情形下解析求解表面态，并建立能标层级以定义各相的实现条件。

papers.title: Amorphous Radial Frustration and Water-Like Anomalies in a Ramp-Shoulder Fluid
papers.abstract: We investigate the thermodynamic, structural, and dynamic behavior of a three-dimensional coarse-grained ramp-shoulder fluid derived from effective interactions between polymer-grafted nanoparticles. The interaction combines a softened repulsive ramp with a shallow attractive shoulder, stabilizing competing local organizations over a broad pressure interval. Molecular dynamics simulations reveal density, diffusion, and structural anomalies together with crystalline, amorphous, and fluid regions in the phase diagram. Unlike conventional isotropic core-softened fluids, the anomalous hierarchy becomes partially decoupled: the density anomaly extends beyond the structural anomaly, while the diffusion anomaly becomes closely connected to amorphization and shell migration processes. Analysis of radial distribution functions, excess entropy, translational and orientational order, and coordination-shell organization shows that the anomalies are not controlled solely by shell competition. Instead, they emerge from cooperative radial restructuring in a regime where radial correlations increase without the development of crystalline orientational order. The results indicate that the detailed shape of the softened interaction region strongly influences the structural pathways explored under compression, leading to a regime of amorphous radial frustration associated with anomalous diffusion and frustrated shell reorganization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“Molecular dynamics simulations”（分子动力学模拟）。；研究对象：论文研究了一种由聚合物接枝纳米颗粒之间的有效相互作用导出的三维粗粒化“斜坡-肩部”流体（ramp-shoulder fluid）的热力学、结构和动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该流体展现出密度、扩散和结构反常，但其反常层级与传统软核流体部分解耦：密度反常区域延伸至结构反常区域之外，而扩散反常与无定形化和壳层迁移过程紧密相关。反常行为并非仅由壳层竞争控制，而是源于一种“无定形径向挫败”机制，即径向相关性增强但未发展出晶体取向序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该流体展现出密度、扩散和结构反常，但其反常层级与传统软核流体部分解耦：密度反常区域延伸至结构反常区域之外，而扩散反常与无定形化和壳层迁移过程紧密相关。反常行为并非仅由壳层竞争控制，而是源于一种“无定形径向挫败”机制，即径向相关性增强但未发展出晶体取向序。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容，其创新点在于发现了一种新的反常行为机制——“无定形径向挫败”，该机制不同于传统各向同性软核流体中由壳层竞争主导的反常，并揭示了相互作用势的精细形状对压缩下结构演化路径的关键影响。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用分子动力学模拟（Molecular dynamics simulations），并分析了径向分布函数、过剩熵、平移序和取向序以及配位壳层组织等结构量。

papers.title: Non-reciprocal Coulomb drag in a ballistic quantum wire
papers.abstract: 1D-Coulomb drag serves as a platform for probing electron-electron interactions in 1D systems. Under the charge fluctuation formalism, the non-reciprocal component of Coulomb drag signal in mesoscopic devices is predicted to rely on the breaking of translational invariance due to intrinsic disorder. In this work, we report the measurement of a Coulomb drag device with a ballistic drag wire, allowing us to study the drag signal in nearly pristine quantum wires. Surprisingly, a non-reciprocal component with strength comparable to that of the reciprocal component is still detected across the measured regime, despite the drag wire being ballistic. We suggest that the non-reciprocal signal arises from low energy disorder in the device, which is consistent with the evolution of the drag wire's conductance at low biases voltages and temperatures. Additionally, the non-reciprocal component of the drag signal shows a power-law temperature dependence that coincides with a diffusive model, while the reciprocal component's temperature dependence cannot be explained under the existing framework. The bias voltage dependence of the drag wire conductance is fitted into three models to extract the interaction parameter and disorder level within the wire, but none of the models provides a fully self-consistent explanation for the data.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“measurement”、“report the measurement”、“device”、“conductance”。；研究对象：弹道量子线中的非互易库仑拖拽效应（non-reciprocal Coulomb drag），具体为在一维弹道量子线器件中测量库仑拖拽信号。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在弹道（近乎无缺陷）的拖拽线中，仍然观测到与互易分量强度相当的非互易库仑拖拽信号，该非互易信号可能源于器件中的低能无序，但其互易分量的温度依赖关系无法用现有理论解释。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在弹道（近乎无缺陷）的拖拽线中，仍然观测到与互易分量强度相当的非互易库仑拖拽信号，该非互易信号可能源于器件中的低能无序，但其互易分量的温度依赖关系无法用现有理论解释。；创新点：在弹道量子线中首次观测到显著的非互易库仑拖拽信号，挑战了此前认为非互易分量仅依赖于本征无序破坏平移不变性的理论预期。
papers.method_zh: 实验测量了弹道库仑拖拽器件的拖拽信号，分析了拖拽线在低偏压和低温下的电导演化，并利用三种模型拟合拖拽线电导的偏压依赖关系以提取相互作用参数和无序水平。

papers.title: A new method to probe conducting filaments in MoS$_2$-based memristors
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs), such as molybdenum disulfide (MoS$_2$), are emerging as promising materials for next-generation electronic devices. They have proved to be serious candidates for integration with memristors in non-volatile memory and radio frequency (RF) applications. However, the physical mechanisms behind their resistive switching, particularly the formation and resorption of conducting filaments, remain unclear. In this study, we present a novel mechanical exfoliation technique that selectively removes the top metallic electrode from MoS$_2$-based memristors by exploiting the weak van der Waals interaction between MoS$_2$ and the top electrode. This method enables direct and multi-scale characterization of the MoS$_2$ surface in different states (initial, ON and OFF) using Kelvin Probe Force Microscopy (KPFM) and Raman spectroscopy mapping. To complete this study, cross-sectional Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM) was also performed in different conductive states. Our results reveal that the conducting filament is formed by metallic atom migration from the top electrode into the MoS$_2$ layer. Additionally, we demonstrate that the choice of metallic electrodes (gold vs. nickel) significantly impacts the switching behavior due to differences in adsorption and diffusion energies. This work not only clarifies the filament formation mechanism and introduces a reproducible approach for in-operando characterization but also represents a real progress in the understanding and optimization of 2D material-based memristors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：mechanical exfoliation technique、KPFM、Raman spectroscopy mapping、cross-sectional TEM。；研究对象：基于二硫化钼（MoS₂）的忆阻器中的导电细丝形成与消散机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 导电细丝由顶部电极的金属原子迁移进入MoS₂层形成；电极材料（金 vs. 镍）因吸附能和扩散能差异显著影响开关行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：导电细丝由顶部电极的金属原子迁移进入MoS₂层形成；电极材料（金 vs. 镍）因吸附能和扩散能差异显著影响开关行为。；创新点：提出一种可重复的原位（in-operando）表征方法，通过机械剥离直接暴露MoS₂表面，实现对不同电阻态（初始、ON、OFF）的多尺度表征，从而澄清了导电细丝的形成机制。
papers.method_zh: 机械剥离技术（利用MoS₂与顶部电极间的弱范德华相互作用选择性去除电极）、开尔文探针力显微镜（KPFM）、拉曼光谱成像、截面透射电子显微镜（TEM）。

papers.title: Emergent heavy-tailed distributions from a Markovian random walk
papers.abstract: The emergence of heavy-tailed statistics in complex systems is conventionally attributed to non-local stochastic jumps or non-Markovian memory. Here, we present a one-dimensional random walk where power-law behaviors arise instead from a strictly local, discrete-time Markovian mechanism. The step length is governed by a deterministic function of the walker's position, establishing a positive feedback loop that induces strong effective correlations along the trajectories. Through analytical derivations in the continuum limit and extensive numerical simulations, we show that this rule yields a robust, non-Gaussian stationary state. The exact analytical solution is obtained in the closed form of a symmetric, Lorentz-like distribution, $ρ_{\text{st}}(x) \propto (|x|/l+rΔx)^{-2}$, confirming asymptotic power-law tails that decay as $|x|^{-2}$ over six decades. Furthermore, by employing the Onsager-Machlup path-integral formalism, we demonstrate that effective velocity and acceleration acquire physical meaning along the shortest fluctuation trajectories. Crucially, we find that a non-zero initial acceleration acts as the fundamental mechanism driving the walker away from the origin, ensuring both the emergence of scale-free statistics and the normalizability of the stationary distribution. This minimal pathway provides a new microscopic foundation for the widespread $-2$ power law observed across multidisciplinary complex systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Markovian random walk、analytical derivations、continuum limit、path-integral formalism、numerical simulations。；研究对象：一维随机游走模型，研究其产生重尾统计（幂律分布）的微观机制，特别是与复杂系统中广泛观测到的-2幂律相关的物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过一个严格局域、离散时间的马尔可夫随机游走机制，无需非局域跳跃或非马尔可夫记忆，即可产生鲁棒的非高斯稳态分布，其尾部呈幂律衰减（|x|^{-2}），且该分布具有精确的解析解（对称类洛伦兹分布）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过一个严格局域、离散时间的马尔可夫随机游走机制，无需非局域跳跃或非马尔可夫记忆，即可产生鲁棒的非高斯稳态分布，其尾部呈幂律衰减（|x|^{-2}），且该分布具有精确的解析解（对称类洛伦兹分布）。；创新点：首次证明仅通过位置依赖的步长确定性函数（正反馈回路）即可在马尔可夫框架下产生重尾统计，并揭示非零初始加速度是驱动游走者远离原点、确保稳态分布可归一化的根本机制，为复杂系统中普遍存在的-2幂律提供了新的微观基础。
papers.method_zh: 采用连续极限下的解析推导、大规模数值模拟，以及Onsager-Machlup路径积分形式论，分析有效速度和加速度在最短涨落轨迹上的物理意义。

papers.title: Thickness-Dependent Spintronic Terahertz Emission in MBE-Grown PtTe$_2$: From Semiconductor to Type-II Dirac Semimetal
papers.abstract: Spintronic terahertz (THz) emitters have established themselves as among the most practical broadband THz sources available, yet their performance remains fundamentally limited by the spin Hall conductivity of the nonmagnetic conversion layer - a quantity that is fixed once the material is chosen. Here, we demonstrate that in PtTe$_2$, a type-II Dirac semimetal within the transition metal dichalcogenide family, this limitation can be circumvented by exploiting the dramatic thickness-driven electronic phase evolution of the material itself. Using molecular beam epitaxy to grow PtTe$_2$ films with single-monolayer precision from 1 to 20 ML, we show that the spintronic THz emission tracks the underlying electronic phase diagram directly: it is absent in the single-layer semiconducting phase, turns on sharply at the semimetal transition near 2 ML, and reaches a peak amplitude six times that of an equivalent Pt reference at 10 ML, before declining at larger thicknesses due to THz reabsorption in the increasingly metallic film. This non-monotonic behavior is inconsistent with a bulk inverse spin Hall mechanism and instead reflects a multi-channel spin-to-charge conversion process in which spin-momentum-locked topological surface states and a thickness-dependent interfacial Rashba splitting both contribute and strengthen as the type-II Dirac band structure develops. First-principles calculations of the interfacial spin accumulation reproduce the experimental trend quantitatively, confirming this physical picture. These findings introduce thickness engineering of van der Waals semimetals as a new and accessible route to optimizing spintronic THz emitters and spin-orbit torques in magnetic memories (SOT-MRAMs), with direct implications for the broader class of dimensionally tunable topological materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以第一性原理计算）。关键词：molecular beam epitaxy（分子束外延）、spintronic THz emission（自旋太赫兹发射）、first-principles calculations（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：PtTe₂薄膜，一种属于过渡金属二硫族化合物的II型狄拉克半金属，及其厚度驱动的电子相变对自旋太赫兹发射的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: PtTe₂薄膜的自旋太赫兹发射强度随厚度非单调变化，在10个单层（ML）时达到峰值，是同等厚度Pt参考样品的六倍，这一行为源于厚度驱动的半导体-半金属相变以及多通道自旋-电荷转换过程（包括拓扑表面态和界面Rashba劈裂）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：PtTe₂薄膜的自旋太赫兹发射强度随厚度非单调变化，在10个单层（ML）时达到峰值，是同等厚度Pt参考样品的六倍，这一行为源于厚度驱动的半导体-半金属相变以及多通道自旋-电荷转换过程（包括拓扑表面态和界面Rashba劈裂）。；创新点：提出通过厚度工程调控范德华半金属的电子相变来优化自旋太赫兹发射性能，突破了传统自旋太赫兹发射器中非磁性转换层自旋霍尔电导率固定的限制。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（MBE）生长1至20 ML精度的PtTe₂薄膜；自旋太赫兹发射实验测量；第一性原理计算界面自旋积累。

papers.title: Fractionalization, emergent SU($N$) symmetries, and fragmentation in layered quantum spin-orbital models
papers.abstract: We propose a family of layered quantum spin-orbital models as a platform to study fractionalization, unconventional forms of symmetry-breaking order, and their possible coexistence. The models are built by stacking $N$ layers of a square-lattice system in which Kitaev-type interactions promote the formation of a $\mathbb{Z}_2$ quantum spin-orbital liquid and coupling the different layers via Ising spin interactions. Using a parton construction, we show how, at low energies, these Hamiltonians can be mapped to $N$-component Fermi Hubbard models on a $π$-flux square lattice at half filling. We also demonstrate that the models acquire an emergent SU($N$) symmetry in the limit of equal all-to-all interlayer couplings and argue that, for $N>2$, the proximity to this limit offers the potential to realize an array of competing phases. To illustrate this point, we compute the zero-temperature phase diagram of the effective $N=3$ Hubbard model within mean-field theory and uncover rich phenomena, including intertwined orders and flavor-selective localization. Mapping back to the original degrees of freedom reveals that the ground states realize distinct forms of magnetic fragmentation, wherein the orbitals remain in a quantum liquid state whereas the spins can present conventional long-range order or nonlocal order characterized by a nontrivial string order parameters. We highlight possible extensions of our construction as well as its potential to provide concrete microscopic models for different fractionalized quantum critical points.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose a family of models、parton construction、mapped to、mean-field theory。；研究对象：层状量子自旋-轨道模型，具体为堆叠N层具有Kitaev型相互作用的方晶格系统，并通过Ising自旋相互作用耦合各层。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型在低能下可映射为π通量方晶格上半满的N分量费米哈伯德模型，并在等全对全层间耦合极限下涌现出SU(N)对称性；对于N=3的情况，平均场相图揭示了交织序和味选择性局域化等丰富现象，且基态实现了不同形式的磁碎裂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型在低能下可映射为π通量方晶格上半满的N分量费米哈伯德模型，并在等全对全层间耦合极限下涌现出SU(N)对称性；对于N=3的情况，平均场相图揭示了交织序和味选择性局域化等丰富现象，且基态实现了不同形式的磁碎裂。；创新点：提出了一个可同时研究分数化、非常规对称性破缺序及其共存的具体微观模型家族，并揭示了磁碎裂（自旋呈现长程序或非局域弦序，而轨道保持量子液体态）这一新颖现象。
papers.method_zh: 采用部分子构造（parton construction）进行低能映射，并运用平均场理论（mean-field theory）计算有效N=3哈伯德模型的零温相图。

papers.title: Weak wave turbulence as a precursor to universal coarsening in a homogeneous Bose gas
papers.abstract: Relaxation and condensation of an isolated low-energy Bose gas provide an ideal setting for the study of the universal features of far-from-equilibrium many-body dynamics and the emergence of long-range order. Conceptually, the emergence of such order involves two steps: the formation of local coherence, on a system-specific microscopic lengthscale, and the spreading of coherence, over lengthscales much larger than any microscopic scale. The latter is understood in terms of universal phase-ordering kinetics, or coarsening, characterized by an algebraic growth of the coherence length. Here, for a homogeneous Bose gas with tunable interactions, we show that the former also has a universal description, within the framework of weak wave turbulence (WWT). Specifically, the initial transport of particles to low momenta corresponds to an inverse turbulent cascade that is, in agreement with the WWT theory, characterized by a power-law momentum distribution, with exponent $γ= 2.4(1)$, and transport times ${\propto} (na)^{-2}$, where $n$ is the gas density and $a$ the $s$-wave scattering length.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：weak wave turbulence framework、universal description、power-law momentum distribution）；研究对象：均匀玻色气体在远离平衡态下的弛豫与凝聚过程，特别是长程有序涌现前的弱波湍流行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在均匀玻色气体中，低能粒子向低动量区域的初始输运过程可被弱波湍流理论普遍描述，表现为幂律动量分布（指数γ=2.4(1)）和输运时间与(na)^{-2}成正比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在均匀玻色气体中，低能粒子向低动量区域的初始输运过程可被弱波湍流理论普遍描述，表现为幂律动量分布（指数γ=2.4(1)）和输运时间与(na)^{-2}成正比。；创新点：揭示了在普遍相化动力学（粗化）之前，局部相干性的形成过程也具有普适性描述，即弱波湍流中的逆级联行为。
papers.method_zh: 基于弱波湍流（WWT）理论框架，结合可调相互作用的均匀玻色气体模型，分析动量分布幂律指数和输运时间标度关系。

papers.title: Genome-Guided Interpretable Screening of Phase-Stable, Lead-Free Double Perovskite Absorbers for All-Inorganic Semiconductors, Sensors, and Photovoltaics with DFT-Validated Design Rules
papers.abstract: The discovery of stable, lead-free halide perovskites for optoelectronic applications is constrained by vast compositional space and limited interpretability of conventional screening approaches. We present a genome-guided, physics-informed framework that decodes thermodynamic stability and optoelectronic behavior through four physically interpretable descriptor families: packing, bonding, polarization, and electronic identity. Trained on 1,221 DFT-calculated A2BB'X6 compounds, machine-learning surrogates achieve robust predictive performance, with a recall-optimized stability classifier (ROC-AUC = 0.92) and an XGBoost regressor for band-gap prediction (R2 = 0.93 on held-out data). Applying a staged inverse-design constraint stack to 13,088 charge-balanced, lead-free compositions reduces the search space to five DFT-validated, phase-stable semiconductors: Rb2SnMnBr6, Cs2CdSnBr6, Cs2CdSnI6, Cs2KGaI6, and Cs2AgAlBr6. These candidates lie on the convex hull (E_hull <= 0 meV/atom), preserve ordered double-perovskite structures, and exhibit strong optical absorption (alpha peak ~1e5 cm^-1). Genotype-phenotype coupling analysis reveals a hierarchical control mechanism: packing genes define structural formability, bonding genes govern near-edge optical transitions and conductivity, and optoelectronic response genes regulate dielectric response and exciton screening (epsilon0 = 4.6-8.2). This work establishes a generalizable paradigm for interpretable inverse design, linking descriptor-level genomics to experimentally relevant optoelectronic phenotypes and providing design rules for discovering stable, lead-free double perovskites for photovoltaics, sensing, and transparent electronic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“DFT-calculated”、“machine-learning surrogates”、“inverse-design constraint stack”等关键词，主要依赖第一性原理计算和机器学习方法。；研究对象：无铅双钙钛矿材料（A₂BB'X₆结构），具体用于全无机半导体、传感器和光伏应用的光吸收层。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过基因组引导的物理信息框架，从12,088种无铅组分中筛选出5种相稳定的双钙钛矿候选材料（Rb₂SnMnBr₆、Cs₂CdSnBr₆、Cs₂CdSnI₆、Cs₂KGaI₆、Cs₂AgAlBr₆），这些材料位于凸包上（E_hull ≤ 0 meV/atom），保持有序双钙钛矿结构，并具有强光吸收（α峰值约10⁵ cm⁻¹）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过基因组引导的物理信息框架，从12,088种无铅组分中筛选出5种相稳定的双钙钛矿候选材料（Rb₂SnMnBr₆、Cs₂CdSnBr₆、Cs₂CdSnI₆、Cs₂KGaI₆、Cs₂AgAlBr₆），这些材料位于凸包上（E_hull ≤ 0 meV/atom），保持有序双钙钛矿结构，并具有强光吸收（α峰值约10⁵ cm⁻¹）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可看出主要新意在于：将描述符级“基因组学”与可解释逆设计相结合，建立了从结构堆积、键合到光电响应表型的层次化控制机制，并提供了可推广的物理信息筛选范式。
papers.method_zh: 采用DFT计算（具体泛函未明确说明）生成1,221种A₂BB'X₆化合物的训练数据；构建机器学习代理模型（包括ROC-AUC=0.92的稳定性分类器和R²=0.93的XGBoost带隙回归器）；通过四类物理可解释描述符（堆积、键合、极化、电子身份）进行基因组-表型耦合分析；应用分阶段逆设计约束堆栈进行筛选。

papers.title: Effects of compocasting process parameters on microstructural characteristics and tensile properties of A356-SiCp composites
papers.abstract: The effects of compocasting process parameters on some structural and tensile characteristics of the A356-10% SiCp (volume fraction) composites were studied. Semisolid stirring was carried out at temperatures of 590, 600 and 610 C with stirring speeds of 200, 400 and 600 r/min for 10, 20 and 30 min. The distribution of the SiC particles within the matrix, porosity content and tensile properties of the obtained samples were examined. The structural evaluations show that by increasing the stirring time and decreasing the stirring temperature, the uniformity in the particle distribution is improved; however, by increasing the stirring speed the homogeneity firstly increases and then declines. It is also found that by increasing all of the processing parameters, the porosity content is enhanced. From the tensile characteristics viewpoint, the optimum values of the speed, temperature and time are found to be 400 r/min, 590 C and 30 min, respectively. The contribution of the reinforcement distribution uniformity prevails over that of the porosity level to the tensile properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了半固态搅拌实验（semisolid stirring）在不同温度、转速和时间下进行，并对样品进行了结构评估和拉伸性能测试。；研究对象：A356-10% SiCp（体积分数）复合材料，即A356铝合金基体中加入10%体积分数的碳化硅颗粒的复合材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过优化compocasting工艺参数（搅拌速度400 r/min、温度590°C、时间30 min），可获得最佳的拉伸性能；增强颗粒分布均匀性对拉伸性能的贡献大于孔隙率的影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过优化compocasting工艺参数（搅拌速度400 r/min、温度590°C、时间30 min），可获得最佳的拉伸性能；增强颗粒分布均匀性对拉伸性能的贡献大于孔隙率的影响。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用compocasting（复合铸造）工艺，具体为半固态搅拌（semisolid stirring），在590、600、610°C温度下，以200、400、600 r/min的搅拌速度，分别搅拌10、20、30分钟。通过结构评估（structural evaluations）分析SiC颗粒分布均匀性和孔隙率，并通过拉伸测试（tensile tests）测量力学性能。

papers.title: Quantum Quenches that Resemble Operator Growth
papers.abstract: We study growth quenches, which are local quenches that may gradually destabilize a false vacuum in certain kinetic constrained quantum lattice models, such as the East-West model. We point out a formal analogy with the dynamics of a local operator in the Heisenberg picture. Exploiting this analogy, we obtain several results on growth quenches by adapting operator-dynamics concepts and methods. First, applying the Krylov approach (recursion method), we conjecture the linear growth of Lanzcos coefficients in generic quenches, $a_m \sim νm$ (diagonal), and $b_m \sim αm$ (off-diagonal), extending an operator growth hypothesis. We show that the growth quench dynamics is localized in both Krylov and Fock spaces when $|ν| > 2 α$, and derive a bound for the growth quench analogue of Lyapunov exponent $λ_L \le \sqrt{4 α^2 - ν^2}$ when $|ν| < 2 α$. Second, we realize the Fock localization in large $N$ solvable growth quenches inspired by Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) models. The bound on Lyapunov exponent is saturated in large-$q$ SYK grow quench. By contrast, the growth quench is almost always Fock localized in a nonrandom all-to-all growth quench amenable to semiclassics. Finally, in the 1D East-West model, we interpret Fock space cage states as the existence of a conserved charge. We show that the latter has ballistic transport due to current conservation. Moreover, adding hopping with a fine-tuned amplitude induces a partial localization due to a flat band. Our work suggest growth quenches as a promising approach to realize non-equilibrium coherent phenomena in many-body systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：研究、指出、类比、推导、猜想、证明、解释。；研究对象：量子晶格模型（如East-West模型）中的“生长淬灭”（growth quenches）现象，即通过局部淬火逐步使假真空失稳的动力学过程，以及其与算符增长动力学的形式类比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 生长淬灭动力学与海森堡绘景中局域算符的增长存在形式类比，并据此推导了Lanczos系数的线性增长行为，给出了Lyapunov指数在生长淬灭中的上界；在East-West模型中发现了Fock空间笼态（cage states）及其对应的守恒荷，并展示了该守恒荷的弹道输运特性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：生长淬灭动力学与海森堡绘景中局域算符的增长存在形式类比，并据此推导了Lanczos系数的线性增长行为，给出了Lyapunov指数在生长淬灭中的上界；在East-West模型中发现了Fock空间笼态（cage states）及其对应的守恒荷，并展示了该守恒荷的弹道输运特性。；创新点：将算符增长假设推广到生长淬灭动力学，建立了Lanczos系数线性增长与动力学局域化/混沌边界的联系；首次在East-West模型中识别出Fock空间笼态并揭示其弹道输运机制；通过精细调谐跳跃振幅实现了平带诱导的部分局域化。
papers.method_zh: 采用Krylov方法（递归方法）分析Lanczos系数；构造大N可解模型（受SYK模型启发）实现Fock局域化；在半经典可解的全连接生长淬灭模型中分析Fock局域化；在一维East-West模型中通过守恒荷和能带结构分析输运与局域化。

papers.title: Coherent dynamics in chaotic spin chains via interference-protected subspaces
papers.abstract: Generic quantum many-body systems are expected to thermalize, scrambling initial coherence while local observables relax to equilibrium values. Weak ergodicity breaking, often associated with quantum many-body scarring of homogeneous states, provides rare exceptions with long-lived coherence. We introduce a family of local spin-1/2 chains with a structured subspace that hosts a much broader range of nonthermal phenomena, such as scars, chirally propagating quasiparticles or approximate topological edge modes. These nonthermal phenomena happening at high energy densities can be understood via structured subspaces that are protected by destructive interference. We develop a quantitative leakage theory predicting which states retain coherence and suggest ways to improve the stability by inducing fast oscillations in the complement subspace. Our framework connects asymptotic scars, quantum cages, and parent-Hamiltonian constructions, and shows that weak ergodicity breaking in chaotic systems extends well beyond revivals of homogeneous initial states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：introduce、develop、framework、theory。；研究对象：局域自旋-1/2链中的非热化动力学现象，包括量子疤痕、手性传播准粒子、近似拓扑边缘模等。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过构建一类具有结构性子空间的局域自旋-1/2链，发现该子空间可被相消干涉保护，从而在混沌系统中支持远超均匀初态复兴的弱遍历性破缺现象，并发展出定量泄漏理论来预测哪些态能保持相干性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过构建一类具有结构性子空间的局域自旋-1/2链，发现该子空间可被相消干涉保护，从而在混沌系统中支持远超均匀初态复兴的弱遍历性破缺现象，并发展出定量泄漏理论来预测哪些态能保持相干性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：提出一类局域自旋-1/2链哈密顿量，构造干涉保护子空间；发展定量泄漏理论（leakage theory）分析态在互补子空间中的动力学泄漏；通过诱导互补子空间中的快速振荡来提升相干稳定性。

papers.title: A new Ising/tricritical-Ising interface: From ${W}_3$ symmetry to Rydberg atoms
papers.abstract: We consider interfaces between critical spin-chains in different universality classes, described in the continuum limit by defect/interface conformal field theory (DCFT/ICFT). We find a new conformal interface between the Tricritical Ising (TIM) and the Ising CFT. We also explore the possibility of its experimental realizations in the context of Rydberg atom arrays. Our analysis emphasizes non-invertible symmetries and consistency under modular transformations, and uses defect couplings and the defect spectrum -- including in the case of mixed boundary conditions -- to make sharp experimental predictions. The structure of the observables hinges on a newly discovered pattern of emergent ${W}_3$ chiral symmetry for the Tricritical-Ising/Ising interface.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：conformal field theory, defect/interface CFT, modular transformations, chiral symmetry）；研究对象：临界自旋链之间的界面，具体为三临界伊辛模型（TIM）与伊辛模型（Ising CFT）之间的共形界面，以及其在里德伯原子阵列中的实验实现可能性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一个新的三临界伊辛/伊辛共形界面，该界面具有新兴的W₃手征对称性，并基于此给出了可观测量的实验预测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一个新的三临界伊辛/伊辛共形界面，该界面具有新兴的W₃手征对称性，并基于此给出了可观测量的实验预测。；创新点：首次发现三临界伊辛与伊辛CFT之间的新型共形界面，并揭示了其中新兴的W₃手征对称性模式。
papers.method_zh: 采用缺陷/界面共形场论（DCFT/ICFT）框架，分析非可逆对称性和模变换一致性，通过缺陷耦合和缺陷谱（包括混合边界条件情况）进行理论推导。

papers.title: Real time monitoring of pressure-induced deformation of PDMS to evaluate pressure distribution in microfluidic channels
papers.abstract: Accurate pressure measurements in micrometric channels are essential for a wide range of microfluidic applications. Existing approaches rely on a variety of sensing mechanisms, but generally require the integration of additional probes or sensing elements during or after chip fabrication. Here, we introduce a pressure sensing approach based on quantitative phase imaging of the deformation of compliant microfluidic channels. We demonstrate real-time measurements of channel deformation over a large field of view with high sensitivity, without the need for embedded components or modifications of the microfluidic device.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“introduce a pressure sensing approach based on quantitative phase imaging”和“demonstrate real-time measurements”，属于实验性工作。；研究对象：微流控通道中聚二甲基硅氧烷（PDMS）在压力作用下的形变，以及由此实现的微通道内压力分布测量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于定量相位成像的微流控通道压力传感方法，无需嵌入额外元件或修改器件，即可实时、高灵敏度地测量大面积通道的形变，从而评估压力分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于定量相位成像的微流控通道压力传感方法，无需嵌入额外元件或修改器件，即可实时、高灵敏度地测量大面积通道的形变，从而评估压力分布。；创新点：无需在芯片制造过程中或之后集成额外的探针或传感元件，即可实现大面积、高灵敏度的实时压力测量。
papers.method_zh: 定量相位成像（quantitative phase imaging），用于实时监测PDMS微流控通道在压力下的形变。

papers.title: Atom-Photon Bound States in Fractal Photonic Lattices: Localization Length and Anomalous Diffusion
papers.abstract: We study atom-photon bound states seeded by two-level emitters coupled to self-similar photonic lattices. By expressing the photonic Green's function through the heat kernel, we show that the far-field localization length obeys $ξ\sim Δ^{-1/d_w}$, with the detuning $Δ$ from the lower spectral edge and the walk dimension $d_w$ of the underlying fractal. This scaling is controlled by anomalous diffusion and does not rely on translational invariance or a band-edge effective-mass approximation. Exact diagonalization on Sierpiński gaskets, pyramids, Vicsek graphs, and Sierpiński carpets confirms the far-field prediction once the bath Hamiltonian is rendered Laplacian-like by compensating the local inhomogeneity in the connectivities with on-site potentials. In the near field, the bound-state amplitude exhibits an additional algebraic variation. For nested finitely ramified fractals, the corresponding exponent agrees with the classical resistance/ first-passage scaling, whereas Sierpiński carpets display clear deviations from this simple law. Our results extend structured-bath waveguide QED to self-similar non-periodic geometries and connect bound-state profiles to transport exponents of the underlying fractal lattice.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：We study, we show, exact diagonalization, 理论推导与数值计算结合）；研究对象：分形光子晶格中由二能级发射体激发的原子-光子束缚态，具体包括Sierpiński垫片、金字塔、Vicsek图、Sierpiński地毯等分形结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 束缚态的远场局域长度满足标度律 ξ ∼ Δ^{-1/d_w}，其中Δ为与下谱边的失谐量，d_w为分形的行走维数；该标度由反常扩散控制，不依赖平移对称性或带边有效质量近似。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：束缚态的远场局域长度满足标度律 ξ ∼ Δ^{-1/d_w}，其中Δ为与下谱边的失谐量，d_w为分形的行走维数；该标度由反常扩散控制，不依赖平移对称性或带边有效质量近似。；创新点：将结构浴波导量子电动力学推广到自相似非周期几何体系，建立了束缚态轮廓与底层分形晶格输运指数之间的联系。
papers.method_zh: 通过热核表达光子格林函数进行解析推导，并在多种分形晶格（Sierpiński垫片、金字塔、Vicsek图、Sierpiński地毯）上进行精确对角化数值验证；通过补偿局域连接性不均匀性的在位势使浴哈密顿量类拉普拉斯化。

papers.title: Non-Hermitian Landau Levels
papers.abstract: We formulate non-Hermitian Landau levels in two-dimensional systems under a complex perpendicular magnetic field. In the symmetric gauge, we derive their discretely spaced, highly degenerate complex spectra and biorthogonal eigenstates, and clarify the role of non-unitary gauge transformations. A non-Hermitian Harper-Hofstadter lattice model confirms the continuum theory and reveals Gaussian wave packet dynamics governed by semiclassical equations with a complex Lorentz force, pointing to possible experimental realizations of complex magnetic fields.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：formulate, derive, confirm, semiclassical equations）；研究对象：非厄米物理系统中的朗道能级，具体为在复垂直磁场下的二维电子系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在复垂直磁场下，二维系统可以形成非厄米的朗道能级，其能谱是离散且高度简并的复数，并且其动力学由包含复洛伦兹力的半经典方程描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在复垂直磁场下，二维系统可以形成非厄米的朗道能级，其能谱是离散且高度简并的复数，并且其动力学由包含复洛伦兹力的半经典方程描述。；创新点：将朗道能级的概念推广到了非厄米体系，即复磁场下的情形，并揭示了其独特的复数能谱、双正交本征态以及由复洛伦兹力主导的高斯波包动力学。摘要未明确说明与具体实验体系的关联细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导。在对称规范下解析推导了非厄米朗道能级的复能谱和双正交本征态，并分析了非幺正规范变换的作用。同时，构建了一个非厄米的Harper-Hofstadter晶格模型来验证连续理论。

papers.title: Preisach Attention: A Hysteretic Model of Sequential Memory
papers.abstract: We introduce the Preisach Attention Layer (PAL), a novel sequence modelling architecture grounded in the classical Preisach hysteresis operator from mathematical physics. PAL replaces the softmax attention mechanism with a binary relay operator parameterised by learned activation and deactivation thresholds, maintaining a stack of local extrema as its internal state. A single-layer PAL-Transformer with O(1) depth is Turing-complete under arbitrary precision arithmetic, achievable through simulation of a two-stack pushdown automaton -- in contrast to the O(log n) depth required by standard hard-attention transformers. Second, we prove that the function classes computable by PAL and by the transformer are incomparable: PAL computes historical range statistics in O(1) layers that require O(log n) layers for transformers, while transformers support random-access retrieval that PAL cannot perform without auxiliary state. The separating property is rate-independence -- PAL responds only to the sequence of local extrema, not to absolute token positions or temporal spacing. Third, we show that the extremum stack constitutes a minimal sufficient statistic of the input history for all rate-independent functionals, providing a formal analogue of the wiping property in classical hysteresis theory. PAL is thus an efficient architecture for tasks with long episodic memory and weak positional dependence, with O(n log n) total inference cost versus O(n^2) for standard attention.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：论文主要进行数学证明（Turing完备性证明、函数类不可比性证明）和理论分析（最小充分统计量、率无关性），属于理论建模工作。；研究对象：论文研究的是一种新型的序列建模架构，即基于经典Preisach磁滞算子的注意力机制（Preisach Attention Layer, PAL），并将其应用于Transformer模型。其核心物理现象是磁滞效应（Hysteresis），特别是其“擦除”特性（wiping property）和率无关性（rate-independence）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 1. 单层PAL-Transformer在任意精度算术下是图灵完备的，而标准硬注意力Transformer需要O(log n)层深度。2. PAL和标准Transformer可计算的函数类不可比：PAL能以O(1)层计算历史范围统计（标准Transformer需O(log n)层），但无法进行标准Transformer擅长的随机访问检索。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：1. 单层PAL-Transformer在任意精度算术下是图灵完备的，而标准硬注意力Transformer需要O(log n)层深度。2. PAL和标准Transformer可计算的函数类不可比：PAL能以O(1)层计算历史范围统计（标准Transformer需O(log n)层），但无法进行标准Transformer擅长的随机访问检索。；创新点：首次将凝聚态物理中的Preisach磁滞模型引入深度学习序列建模，并严格证明了其与标准Transformer在计算能力上的本质区别（不可比性），特别是其率无关性（仅响应局部极值序列，而非绝对位置或时间间隔）和极值栈作为历史最小充分统计量的理论地位。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：经典Preisach磁滞算子。模型架构：用二元中继算子（binary relay operator）替代softmax注意力，通过学习的激活/去激活阈值来参数化，并维护一个局部极值栈作为内部状态。分析方法：通过模拟双栈下推自动机证明图灵完备性；通过函数类对比和率无关性分析证明与标准Transformer的不可比性。

papers.title: Entanglement entropy across the dynamical phase transition in the quantum $\mathcal{O}(N)$ model
papers.abstract: We demonstrate that the dynamical phase transition of the quantum $\mathcal{O}(N)$ model at large $N$ leaves universal fingerprints in the infrared structure of the entanglement spectrum. While the leading contribution to the entanglement entropy at long time follows the conventional volume law associated with ballistic entanglement spreading, its subleading behavior sharply distinguishes the different dynamical regimes. Specifically, quenches at and below the critical point generate gapless low-energy entanglement modes together with logarithmic corrections to the long-time entanglement entropy, whose scaling is governed by the dynamical exponent of the transition. Using an infinite-slab bipartition geometry and exact numerical correlation functions in the large-$N$ limit, we characterize these scaling laws across the dynamical phase diagram and relate them to the emergence of long-range correlations during the post-quench dynamics. We further show that the entanglement eigenmodes themselves reveal characteristic signatures of the dynamical phase transition through their spatio-temporal structure and degeneracy properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“large N limit”、“exact numerical correlation functions”、“scaling laws”等理论分析关键词，未涉及实验或第一性原理计算。；研究对象：量子O(N)模型在动力学相变中的纠缠熵行为，具体研究大N极限下该模型经淬火后纠缠谱的红外结构及其与动力学相变的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量子O(N)模型在大N极限下的动力学相变会在纠缠谱的红外结构中留下普适指纹：长时间纠缠熵的次领头行为可清晰区分不同动力学区域，临界点及以下淬火会产生无能隙低能纠缠模及对数修正，其标度由动力学临界指数控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量子O(N)模型在大N极限下的动力学相变会在纠缠谱的红外结构中留下普适指纹：长时间纠缠熵的次领头行为可清晰区分不同动力学区域，临界点及以下淬火会产生无能隙低能纠缠模及对数修正，其标度由动力学临界指数控制。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用无限平板二分几何（infinite-slab bipartition geometry），在大N极限下通过精确数值关联函数计算纠缠熵及其标度律，并分析纠缠本征模的时空结构与简并性质。

papers.title: Asymmetric Scaling Laws from Sparse Features
papers.abstract: We introduce a model for neural scaling laws under sparse activations. In the model, test loss is often dominated by rare coordinates that are never observed in the training input. This mechanism induces a novel bottleneck absent from dense models. We derive the asymptotic population loss in both the underparameterized and overparameterized regimes, and show that the loss exhibits a double-descent peak near the interpolation threshold -- where the number of parameters is just sufficient to fit the training data -- resulting in a loss curve governed by two distinct scaling exponents -- one for the overparameterized regime and one for the underparameterized regime -- with a gap determined by the degree of sparsity. Additionally, we derive a compute-optimal frontier that favors increasing dataset size over model capacity under fixed compute budgets. We also analyze gradient-descent dynamics and identify a scaling law for the probability that fixed-step gradient descent becomes unstable. We further show that the sparsity-induced effect persists under nonlinear activations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：model、derive、asymptotic population loss、scaling exponents、compute-optimal frontier、gradient-descent dynamics。；研究对象：稀疏激活（sparse activations）条件下的神经网络缩放定律（neural scaling laws），具体研究测试损失在欠参数化和过参数化区域的行为，以及由稀疏特征引入的瓶颈效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在稀疏激活模型中，测试损失主要由训练输入中从未出现的稀有坐标主导，导致在插值阈值附近出现双下降峰（double-descent peak），损失曲线由两个不同的缩放指数（欠参数化与过参数化）控制，其间隙由稀疏度决定。此外，在固定计算预算下，增加数据集大小比增加模型容量更优。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在稀疏激活模型中，测试损失主要由训练输入中从未出现的稀有坐标主导，导致在插值阈值附近出现双下降峰（double-descent peak），损失曲线由两个不同的缩放指数（欠参数化与过参数化）控制，其间隙由稀疏度决定。此外，在固定计算预算下，增加数据集大小比增加模型容量更优。；创新点：揭示了稀疏激活机制引入的独特瓶颈（稀有坐标主导损失），该瓶颈在密集模型中不存在；发现了由稀疏度决定的双指数缩放行为及双下降峰；给出了计算最优前沿（compute-optimal frontier）的解析结果。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：建立稀疏激活下的神经网络缩放定律模型，解析推导渐近总体损失（asymptotic population loss），分析梯度下降动力学，并推导固定步长梯度下降不稳定的概率缩放律。

papers.title: Non-normal spectral signatures of instability in neural network training dynamics
papers.abstract: Training instabilities in deep networks - loss spikes, oscillatory convergence, and gradient pathologies - are empirically prevalent but lack a rigorous operator-theoretic explanation. We show that the linearized update operators for practically used optimizers are generically non-normal: for Adam, non-normality is controlled by the commutator [H, M] between the Hessian and the diagonal adaptive preconditioner, while for SGD with momentum it arises from the augmented state-space structure of the update map. Applying non-normal stability theory to these operators, we derive a conservative pseudospectral precursor bound in which κ(V) serves as an early-warning indicator of transient amplification even when the spectral radius remains below one, and we establish that exceptional points of the update operator appear as the κ(V) -> \infty limiting case of this framework. Numerical experiments on two-layer networks confirm that the spectral radius ρ(J) provides no separation between stable and unstable training phases while κ(V) separates them by approximately one order of magnitude, complementing the classical sharpness criterion with a continuous severity measure of non-normal amplification. These results establish non-Hermitian operator theory as a useful and underexplored framework for neural network optimization stability, offering a diagnostic language and proof-of-concept benchmark for understanding adaptive optimization stability.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值实验）。判断依据：推导了非正规稳定性理论框架，并进行了数值实验验证。；研究对象：神经网络训练动力学中的不稳定性现象，具体包括损失尖峰、振荡收敛和梯度病理等训练不稳定性，以及优化器（Adam、带动量的SGD）的更新算子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 线性化更新算子普遍是非正规的（non-normal），其条件数κ(V)可作为训练不稳定的早期预警指标，而谱半径ρ(J)无法区分稳定与不稳定训练阶段。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：线性化更新算子普遍是非正规的（non-normal），其条件数κ(V)可作为训练不稳定的早期预警指标，而谱半径ρ(J)无法区分稳定与不稳定训练阶段。；创新点：首次将非厄米算子理论系统引入神经网络优化稳定性研究，建立了κ(V)作为连续严重性度量指标，并揭示了异常点作为κ(V)→∞极限情形与训练不稳定性的联系。
papers.method_zh: 非正规稳定性理论（non-normal stability theory）、伪谱（pseudospectral）分析、算子理论中的条件数κ(V)与异常点（exceptional points）分析，并在两层神经网络上进行了数值实验验证。

papers.title: Quantum viscosity mechanism of the dissipative dynamics in the Dicke model expressed via Lindblad equation of motion
papers.abstract: Quantum dissipation is studied in the superradiant phase of the Extended Dicke model. It is demonstrated analytically by quantum mechanical derivation of the Lindblad equation for the Dicke model in the superradiant state coupled to Caldeira-Leggett thermal bath, that the effective viscosity appearing in the semiclassical equations of motion of polaritonic condensate survives in the zero temperature limit T -> 0. The nonzero contribution to viscosity contains prefactor nB (ω, T ) + 1 with the Bose-Einstein function nB of harmonic oscillators in the thermal bath, indicating that virtual excitations of harmonic oscillators in the thermal bath coupled to the polaritons of Dicke model give rise to effective viscosity in the T -> 0 limit. Besides, it is demonstrated analytically, that correct expression for Lindbladian in the superradiant phase should be built using condensate-shifted creation and annihilation operators of the photons and pseudospin operators in Holstein-Primakoff representation of the coupled to photons two-level systems in order the system could relax to its minimum energy in T -> 0 limit due to thermal bath provided effective viscosity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“analytically demonstrated”、“quantum mechanical derivation”、“Lindblad equation”。；研究对象：扩展Dicke模型超辐射相中的量子耗散动力学，具体涉及与Caldeira-Leggett热浴耦合的极化激元凝聚体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在零温极限（T→0）下，半经典运动方程中的有效粘度仍然存在，其非零贡献来自热浴中谐振子的虚激发（包含Bose-Einstein因子n_B(ω,T)+1）。此外，为在T→0极限下使系统弛豫到最小能量，超辐射相中的Lindblad算符必须使用凝聚位移后的光子产生湮灭算符以及Holstein-Primakoff表象中的赝自旋算符来构建。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在零温极限（T→0）下，半经典运动方程中的有效粘度仍然存在，其非零贡献来自热浴中谐振子的虚激发（包含Bose-Einstein因子n_B(ω,T)+1）。此外，为在T→0极限下使系统弛豫到最小能量，超辐射相中的Lindblad算符必须使用凝聚位移后的光子产生湮灭算符以及Holstein-Primakoff表象中的赝自旋算符来构建。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过量子力学推导超辐射态下Dicke模型的Lindblad主方程，结合Caldeira-Leggett热浴模型，并采用Holstein-Primakoff变换处理与光子耦合的二能级系统。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning for Microcanonical Graph Ensemble with Assortativity Constraints
