papers.abstract: How network structure determines function is a fundamental question, and it can be investigated by graph ensembles with precisely controlled structural properties. Canonical approaches, formulated as exponential random graph models (ERGMs), enforce constraints only in expectation, allowing individual realizations to fluctuate around the target. Conversely, microcanonical ensembles impose hard constraints exactly, but practical sampling methods beyond fixing the degree sequence have remained out of reach. Here we introduce the Deep Microcanonical Graph Generator (DMGG), a reinforcement learning (RL) framework that transforms any given graph through degree-preserving rewirings to exactly reach a prescribed assortativity, which characterizes the degree--degree correlation of adjacent nodes. Instead of relying on the entropically dominated Metropolis--Hastings dynamics of the ERGM, DMGG employs a policy-guided search that maximally alters the joint-degree matrix. This eliminates exhaustive parameter tuning and accelerates generation by at least an order of magnitude while preserving configurational diversity. As DMGG generalizes across various graph sizes, sparsities, and topologies, it provides exact null models that allow for the quantitative isolation of secondary observables, such as the clustering coefficient. These results establish RL as a practical and powerful paradigm for generating hard-constrained graphs, opening avenues to investigate structure-function relationships free from ensemble artifacts.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：reinforcement learning framework, graph ensembles, sampling methods。；研究对象：网络图（graph）的微正则系综（microcanonical ensemble），具体研究在保持度序列（degree sequence）不变的条件下，精确控制图的同配性（assortativity，即节点度-度相关性）的图生成问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于强化学习（RL）的深度微正则图生成器（DMGG），能够通过度保持重连（degree-preserving rewiring）精确达到指定的同配性，生成速度比传统Metropolis-Hastings方法快至少一个数量级，同时保持构型多样性，为定量分离聚类系数等次级可观测量提供了精确零模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于强化学习（RL）的深度微正则图生成器（DMGG），能够通过度保持重连（degree-preserving rewiring）精确达到指定的同配性，生成速度比传统Metropolis-Hastings方法快至少一个数量级，同时保持构型多样性，为定量分离聚类系数等次级可观测量提供了精确零模型。；创新点：首次将强化学习应用于生成具有硬约束（精确同配性）的微正则图系综，避免了传统指数随机图模型（ERGM）中熵主导的Metropolis-Hastings动力学所需的繁琐参数调优，并显著加速生成过程。
papers.method_zh: 采用强化学习（RL）框架，通过策略引导的搜索（policy-guided search）最大化改变联合度矩阵（joint-degree matrix），实现度保持重连，从而生成满足硬约束（hard constraints）的微正则图系综。

papers.title: Interference of local-measurement histories
papers.abstract: The evolution of a quantum system comprises two fundamental processes--continuous unitary dynamics and stochastic measurement-induced jumps. The latter are often viewed as a source of decoherence. Can two histories of such an evolution, made up of local measurements, interfere with each other? Here, we answer this question in the affirmative. A manifestation of this interference is the generation of entanglement between two parts of the system that are individually coupled to distinct detectors. Specifically, we develop a protocol in which two alternative local measurement processes act on a pair of qubits, and show how interference of histories is generated under coherent control, leading to entanglement. Furthermore, we find that averaging over the detectors' readouts still results in an entangled (albeit not maximally entangled) state. Our results extend the notion of quantum interference beyond unitary evolution to genuinely measurement-driven dynamics, and identify limits on the generation of quantum correlations using interference of measurement histories.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：quantum interference, measurement-induced jumps, coherent control, protocol。；研究对象：量子系统中由局域测量构成的历史演化路径之间的干涉现象，具体以一对量子比特（qubits）为体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 局域测量历史之间可以发生量子干涉，这种干涉能够产生两个子系统之间的纠缠，即使对探测器的读出结果进行平均后，系统仍处于纠缠态（尽管非最大纠缠）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：局域测量历史之间可以发生量子干涉，这种干涉能够产生两个子系统之间的纠缠，即使对探测器的读出结果进行平均后，系统仍处于纠缠态（尽管非最大纠缠）。；创新点：将量子干涉的概念从幺正演化扩展到完全由测量驱动的动力学过程，并揭示了利用测量历史干涉生成量子关联的极限。
papers.method_zh: 提出了一个理论协议：对一对量子比特分别施加两种可选的局域测量过程，在相干控制下实现测量历史的干涉，并分析纠缠生成。

papers.title: Transition-state lattice modes and the breakdown of adiabatic tunneling for hydrogen and deuterium in bcc Nb
papers.abstract: Interstitial hydrogen and deuterium in body-centered-cubic metals constitute archetypal quantum tunneling systems. Their relevance has been renewed by the connection between hydrogenic tunneling in Nb and defect-induced decoherence in superconducting qubits, motivating a predictive microscopic theory. Existing theoretical treatments invoke an adiabatic separation between the light interstitial and the host lattice, an assumption whose validity has not been rigorously established for hydrogenic species. Here, we show that the experimentally measured tunnel splittings of O-trapped H and D in bcc Nb are quantitatively reproduced only within a five-dimensional (5D) Lattice-Renormalized Born-Oppenheimer (LRBO) framework. This approach treats three interstitial modes and two judiciously selected lattice modes, which includes a transition-state mode, on equal quantum footing. By recasting nested Born-Oppenheimer hierarchies within this same formalism and benchmarking against modern \textit{ab initio} potential energy surfaces, we show that adiabatic separation of the light particle from lattice dynamics is satisfied only in the positive-muon ($μ^{+}$) mass limit. In contrast, tunneling for H and D is fundamentally a collective, nonadiabatic process mediated by anharmonic lattice couplings. Finally, we show that the breakdown of adiabaticity can be anticipated from simple energy estimates involving the ground-state light-particle energy evaluated at a small number of fixed lattice configurations, providing a practical criterion for assessing the validity of adiabatic tunneling theories in other systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：Born-Oppenheimer框架、ab initio势能面、非绝热过程分析。；研究对象：体心立方铌（bcc Nb）中O位捕获的氢（H）和氘（D）的量子隧穿现象，以及其与晶格振动的耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 氢和氘在bcc Nb中的隧穿分裂只有在一个五维晶格重整化玻恩-奥本海默（LRBO）框架下才能被定量重现；轻粒子与晶格运动的绝热分离仅在正μ子质量极限下成立，而对H和D而言，隧穿本质上是集体非绝热过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：氢和氘在bcc Nb中的隧穿分裂只有在一个五维晶格重整化玻恩-奥本海默（LRBO）框架下才能被定量重现；轻粒子与晶格运动的绝热分离仅在正μ子质量极限下成立，而对H和D而言，隧穿本质上是集体非绝热过程。；创新点：首次严格证明氢和氘在bcc Nb中的隧穿不能采用绝热近似，必须将特定晶格模式（尤其是过渡态模式）与间隙模式非绝热耦合处理；提出了一个基于少量固定晶格构型下轻粒子基态能量的简单判据，用于评估其他系统中绝热隧穿理论的适用性。
papers.method_zh: 采用五维晶格重整化玻恩-奥本海默（5D LRBO）框架，将三个间隙模式与两个精心选择的晶格模式（包括一个过渡态模式）置于同等量子地位处理；通过在该形式内重构嵌套的玻恩-奥本海默层级，并基于现代第一性原理势能面进行基准测试。

papers.title: Yukawa-Screened Bose-Star Condensation
papers.abstract: We study Bose-star formation in a Yukawa-Schrödinger-Poisson (YSP) system. A finite interaction range suppresses the infrared kinetic relaxation responsible for Bose-star condensation, modifying both the equilibrium Bose-star structure and the condensation timescale. We derive a screened kinetic condensation formula in which the ordinary gravitational Coulomb logarithm is replaced by a finite Yukawa transport logarithm. Static YSP solutions show that Yukawa screening broadens the Bose-star density profile relative to the ordinary Newtonian soliton. Fully dynamical pseudospectral simulations with homogeneous and isotropic initial conditions demonstrate that Yukawa screening systematically delays Bose-star condensation, in good agreement with the screened kinetic prediction after fitting a single overall normalization parameter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：We study、derive、static solutions、pseudospectral simulations）；研究对象：Yukawa-Schrödinger-Poisson（YSP）系统中的玻色星（Bose-star）凝聚现象，具体研究有限相互作用范围（Yukawa屏蔽）对玻色星形成的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Yukawa屏蔽抑制了导致玻色星凝聚的红外动力学弛豫，从而改变了平衡态玻色星的结构（密度分布更宽）并延长了凝聚时间尺度；动力学模拟结果与屏蔽后的动力学凝聚公式在拟合一个整体归一化参数后吻合良好。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Yukawa屏蔽抑制了导致玻色星凝聚的红外动力学弛豫，从而改变了平衡态玻色星的结构（密度分布更宽）并延长了凝聚时间尺度；动力学模拟结果与屏蔽后的动力学凝聚公式在拟合一个整体归一化参数后吻合良好。；创新点：首次在Yukawa-Schrödinger-Poisson系统中系统研究了有限相互作用范围对玻色星凝聚的动力学和平衡态性质的影响，并提出了相应的屏蔽动力学凝聚公式。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导（屏蔽动力学凝聚公式，引入有限Yukawa输运对数替代普通引力库仑对数）；静态YSP解（分析平衡态结构）；全动力学赝谱模拟（pseudospectral simulations，采用均匀各向同性初始条件）。

papers.title: Full-Scattering-Matrix Deterministic Phonon Boltzmann Transport Simulation
papers.abstract: Solutions to the phonon Boltzmann transport equation under the relaxation-time approximation (RTA) are fundamentally limited in that they do not account for the off-diagonal elements of the scattering matrix, which encode intermode energy redistribution. We find that the phonon in-scattering matrix is globally incompressible, requiring nearly its full rank for any useful Frobenius accuracy. The incompressibility worsens as the Brillouin zone is refined. We show that, despite this difficulty, one can develop a computationally efficient 3D BTE solver incorporating the complete scattering matrix by leveraging our two structural discoveries: the non-equilibrium phonon distribution inhabits a remarkably low-dimensional subspace of mode space regardless of how many phonon modes exist, and the leading singular modes of the scattering operator align selectively with this transport-active subspace. Consequently, truncation incurs negligible transport error even under large norm error. The phonon streaming operator's mode-diagonal character further motivates a hybrid architecture that exploits these two properties. When applied to nanoscale structures emulating a fin field-effect transistor, our BTE solver quantifies a geometry-independent multiplicative correction to the temperature rise predicted under RTA. Our theoretical work and resulting BTE solver help enable rigorous study of phonon transport and systematic design of devices and structures in the ballistic and quasi-ballistic phonon transport regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“理论工作”、“BTE求解器”、“计算高效”等关键词，核心是发展数值求解方法。；研究对象：声子在弹道和准弹道输运 regime 下的输运现象，具体模拟对象为模仿鳍式场效应晶体管（FinFET）的纳米结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 声子散射矩阵的不可压缩性导致其几乎需要满秩才能准确表示，但非平衡声子分布函数仅占据一个极低维度的子空间，且散射算子的主要奇异模式与该输运活跃子空间选择性对齐。基于此，可以构建一个包含完整散射矩阵的高效三维声子玻尔兹曼输运方程（BTE）求解器，并发现弛豫时间近似（RTA）预测的温度上升存在一个与几何无关的乘法修正。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：声子散射矩阵的不可压缩性导致其几乎需要满秩才能准确表示，但非平衡声子分布函数仅占据一个极低维度的子空间，且散射算子的主要奇异模式与该输运活跃子空间选择性对齐。基于此，可以构建一个包含完整散射矩阵的高效三维声子玻尔兹曼输运方程（BTE）求解器，并发现弛豫时间近似（RTA）预测的温度上升存在一个与几何无关的乘法修正。；创新点：1）首次揭示了声子入射散射矩阵的全局不可压缩性这一数学结构。2）发现了非平衡声子分布的低维子空间性质以及散射算子奇异模式的选择性对齐，并利用这两个结构发现，克服了完整散射矩阵计算量巨大的困难，实现了包含完整散射矩阵的高效BTE求解。3）定量给出了RTA下温度预测的几何无关乘法修正。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与数值模拟。具体方法包括：1）对声子散射矩阵的不可压缩性进行数学分析；2）利用奇异值分解（SVD）发现非平衡声子分布的低维子空间性质；3）提出一种混合架构，利用声子流算子的模式对角特性，结合上述两个结构发现，构建高效的3D BTE求解器。

papers.title: Absorbing Many-Body Correlations into Core-Optimized Orbitals
papers.abstract: The cost of simulating quantum many-body systems - on classical or quantum hardware - scales with the number of variational parameters, so progress at fixed computational budget hinges on more parameter-efficient ansätze. Configuration Interaction (CI) is widely dismissed as parameter-heavy; we show this verdict is an artifact of the orbital basis. Co-optimizing the orbital basis with a sparse CI wavefunction - a method we call Core-Optimized Orbitals (COO) - absorbs a large fraction of the dynamical correlation directly into the single-particle basis, cutting the determinant count by several orders of magnitude beyond the already compact TrimCI ansatz on which it builds. On [Fe$_4$S$_4$] (54e, 36o), a billion-determinant TrimCI+COO wavefunction reaches accuracy that would require $3\!\times\!10^{14}$ determinants in a localized basis. At matched accuracy, it is $8\times$ more compact than the largest unrestricted-DMRG benchmark ($25\times$ with PT2). Across the iron-sulfur series - from [Fe$_2$S$_2$] (30e,20o) to the P-cluster (114e,73o) - TrimCI+COO is $10$-$100\times$ more compact than SU(2)-adapted DMRG with entanglement-minimized orbitals at matched accuracy. A tunable Hubbard-on-graph model factorizes the advantage into an orbital-basis gain and an ansatz gain, the latter capturing multi-center entanglement that resists MPS localization. COO therefore changes the picture of CI efficiency: sparse CI with optimized orbitals can outperform state-of-the-art tensor networks on strongly correlated multi-center systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：simulating、classical or quantum hardware、variational parameters、method、wavefunction、benchmark。；研究对象：论文研究的具体体系是铁硫簇系列，包括[Fe₂S₂]（30e,20o）、[Fe₄S₄]（54e,36o）以及P-cluster（114e,73o），属于强关联多中心量子多体系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将轨道基与稀疏CI波函数协同优化（Core-Optimized Orbitals, COO），可以将大量动态关联直接吸收进单粒子基中，使行列式数量降低数个数量级，从而在强关联多中心体系上超越最先进的张量网络方法（如DMRG）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将轨道基与稀疏CI波函数协同优化（Core-Optimized Orbitals, COO），可以将大量动态关联直接吸收进单粒子基中，使行列式数量降低数个数量级，从而在强关联多中心体系上超越最先进的张量网络方法（如DMRG）。；创新点：该工作颠覆了“CI方法参数过多、效率低下”的传统认知，证明通过轨道优化，稀疏CI可以比DMRG等张量网络方法更紧凑（在相同精度下，行列式数量减少10-100倍），从而改变了CI效率的图景。
papers.method_zh: 具体方法为“Core-Optimized Orbitals (COO)”，即在稀疏组态相互作用（CI）框架下协同优化轨道基，构建于已有的紧凑TrimCI ansatz之上。对比基准包括SU(2)适配的DMRG（使用纠缠最小化轨道）以及无限制DMRG。还引入了一个可调Hubbard-on-graph模型来分解优势来源。

papers.title: Phase-dependent role of dissipation across the Aubry-André-Harper transition
papers.abstract: We study transport across the Aubry-André-Harper localization transition in the presence of non-Markovian dissipation. For a single particle initially at the center of the chain, we show that bath memory (i.e., finite decay time of bath correlations) plays distinct roles in the two phases. In the extended phase, bath memory qualitatively reshapes the dynamical generator, thereby producing transport patterns that cannot be reduced to a simple rescaling of time. By contrast, in the localized phase, the bath activates motion between localized states and bath memory mainly renormalizes the dynamical timescales. Our results identify localization as a simple filter of non-Markovian effects: memory restructures transport in the extended regime, but survives mainly as a timescale renormalization in the deeply localized regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：非马尔可夫耗散、动力学生成元、时间尺度重整化。；研究对象：Aubry-André-Harper 模型中的局域化-扩展相变，以及非马尔可夫耗散对该体系输运行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在扩展相中，浴记忆（非马尔可夫效应）会重塑动力学生成元，产生无法通过简单时间缩放来描述的输运模式；而在局域化相中，浴记忆主要对动力学时间尺度进行重整化，局域化充当了非马尔可夫效应的“滤波器”。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在扩展相中，浴记忆（非马尔可夫效应）会重塑动力学生成元，产生无法通过简单时间缩放来描述的输运模式；而在局域化相中，浴记忆主要对动力学时间尺度进行重整化，局域化充当了非马尔可夫效应的“滤波器”。；创新点：首次揭示了非马尔可夫耗散在Aubry-André-Harper局域化转变中具有相依赖的角色，即局域化相会抑制记忆对输运结构的重塑，仅保留时间尺度重整化效应。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，具体为研究单个粒子在链中心初始条件下，耦合非马尔可夫耗散浴的输运动力学，通过比较扩展相与局域化相中浴记忆的不同作用来揭示其相依赖角色。

papers.title: Chaos to Synchronization and Dissipative Quantum Scarring in Open Coupled top-Dicke model in a Lossy Cavity
papers.abstract: We present a variant of the Dicke model, termed as the open coupled-top Dicke model, which enables the exploration of rich non-equilibrium phenomena, particularly the fate of quantum scars in an open environment. This model can effectively be realized by coupling a two-species Bose-Josephson junction to a lossy cavity. Photon loss induces spontaneous synchronization via projection onto a dissipation-free subspace, along with transient chaos followed by restoration of synchronization and coherence. We identify two distinct scarring phenomena in the presence of dissipation. One remains protected, exhibiting persistent revivals, while the scar associated with the superradiant phase displays a dissipation-induced slow decay of the survival probability. Remarkably, for sufficiently small spin magnitude, the chaos-assisted macroscopic quantum tunneling is linked to the latter type of scarring. The results can be readily tested in ongoing cavity QED experiments and have broader applicability in other platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：present a variant, can effectively be realized, results can be readily tested）；研究对象：开放耦合顶-迪克模型（open coupled-top Dicke model），具体为耦合两物种玻色-约瑟夫森结与有损腔的光学系统，研究非平衡现象、量子疤痕在开放环境中的命运以及混沌与同步行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在光子耗散存在下，系统可通过投影到无耗散子空间实现自发同步，并出现瞬态混沌后恢复同步与相干性；发现两种不同的耗散量子疤痕，其中一种受保护并持续复苏，另一种与超辐射相相关并表现出耗散诱导的缓慢衰减。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在光子耗散存在下，系统可通过投影到无耗散子空间实现自发同步，并出现瞬态混沌后恢复同步与相干性；发现两种不同的耗散量子疤痕，其中一种受保护并持续复苏，另一种与超辐射相相关并表现出耗散诱导的缓慢衰减。；创新点：首次在开放耦合顶-迪克模型中同时揭示耗散诱导的同步、瞬态混沌与两种不同类型的量子疤痕，并指出混沌辅助的宏观量子隧穿与后一种疤痕相关，摘要未突出说明与已有模型的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与分析，基于开放耦合顶-迪克模型的量子主方程或有效非厄米哈密顿量框架，结合数值模拟研究动力学（如生存概率、同步与混沌行为）。

papers.title: Entanglement-facilitated macroscopic cluster formation in quantum many-body dynamics
papers.abstract: The capacity of a quantum many-body system to preserve global information -- encoded in the non-local correlations -- is a prerequisite for robust quantum computing. Unlike local degrees of freedom, large structures offer inherent resilience to noise, but their stability is often compromised by dynamical fragmentation and local excitations. In this work, we investigate under what initial conditions the quantum dynamics can sustain system-size cluster structures by examining false-vacuum decay dynamics in a 2D quantum Ising model. We find that while product states rapidly fragment into uncorrelated domains, initial-state entanglement suppresses the proliferation of true-vacuum bubbles and stabilises macroscopic connected clusters. We find that this passive stabilisation is not a mere consequence of entanglement entropy but rather depends on the specific pre-quench correlations. Our results establish a connection between initial-state preparation and the preservation of global structures, highlighting the role of entanglement for the passive protection of information in 2D quantum many-body simulation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“investigate”“examining”“find”等理论分析用语，未涉及实验或计算模拟的具体方法。；研究对象：二维量子伊辛模型中的假真空衰变动力学，以及量子多体系统中宏观团簇结构的形成与稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 初始态中的纠缠可以抑制真空气泡的增殖，从而稳定宏观连通的团簇结构，防止系统因动力学碎片化而失去全局信息。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：初始态中的纠缠可以抑制真空气泡的增殖，从而稳定宏观连通的团簇结构，防止系统因动力学碎片化而失去全局信息。；创新点：揭示了初始态纠缠对宏观结构被动稳定的作用并非单纯由纠缠熵决定，而是依赖于具体的预淬火关联模式，建立了初始态制备与全局信息保护之间的直接联系。
papers.method_zh: 通过分析二维量子伊辛模型中的假真空衰变动力学，比较不同初始条件（乘积态 vs. 纠缠态）下系统演化行为，并考察预淬火关联对团簇稳定性的影响。

papers.title: Observation of associative-memory retrieval and spin-glass phases on a photonic quantum simulator
papers.abstract: Models of interacting complex systems provide the fundamental statistical physics reference frame for the study and the understanding of associative memories, machine learning, and the dynamics of neural networks. On the other hand, simulating complex multi-synaptic interactions on a classical hardware is computationally demanding due to the super-linear scaling of the system complexity. Photonic quantum technologies provide a promising solution to these limitations by leveraging on their inherent speed and parallel processing ability in order to simulate complex networks. Recently, a connection between multiphoton processes and generalized $p$-body Hopfield models has been theoretically established. Here, we design and demonstrate an experimental platform that exploits single photons distributed across a set of optical modes, in which controlled arrays of binary phase shifters act as Ising-like neurons. We focus specifically on a fully connected Hopfield Hamiltonian with four-body local interaction terms, realized via two-photon processes. Through quantum simulations on programmable photonic processors, the study identifies three distinct regimes: a memory retrieval phase, a spin-glass memory "black-out" phase, and a paramagnetic phase. Experimental results confirm successful memory retrieval at low storage capacities and temperatures, where the system consistently relaxes to fixed points with high memory overlap, effectively reconstructing the stored patterns. Future research will extend the platform design to investigate networks with local or dilute interactions, while advances in the realization of scalable photonic circuits will enable architectures that encompass very large numbers of interacting spins.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：experimental platform, quantum simulations on programmable photonic processors, Experimental results confirm）；研究对象：基于光子量子模拟器的联想记忆检索与自旋玻璃相，具体为具有四体局域相互作用项的完全连接Hopfield模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在光子量子模拟器上实验观测到三种不同相：记忆检索相、自旋玻璃记忆“黑障”相和顺磁相；在低存储容量和低温下成功实现了存储模式的检索。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在光子量子模拟器上实验观测到三种不同相：记忆检索相、自旋玻璃记忆“黑障”相和顺磁相；在低存储容量和低温下成功实现了存储模式的检索。；创新点：首次在光子量子平台上实验实现了广义p体Hopfield模型的量子模拟，并观测到联想记忆检索与自旋玻璃相变。
papers.method_zh: 利用可编程光子处理器，通过单光子分布在光学模式阵列中，以二进制移相器阵列模拟伊辛型神经元，通过双光子过程实现四体局域相互作用的Hopfield哈密顿量，进行量子模拟实验。

papers.title: Scale-Invariant Open Quantum Systems
papers.abstract: We develop a complete theoretical framework for open quantum systems coupled to scale-invariant environments. We show that such environments are universally described by unparticle baths characterized by a single scaling dimension $d_{\mathcal{U}}$. This work provides the proof of the uniqueness theorem, the formalism of the resulting non-Markovian dynamics, and applications to several physical systems. From the uniqueness theorem, we derive the non-Markovian memory kernels, the exact noise kernel including vacuum and thermal contributions, and a fractional generalization of the Caldeira-Leggett master equation for arbitrary $d_{\mathcal{U}}$. The scaling dimension governs a rich phase structure, including a thermalization transition at $d_{\mathcal{U}}=3/2$, the Ohmic boundary at $d_{\mathcal{U}}=2$, and a decoherence transition at $d_{\mathcal{U}}=5/2$ in the thermal regime, beyond which long-time quantum coherence is protected. Three realizations are studied. For the quantum Ising model at criticality, coupling to the energy operator in $(1+1)$ dimensions gives $d_{\mathcal{U}}=3/2$, producing $1/f$ noise, while the $(2+1)$D case yields $d_{\mathcal{U}}\approx1.413$ from the conformal bootstrap. In inflationary cosmology, massless scalar and graviton baths in de Sitter spacetime give $d_{\mathcal{U}}=2$, predicting linear decoherence growth consistent with the quantum-to-classical transition. For high-energy astrophysical neutrinos, the decoherence rate $Γ_{\mathrm{decoh}}\propto \mathcal{B}(E,T_{\mathcal{U}})L^{5-2d_{\mathcal{U}}}$ provides an observable signature of the scaling dimension. We also compare the framework with Caldeira-Leggett and Lindblad approaches, analyze the validity regimes, and discuss experimental implications for trapped-ion simulators, neutrino telescopes, and superconducting qubits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：develop a complete theoretical framework、proof of the uniqueness theorem、formalism、applications。；研究对象：标度不变环境中的开放量子系统，具体包括临界量子伊辛模型、暴胀宇宙学中的德西特时空、高能天体物理中微子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 标度不变环境由单一标度维数 \(d_{\mathcal{U}}\) 的“非粒子浴”普适描述，该维数决定了系统的热化转变（\(d_{\mathcal{U}}=3/2\)）、欧姆边界（\(d_{\mathcal{U}}=2\)）以及退相干转变（\(d_{\mathcal{U}}=5/2\)），在热区超过后者时量子相干性可被长期保护。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：标度不变环境由单一标度维数 \(d_{\mathcal{U}}\) 的“非粒子浴”普适描述，该维数决定了系统的热化转变（\(d_{\mathcal{U}}=3/2\)）、欧姆边界（\(d_{\mathcal{U}}=2\)）以及退相干转变（\(d_{\mathcal{U}}=5/2\)），在热区超过后者时量子相干性可被长期保护。；创新点：首次建立了标度不变环境与“非粒子浴”之间的普适对应关系，并给出了完整的非马尔可夫动力学框架，揭示了标度维数驱动的丰富相结构及其在多个物理系统中的可观测后果。
papers.method_zh: 通过唯一性定理推导非马尔可夫记忆核、包含真空和热贡献的精确噪声核，以及任意 \(d_{\mathcal{U}}\) 下的分数阶 Caldeira-Leggett 主方程；并利用共形自举方法计算具体体系的标度维数。

papers.title: Quantum Fisher Information under decoherence with explicit wavefunctions
papers.abstract: We present a method to estimate the quantum Fisher information (QFI) of many-body quantum states in the presence of decoherence, where its direct evaluation requires the full spectral resolution of the density matrix. We show that, for many-body wave functions known analytically in the occupation-number basis, systematic lower bounds to the QFI can be mapped onto expectation values over a classical probability distribution defined by the wave function amplitudes. This mapping enables efficient estimation via Markov-chain Monte Carlo sampling, with a computational cost that scales as a `slow' exponential ($e^{b L}$ with $b \lesssim 0.6$) and remains manageable for system sizes well beyond exact diagonalization. We specify this framework to Jastrow-Gutzwiller wave functions. We characterize their metrological content by identifying the observables that maximize the QFI and the corresponding scaling with $L$. Then, we analyze the QFI under three physically motivated noise channels: local dephasing, local amplitude damping, and global depolarizing. We compare polynomial and Krylov-based lower bounds across these channels, relating their behavior to the effective rank of the noisy density matrix and to the structure of the operator generating the parameter encoding. The framework extends naturally to other analytically known wave functions and to a broader class of information-theoretic quantities beyond the QFI.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：提出计算方法（Markov-chain Monte Carlo sampling）、理论框架（映射到经典概率分布）、分析噪声通道（local dephasing, local amplitude damping, global depolarizing），无实验数据。；研究对象：存在退相干（decoherence）的多体量子态，具体以Jastrow-Gutzwiller波函数为例，研究其量子Fisher信息（QFI）的估计与计量学内容。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于在占据数基下具有解析形式的多体波函数，量子Fisher信息的系统性下界可映射为经典概率分布上的期望值，从而通过马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛采样高效估计，计算代价为“慢指数”增长（指数因子b≲0.6），可处理远超精确对角化能力的系统尺寸。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于在占据数基下具有解析形式的多体波函数，量子Fisher信息的系统性下界可映射为经典概率分布上的期望值，从而通过马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛采样高效估计，计算代价为“慢指数”增长（指数因子b≲0.6），可处理远超精确对角化能力的系统尺寸。；创新点：提出一种无需密度矩阵全谱分解即可估计退相干下多体量子态QFI的方法，并系统分析了Jastrow-Gutzwiller波函数在不同噪声通道下的计量学内容及其与噪声密度矩阵有效秩和参数编码算符结构的关系。该方法可推广至其他解析已知波函数及更广的信息论量。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：将QFI下界映射为波函数振幅定义的经典概率分布上的期望值；数值方法：马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（Markov-chain Monte Carlo）采样；具体波函数：Jastrow-Gutzwiller波函数；噪声模型：局域退相位（local dephasing）、局域振幅阻尼（local amplitude damping）、全局退极化（global depolarizing）；下界比较：多项式型与Krylov型下界。

papers.title: Propagation Maps, Maradona Exceptional Points, and Pele Singularities in Anisotropic, Tellegen, Chiral, Moving-Medium, Omega and Other Isotropy-Broken Materials
papers.abstract: Anisotropic, Tellegen, chiral, moving-medium-type, omega, gyrotropic, hyperbolic, and multi-hyperbolic materials form an important class of isotropy-broken photonic media in which wave propagation can no longer be characterized by the Fresnel wave surface alone. Here we show that Fresnel wave surfaces can be converted into propagation maps that organize positive- and negative-phase-velocity propagation together with attenuation and amplification. In Hermitian media, the boundary between forward and backward propagation forms the Michelangelo silhouette separatrix. This separatrix is also a continuous locus of Maradona exceptional points, where the index-of-refraction operator becomes defective even though the material medium remains Hermitian. In non-Hermitian media, the attenuation-amplification boundary forms the Caravaggio chiaroscuro separatrix. The associated Pele singularities occur where the handedness remains continuous while the gain-loss character changes sign. Their physical importance is revealed by the momentum-resolved density of states: at these points, the Lorentzian linewidth of the non-Hermitian momentum-resolved density of states (DOS) collapses, producing sharp DOS peaks whose sign reverses across the separatrix. Thus, Pele singularities are threshold-like gain-loss singularities of the Fresnel wave-surface propagation map, generated by non-Hermitian linewidth collapse. The result is a compact geometric language for describing how handedness, degeneracy, loss, gain, and momentum-resolved DOS are organized in isotropy-broken electromagnetic materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show, form, geometric language（无实验或计算细节描述）。；研究对象：各向异性、Tellegen、手性、运动介质型、Omega、回旋、双曲及多双曲材料等各类破缺各向同性的电磁介质中的波传播现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在破缺各向同性的电磁材料中，Fresnel波面可转化为“传播图”，其中正向/反向传播边界构成连续的马拉多纳奇异点（Hermitian介质），而增益/损耗边界构成佩莱奇异点（非Hermitian介质），后者由非Hermitian线宽坍塌产生，导致动量分辨态密度出现尖锐峰并跨边界反转符号。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在破缺各向同性的电磁材料中，Fresnel波面可转化为“传播图”，其中正向/反向传播边界构成连续的马拉多纳奇异点（Hermitian介质），而增益/损耗边界构成佩莱奇异点（非Hermitian介质），后者由非Hermitian线宽坍塌产生，导致动量分辨态密度出现尖锐峰并跨边界反转符号。；创新点：首次将Fresnel波面转化为包含正/负相速度传播、衰减与放大的“传播图”，并识别出两类新型奇异点：Maradona奇异点（Hermitian介质中折射率算符缺陷的连续轨迹）和Pele奇异点（非Hermitian介质中增益-损耗边界上的阈值型奇异点），建立了手征性、简并、损耗、增益与动量分辨态密度之间统一的几何描述语言。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于Fresnel波面的传播图（propagation map）几何语言，分析折射率算符的缺陷性、手征性、增益-损耗特征及动量分辨态密度（DOS）的洛伦兹线宽行为。
